title: Startup Success and Execution Manager
description:
**FORGE Startup Success and Execution Manager**

Hyderabad | Approximately ₹50,000 per month | Minimum 2 years of relevant experience

**About The Big Blind**

The Big Blind is a venture studio working with early-stage founders to strengthen their businesses and prepare for growth. Through FORGE, we help startups sharpen their business models, address execution gaps, improve commercial readiness and build the materials and evidence needed for meaningful investor conversations.

**The opportunity**

We are looking for someone who loves startups and can turn founder discussions into completed work. You will be the continuous point of contact for assigned founders throughout FORGE, owning programme timelines, startup readiness and growth execution with The Big Blind team and specialist mentors. This is a hands-on business-building role, not just programme administration or investment research.

FORGE combines approximately two months of business building and readiness work with investor outreach and connections from the third month. You will help founders move from diagnosis to focused action, while developing their pitch, financials and diligence readiness in parallel. Delivery must follow each startup’s agreed scope and milestones.

**What you will own**

Startup diagnosis and execution plans: Understand the product, customer, market, traction and founder priorities. Identify the most important gaps and translate them into a practical plan with owners, deadlines and evidence of completion.

Business models and growth execution: Assess each startup’s customer segments, pricing, revenue streams and unit economics. Translate strategy into go-to-market, customer acquisition and partnership experiments, track results and help founders make decisions across different business models.

Financial models and analysis: Build or improve spreadsheet models covering revenue, costs, cash flow, burn, runway and relevant unit economics. Test assumptions and scenarios, reconcile available actuals and explain the numbers clearly to founders.

Pitch and business materials: Develop and refine pitch decks, one-pagers and business narratives. Ensure the market story, growth plan and financial model are consistent, supported and easy to understand.

Continuous founder engagement: Stay actively connected with founders throughout the programme, not only during sessions. Run the twice-weekly working cadence, set pre-work, follow up between sessions, resolve bottlenecks and keep founders accountable and supported.

Diligence readiness: Organise the data room and supporting evidence, identify missing information and track closure of readiness gaps. Coordinate legal, tax or other specialist inputs where needed rather than substituting for professional advice.

Mentors and network coordination: Bring the right internal or external expertise into each startup’s work. Support approved customer, partner and investor introductions with relevant materials, clear follow-through and accurate feedback tracking.

Timeline and readiness ownership: Own milestones, dependencies and delivery dates for each startup. Track commercial and investor-readiness gaps, flag slippage early and agree recovery actions. Maintain accurate records and weekly updates through programme close and handover.

**What you should bring**

At least 2 years of relevant experience in startup operations, a founder’s office, venture building, an accelerator or incubator, consulting, or another role involving hands-on work with early-stage businesses.

A genuine interest in startups and the judgement to work constructively with founders through ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.

A practical understanding of multiple startup business models, such as SaaS, marketplaces, D2C, services and product-led businesses. Know how pricing, sales cycles, margins, working capital and growth drivers differ, and adapt the execution plan accordingly.

Confidence building and reviewing financial models in Excel or Google Sheets. You should understand how revenue, costs, cash flow, burn and runway connect, and be able to challenge assumptions without inventing missing data.

The ability to turn complex ideas and analysis into clear pitch decks, one-pagers and action plans using PowerPoint, Google Slides or similar tools.

Strong project ownership: managing multiple workstreams, following up consistently and producing high-quality deliverables on time.

Strong analytical and presentation skills: interpret financial and business data, structure recommendations clearly and present them confidently to founders and stakeholders. Communicate clearly in writing and facilitate productive discussions.

Discretion with startup information and a habit of distinguishing verified facts, founder claims and working assumptions.

**Helpful but not essential**

Ideally, an MBA, a master’s degree in finance, or relevant hands-on finance experience. A specific degree is not required; practical ability and relevant experience matter.

Experience supporting pre-seed or seed-stage startups through business building, fundraising preparation or investor diligence.

Exposure to customer discovery, sales experiments, partnership development or operating metrics across different business models.

Familiarity with cap tables, startup data rooms and investor-facing materials.

Experience coordinating mentors, specialists or cross-functional teams without relying on formal authority.

**What good performance looks like**

Founders stay engaged throughout the programme. Each startup has a current plan, clear owners and dates, with timely follow-ups and recovery actions when milestones slip.

Sessions lead to completed actions and useful evidence, not just meeting notes. Blockers and scope changes are surfaced early.

Financial models are usable and internally consistent; assumptions and gaps are transparent. Pitch materials accurately reflect the business.

Startups make measurable progress against agreed growth priorities and readiness milestones, backed by evidence rather than activity alone, and finish with usable materials and clear next steps.

Introductions and investor conversations are well prepared and followed through. Success is not defined by promising funding or guaranteeing growth.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Quantity Surveyor – Tendering & Estimation**
to independently manage the complete end-to-end tendering process for high-rise residential and commercial construction projects, including MIVAN construction.

The ideal candidate must possess strong expertise in tender preparation, quantity surveying, BOQ preparation, rate analysis, cost estimation, project budgeting, and commercial management.

**Tendering and estimation will be the primary focus of this role.**

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the entire tendering lifecycle, from tender evaluation to final bid submission.
* Review tender documents, drawings, technical specifications, and contractual conditions.
* Prepare accurate quantity take-offs and detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQ).
* Develop comprehensive cost estimates and detailed rate analyses.
* Obtain and evaluate vendor and subcontractor quotations.
* Prepare competitive technical and commercial bids.
* Manage pre-bid queries, tender clarifications, negotiations, and bid documentation.

**2. Project Budgeting & Cost Control**

* Prepare detailed project budgets and cost forecasts.
* Monitor project costs against approved budgets.
* Identify cost variations, deviations, and optimisation opportunities.
* Conduct value engineering and cost-benefit analysis.
* Prepare commercial reports and cost monitoring statements.

**3. Post-Contract Commercial Management**

* Support subcontractor billing, reconciliation, and commercial evaluations.
* Evaluate variations, additional works, and contractual claims.
* Coordinate with execution, procurement, and project management teams.
* Maintain accurate commercial and tender-related documentation.

Qualifications & Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering.
* **5–10 years of relevant experience**

* Proven experience in high-rise residential or commercial construction projects.
* Strong understanding of

  .
* Extensive hands-on experience in end-to-end tendering and bid preparation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, AutoCAD, and relevant estimation software.

Preferred Candidate

Candidates with proven experience in
**independently handling complete tender submissions for high-rise construction projects**
, including MIVAN-based projects, will be preferred.

**Immediate joiners are preferred.**

title: Sr. Delivery Consultant, Customer Experience, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI-native approaches into every engagement.
  
  
This is a customer-facing delivery leadership role that combines deep technical execution with strategic consulting, pre-sales leadership, and practice development.
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

## Required Qualifications
  
  
### Technical Expertise
  
  

* \*\*10+ years\*\* of hands-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (or equivalent enterprise contact center platforms with 3+ years on Connect)
* \*\*Deep proficiency\*\* in Amazon Connect ecosystem: Contact Flows, Routing Profiles, Contact Lens, Amazon Q in Connect, Lex, Outbound Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, and Customer Profiles
* \*\*Strong software engineering skills\*\* — Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
* \*\*AI/ML competency\*\* — practical experience implementing generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, LLM-based agents, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and conversational AI (Lex, Q in Connect)
* \*\*Integration expertise\*\* — building production integrations with CRM/ITSM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), telephony (SIP/PSTN), and workforce management platforms
* \*\*Architecture at scale\*\* — designing multi-region, multi-tenant, highly available contact center architectures handling 10,000+ concurrent contacts

### Consulting & Leadership
  
  

* \*\*Pre-sales experience\*\* — led or co-led 5+ customer proposals/SOWs including effort estimation, delivery planning, and technical presentations to senior stakeholders
* \*\*Delivery leadership\*\* — managed end-to-end delivery on engagements with 5+ team members, navigating scope changes, customer escalations, and go-live coordination
* \*\*Stakeholder management\*\* — demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with VP/C-level customer stakeholders
* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions

### Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
  
  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)

\* \* \*
  
  
## Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step-by-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking

\* \* \*
  
  
## Working Model
  
  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration

\* \* \*
  
  
## About the Team
  
  
AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
  
  
We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.
  
  
\* \* \*
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Delivery (80%)

Architect and deliver complex Amazon Connect implementations including multi-channel (voice, chat, email, task) contact center solutions for enterprise customers
  
  

* Design end-to-end CX solutions encompassing contact flows, routing strategies, agent workspaces, real-time and historical analytics, workforce management integration, and omnichannel orchestration
* Lead technical delivery on engagements valued at $1M+ — owning architecture decisions, HLD/LLD documentation, implementation patterns, and production go-live
* Build production-grade integrations with CRM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow), backend applications, and third-party platforms using Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, and Step Functions
* Implement AI-powered capabilities including Amazon Q in Connect, Contact Lens, Lex-based conversational AI, generative AI agents, sentiment analysis, real-time transcription, and intelligent routing
* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions multi-agent orchestration, tool-calling frameworks, prompt engineering, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows within the contact center context
* Ensure operational excellence establish monitoring (CloudWatch, Contact Lens), alerting, disaster recovery, and performance optimization for production contact center environments
* Create reusable delivery accelerators CDK constructs, solution patterns, reference architectures, and automation frameworks that reduce future engagement timelines
* Pre-Sales Leadership (10%)
* Lead customer discovery conduct workshops, ideation sessions, and technical deep-dives to understand customer pain points and define CX transformation roadmaps
* Create compelling proposals develop SOWs, technical architectures, effort estimations, and delivery plans for complex Connect engagements
* Present to C-suite and senior stakeholders articulate business value, ROI projections, and differentiated solution approaches during competitive evaluations
* Support pipeline development collaborate with Account Managers, Solutions Architects, and Engagement Managers to identify and qualify opportunities worth $500K–$5M+
* Shape deal strategy define technical win themes, competitive positioning, and phased delivery approaches that de-risk customer commitments
* Practice & Team Leadership (10%)
* Lead and mentor a team of Connect consultants, providing architectural guidance, code reviews, and career development coaching
* Drive capability uplift work with AWS Connect Specialist SAs and Product teams to enable the team on new features (Q in Connect, multi-party calls, outbound campaigns, generative AI integrations)

* Build partnerships collaborate with Connect product teams on feature requests, roadmap influence, and early-access programs; provide field feedback to shape product direction

**About The Team**

companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional

title: Senior Consultant
description:

**Team: Consulting**

**About Us**
**GlobalData is a productivity and intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change.**
By uniting proprietary data, human expertise, and purpose-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organizations see what's coming, move faster, and lead with confidence.
  
  
Our solutions are used by over 5,000 organizations across the world's largest industries, delivering tailored intelligence that supports strategic planning, innovation, risk management, and sustainable growth.

Proprietary coverage of 95% of global GDP, synthesized in real time from internal and external sources, aligned under a single business taxonomy - giving you earlier insight, unified context, and decisions you can trust.
  
  
**Experts Who Turn Insight Into Impact**
Human insights that AI alone can't replicate, from industry specialists and strategic advisors, embedded in your workflows to decode complexity and guide high-value action.
  
  
**AI that moves smarter & faster**
AI that doesn't just think, but acts - forecasting market moves, surfacing answers in seconds, and freeing your teams to focus on execution when timing matters most.
  
  
**Workflow solutions**
Together, our six solutions turn intelligence into action, helping every team make smarter, faster decisions. Each solution focuses on the decisions that matter most, driving measurable impact.
  
  
**Role Overview**
GlobalData’s Consulting Team to strengthen our Data Science team within Consumer Consulting. This is a senior, hands-on role owning quantitative workstreams — market sizing, forecasting and scenario modelling — across custom, strategy-led consulting engagements for clients spanning Consumer, Food & Beverage, Packaging, Retail, Automotive, Agriculture and other verticals. We are looking first for strong general analytical ability, structured thinking and consulting judgement; ability to reason clearly about data and client problems, and to pick up new tools quickly.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**

* 5-8+ of experience in consulting, market research, or a strongly analytical commercial role, with meaningful exposure to data modelling or market sizing work.
* Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, structured spreadsheet design) and clear comfort building or working within a data model.
* Strong general analytical and quantitative reasoning — able to work with imperfect, multi-source data, spot inconsistencies, and defend assumptions.
* Good written and verbal communication skills; able to present findings clearly, including to clients or senior stakeholders.
* Some experience — or clear potential and willingness — to review work and mentor junior consultants or analysts.
* Prior experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) in day-to-day research and modelling work
* Basic familiarity with a dashboarding or data-visualisation tool (Power BI or similar) is helpful
* Exposure to any of Consumer, Foodservice, Packaging, Retail, Automotive or Agriculture sectors is a plus, but not essential — genuine interest in learning a sector matters more than prior coverage of it.

**Good To Have**

* Working knowledge of Python and/or SQL for data manipulation.
* Experience contributing to forecasting models that use macroeconomic or demographic drivers.
* Experience designing primary research instruments (surveys, discussion guides, store audits) or briefing external field agencies.
* Basic ability to read and interpret company financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, annual/quarterly filings).
* Prior exposure to using AI/automation to speed up secondary desk research or report generation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead data modelling workstreams — market sizing, demand forecasting, scenario analysis — primarily in Excel, turning primary and secondary data into clear, defensible, client-ready outputs.
* Shape analytical frameworks and methodology for consulting engagements (sizing logic, driver trees, cross-checks), in partnership with Consulting Directors.
* Contribute to the design and quality review of primary and secondary research — surveys, store audits, desk research — that feeds into models and deliverables.
* Partner with clients and Consulting Directors to interpret findings and translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Review and quality-control the analytical work of consultants and analysts; help set a consistent standard of rigour and structure across the team.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on a workstream basis, developing their modelling and consulting skills.
* Contribute to report writing and deliverable narratives, ensuring outputs are client-ready and consistent with GlobalData's standards.
* Use, and help the team adopt, AI tools and simple automation to speed up desk research and modelling tasks (e.g. summarising industry reports, structuring SKU or pricing data, drafting survey questions) — training and support will be provided to build this up on the job.
* Help translate model outputs into simple dashboards or visual summaries for clients and internal stakeholders, using whatever tools you're comfortable with (Excel, Power BI, or similar).
* Work cross-functionally with other verticals to bring data-science thinking into broader consulting solutions and proposals.

**Commitment To D&I And EEO**
We believe strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, GlobalData is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. GlobalData is determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favorable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

The PSM will collaborate closely with Kore.ai Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Marketing, and partner teams to build pipeline, manage opportunities, and drive joint partner initiatives.

**Partner Relationship Management**

* Ensure partners are informed on Kore.ai solutions, product updates, and value propositions.
* Act as a primary point of contact for day-to-day partner interactions.

**Opportunity Management**

* Coordinate with Account Executives and Sales Engineers to support opportunity progression.
* Track deal status, partner involvement, and next steps to ensure momentum.

**Partner Enablement**

* Support partner enablement initiatives to help partners effectively position Kore.ai solutions.
* Coordinate training sessions, workshops, and enablement activities for partner teams (sales and technical).
* Help partners understand Kore.ai’s platform capabilities and key use cases.

**Support Joint Go-To-Market Execution**

* Work with the marketing team to support joint marketing activities with partners, including:
* Partner events
* Industry webinars
* Field marketing campaigns
* Executive roundtables
* Assist in converting partner engagement into a qualified pipeline.

**Execute Partner Business Plans**

* Support Partner Sales Directors in developing and executing joint partner business plans.
* Track progress against partner objectives across:
* Co-sell pipeline
* Co-marketing initiatives
* Partner enablement milestones
* Maintain reporting and insights on partner performance.

**Internal Coordination**

* Serve as a liaison between partner teams and Kore.ai internal teams including sales, marketing, and product.
* Ensure alignment on account priorities, deal strategy, and partner engagement.
* Provide operational support for partner programs and initiatives.

**REQUIRED EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* A bachelor’s or an MBA from a premier institute would be highly preferred
* 5–7 years of experience in partnerships, enterprise sales support, business development, or partner ecosystem roles within enterprise software, SaaS, AI, or cloud companies.
* Experience working with or supporting partner ecosystems including hyperscalers, system integrators, or channel partners.
* Strong interest in building a career in enterprise partnerships and ecosystem sales.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Partner Relationship Management: Ability to build strong working relationships with partner teams and maintain consistent engagement.
* Pipeline Development: Experience supporting opportunity development and pipeline management.
* Sales Coordination: Strong ability to coordinate cross-functional sales activities across internal and partner teams.
* Partner Enablement: Ability to help partners understand and effectively position enterprise technology solutions.
* Operational Excellence: Highly organised with strong attention to detail in managing opportunities, reporting, and partner programs.

**SUCCESS METRICS**

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Growth in partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline
* Number of qualified opportunities developed with partners
* Effectiveness of partner enablement programs
* Execution of joint partner marketing activities
* Partner engagement and relationship health

**WHY JOIN KORE.AI**

* Work at the forefront of enterprise agentic AI transformation
* Partner with leading technology and consulting firms globally
* Support strategic deals that shape the future of AI-powered enterprise experiences
* A clear path for growth into senior alliance and partner sales leadership roles

title: Lead - Clinical Partnerships
description:
Medvarsity is Asia's largest and fastest growing Health EdTech company and impacts over 60% of all healthcare professionals in the region. We are looking for a dynamic and clinically sound professional to join our Partnerships team and help us scale our academic footprint.

We are a team of high-energy professionals based out of Hyderabad with a shared vision of "Impacting Healthcare through Education". Medvarsity is a combination of multiple product verticals including Medvarsity.com, Dosily.com, BookMySim.one and Healthjobs.one. We believe in constant innovation and strong business fundamentals to drive continuous growth.

We are a rapidly growing company now looking for a Clinical Lead – Hospital Partnerships. This role is ideal for a medical professional looking to transition from clinical to a non-clinical, revenue-focused leadership role. In this position, you will be crucial to scaling up Medvarsity's partnership network by building strong relationships with hospital owners, HODs, and Deans in medical colleges. You must be an astute negotiator capable of collaboratively creating value for both our partners and us. This is a strategic, high-visibility role requiring clinical competency, analytical thinking, and up to 35% travel.

Key Responsibilities

* Scale up Medvarsity's partnership network by initiating, developing, and managing strategic alliances with hospitals and medical colleges.
* Build and maintain robust relationships with key stakeholders including hospital owners, HODs, Deans, and medical directors.
* Drive revenue growth through hospital partnerships, managing commercial outcomes while upholding clinical standards.
* Act as an astute negotiator to structure partnership agreements that collaboratively create measurable value for both the partner and Medvarsity.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution, deployment, and onboarding of partnership initiatives.
* Travel up to 35% of the time for in-person engagements, facility assessments, and partnership negotiations.
* Apply analytical thinking to evaluate partnership performance, track metrics, and identify areas for strategic expansion.

Experience:

* 8-12 years of total experience, with a solid clinical foundation (MBBS or equivalent required; MBA/MHA is a plus).
* Proven interest and aptitude for transitioning from a clinical role to a non-clinical, revenue-focused commercial role.
* Above average communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence senior healthcare leaders.
* Astute negotiation skills with a demonstrated ability to close complex agreements.
* Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to foster long-lasting institutional ties.
* Proven analytical thinking and strategic agility.

Additional Critical Skills

* **Healthcare Ecosystem Expertise:**
  A deep understanding of hospital operations, healthcare regulations, and the continuing medical education (CME) landscape.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Navigating complex institutional hierarchies (trusts, corporate hospitals, academic boards) and aligning diverse interests.
* **Strategic Account Management:**
  Treating partner hospitals as key accounts, managing the entire lifecycle from acquisition to retention and expansion.
* **P&L / Commercial Acumen:**
  Understanding cost structures, ROI, and optimizing margins within educational and hospital partnerships.

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Kruu is a structured experiential learning ecosystem that partners with globally oriented secondary schools to build advanced thinking skills that traditional education often overlooks. Through three-week intensive immersion programs, students tackle real, open-ended problems without predetermined answers, guided by faculty from institutions such as IBM Research, Illinois Tech, AiVancity, and Syracuse University. Each student produces an assessed output—such as a system, strategy, research brief, or designed solution—validated by actual stakeholders. Kruu works with IB World Schools, CBSE, IGCSE institutions, and other internationally accredited programs across India and South Asia, serving as an embedded academic development layer inside serious global schools. The organization was founded in 2022 by Dr. Anil Srinivasan, a Columbia University–trained cognitive neuroscientist and Professor of Practice Fellow at The Aspen Institute.

**Role Description**
The Partnerships Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for building and managing strategic relationships with schools and education partners across India and South Asia. This role includes identifying prospective partner institutions, conducting outreach, and leading end-to-end partnership discussions from initial contact through negotiation and onboarding. The Partnerships Manager will maintain ongoing account relationships, ensure high-quality delivery of Kruu programs, and collaborate with academic and operations teams to align partnership goals with program outcomes. Day-to-day tasks involve developing partnership strategies, tracking performance metrics, preparing proposals and presentations, and representing Kruu at meetings, events, and conferences. The role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders to refine offerings based on partner feedback and to support sustainable, long-term growth of the partnership ecosystem.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Partnerships and Strategic Partnerships skills to identify, build, and grow relationships with schools and educational organizations.
* Account Management capabilities to manage ongoing partner engagements, ensure satisfaction, and drive renewals and expansions.
* Excellent Communication skills for clear, professional interaction with institutional leaders, faculty, and internal teams.
* Robust Analytical Skills to interpret data, evaluate partnership performance, and inform strategy and decision-making.
* Previous experience in business development, institutional partnerships, or sales in education or related sectors is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, education, communications, or a related field; advanced degrees or equivalent experience are an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Hyderabad, travel as needed for partner meetings, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.
* Familiarity with K–12 or secondary school ecosystems, especially IB, CBSE, or international curricula, is a plus.

title: Associate Consultant - ORC Supply Chain Proc-Plan
description:
**Job Description**
Associate Consultant – Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM Functional
  
  
**Job Summary**
An Associate Consultant at Argano is an entry-level position in the consulting family. The individual will work closely with senior functional consultants and project managers on Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementation engagements. The role provides structured progression from supervised project contributions to independent ownership of routine functional activities.
  
  
The Associate Consultant will support the full implementation lifecycle, including business process understanding, requirements documentation, application configuration, data migration, solution documentation, user training, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. The individual is expected to build strong Oracle Cloud SCM functional capability while following Argano delivery methodologies, quality standards, and client commitments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Work on Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementation projects under the guidance of senior functional consultants and project leads.
* Participate in client workshops, requirement discussions, process walkthroughs, solution playback sessions, and project meetings under the guidance of senior functional consultants.
* Assist in documenting requirements, process flows, gaps, decisions, and action items.
* Assist with Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM configuration based on approved business requirements and solution designs.
* Develop functional knowledge in one or more areas such as Procurement, Inventory Management, Product Information Management, Order Management, Manufacturing, Maintenance, Cost Management, Demand Management, Supply Planning, and Global Order Promising.
* Prepare and maintain functional deliverables such as configuration workbooks, requirement traceability matrices, functional design documents, test scripts, user guides, and training materials.
* Support end-to-end business process testing across integrated Oracle Cloud modules.
* Assist with data collection, cleansing, mapping, validation, reconciliation, and migration using Oracle-provided tools such as FBDI and ADFdi, where applicable.
* Work with technical, integration, reporting, and data teams to validate interfaces, reports, extensions, conversions, and workflows.
* Analyze routine functional issues by reviewing setups, transactions, scheduled processes, and application messages; escalate complex issues with clear evidence.
* Support Conference Room Pilots, user training, cutover readiness, deployment, go-live, and hypercare activities.
* Maintain assigned tasks, risks, issues, dependencies, and status updates in project management tools.
* Follow Argano implementation methodology, documentation standards, security requirements, quality controls, and project governance processes.
* Continuously build Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM expertise and complete assigned learning paths and certifications within agreed timelines.

**Minimum And Preferred Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline preferred.

**Experience**

* 0–2 years of relevant experience, including internship experience, in consulting, enterprise applications, supply chain operations, business analysis, or a related area.
* Hands-on exposure during the internship to Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementation activities is strongly preferred for conversion.

Skill Requirements
  
  

* Oracle Cloud SCM: Foundational understanding of Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and supply chain processes such as Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, inventory, product management, manufacturing, and supply/demand planning.
* Functional Analysis: Ability to understand business requirements, document processes, identify routine gaps, and translate requirements into clear functional artifacts with guidance.
* Testing & Issue Resolution: Ability to prepare and execute test scenarios, capture evidence, reproduce issues, and communicate observations clearly.
* Data & Reporting: Basic knowledge of data collection, cleansing, mapping, validation, and reconciliation. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is expected; exposure to FBDI, ADFdi, OTBI, or BI Publisher is advantageous.
* Analytical & Problem Solving: Strong logical and analytical ability, attention to detail, and a structured approach to resolving routine functional problems.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal English communication for collaborating with clients and project teams and preparing professional project documentation.
* Teamwork & Adaptability: Ability to collaborate across functional and technical teams, accept feedback, learn quickly, and adapt to client, project, and industry requirements.
* Ownership & Professionalism: Accountability for assigned deliverables, timelines, quality, confidentiality, and timely escalation of risks or delays.

Certifications, Licenses and Registrations
  
  

* The employee may be expected to complete relevant Oracle Cloud SCM certifications within defined timelines after conversion to FTE.

**About Us**
Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
  
  
Argano is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

* Follows PS implementation standards
* Assesses complex project situations to make appropriate recommendations to both Genesys and the customer
* Initiates and suggests process improvements to Project Managers and other Management to increase efficiencies for delivery of Genesys Cloud solutions

* Flexibility to work across different time zones
* Flexibility to take up a managed services role (managing a customer environment), if there is business need

* IP Telephony & Hardware: Genesys Cloud Edge, Audiocodes, Cisco Gateways, IP Telephones (Polycom, Cisco, etc.)
* Cisco/Juniper/other network routing and switching devices is an added advantage.
* Software: Wireshark, MS Server, DHCP/DNS, MS Hyper-V, VMWare ESXi, MS Visio, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access), Email (MS Outlook)
* Software Development experience in Java and C#.NET, Python, PHP, web application development scripting, tools and methods is a BIG Plus
* Operating Systems: Windows 200/2008/2012R2, XP, Vista, Windows 7
* Knowledge on Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a bonus

**Business Skill:**

* Capable of working on or leading a team through a fast paced and complex project.
* Excellent verbal and written business communication skills (English is a must), including escalation management and information presentation.
* Prior experience in working in a customer-facing role
* Knowledge of customer service processes.
* Knowledge of Cloud change control processes.

**Exercises good judgment:**

* Strong follow-through, ownership & responsibility on tasks assigned.
* Effective time management and maintains flexibility
* Demonstrate flexibility to adjust working hours to match customer and team interactions

**Work Context:**

* Communicates regularly with colleagues and management
* Uses computer frequently
* Occasionally travels to customer and business meeting sites, including international locations
* Valid Passport for international Travel

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Senior architects join us for the depth of the Lead-to-Cash problems and the freedom to shape the solution rather than just govern a slide pack.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* As a Senior Salesforce Solution Architect specialising in Agentforce Revenue Management (ARM) and Revenue Cloud, you will lead the Solution Delivery Lifecycle — translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure and supportable technical designs. You will architect end-to-end Quote-to-Cash solutions and govern the corporate business applications roadmap across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud. The role is deliberately hands-on: you will run design reviews, guide build teams, unblock technical issues and align stakeholders from business sponsors to engineering leads. Your design decisions directly determine how reliably our clients can quote, contract, bill and recognise revenue at scale.

**Requirements:**

* Act as the design authority for end-to-end Quote-to-Cash solutions on Agentforce Revenue Management and Revenue Cloud, covering product and pricing models, guided selling, quoting, ordering, contracts, billing and revenue recognition.
* Lead the Solution Delivery Lifecycle from requirement elaboration through design, build oversight, testing support and deployment, translating complex business processes into scalable technical designs.
* Define and govern the future-state architecture and roadmap for corporate business applications across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, ensuring a coherent platform strategy rather than point solutions.
* Architect ARM-specific capabilities including dynamic pricing waterfalls, order decomposition and orchestration, subscription and usage-based billing, amendments and renewals, and contract lifecycle management.
* Design integration patterns between Salesforce and enterprise ERP, finance, provisioning and data platforms, with clear interface contracts, error handling and reconciliation approaches.
* Chair and contribute to architecture governance forums — conducting design reviews, enforcing architectural standards, security policies, data models and Salesforce best practices, and signing off on technical approaches.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance to delivery teams: reviewing Apex, LWC and configuration, debugging complex defects, performing performance and scalability analysis, and supporting unit and integration testing.
* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners and programme leadership on solution options, trade-offs, effort estimation and presales/solutioning input for new and expanding engagements.

**What You'll Bring — Required**

* 15+ years of total IT experience, with 15+ years of relevant experience on the Salesforce platform in architecture and solution delivery roles.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in the Agentforce Revenue Management (ARM) / Revenue Cloud domain, including product catalogue, pricing, quoting, ordering and billing design.
* Strong background in legacy Salesforce CPQ and Billing, with the ability to assess, migrate and re-architect existing implementations onto Revenue Cloud / ARM.
* Proven end-to-end Quote-to-Cash architecture experience, including order orchestration, subscription and usage-based billing, amendments, renewals and revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 / IFRS 15).
* Solution architecture depth across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, including data modelling, sharing and security, governor limits and large-volume design considerations.
* Hands-on technical capability to review and guide builds in Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow and declarative configuration, alongside integration design using REST/SOAP APIs, events and middleware.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise ERP and finance systems (for example SAP, NetSuite or equivalent) and the ability to define robust integration and reconciliation patterns.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a track record of leading design reviews, architecture governance and executive-level solution discussions.

**What You'll Bring — Preferred**

* Salesforce Architect-level certifications (Application Architect, System Architect, or CTA) and Revenue Cloud / CPQ Specialist credentials.
* Exposure to Agentforce and AI-agent-driven capabilities applied to revenue and service processes.
* MuleSoft or other middleware and iPaaS experience for enterprise integration landscapes.
* Industry domain depth in subscription-heavy sectors such as high-tech, software, telecommunications or manufacturing.
* Presales and estimation experience — solution shaping, effort sizing and proposal support for large transformation programmes.

**Eligibility / Qualification**

* 15+ years of total IT experience with 15+ years relevant Salesforce platform experience, including a minimum of 3 years in Agentforce Revenue Management / Revenue Cloud. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline (B.E. / B.Tech. / M.Tech. / M.S. / MCA) is preferred. Salesforce certifications are strongly preferred; exceptional ARM and Quote-to-Cash architecture depth will be considered alongside certification status.

title: Director - Large Deals (Engineering Services)
description:
**Role Summary**

The Deal Director is a senior sales/business development leader responsible for owning and driving large, complex engineering services deals end to end — from opportunity identification and qualification through solutioning, commercial negotiation, contracting, and successful handover to delivery. The role covers engineering services across sectors including
**Life Sciences, Aerospace, Rail, Mining, Energy, Industrial Products (IP), and Automotive**
, among others. This role requires a rare blend of commercial acumen, cross-sector technical fluency, deal structuring expertise, and executive-level stakeholder management. The Deal Director acts as the deal "quarterback," orchestrating cross-functional teams (solutioning, pricing, legal, delivery, finance) to close high-value, strategically important deals with a
**minimum deal size of $20M TCV**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Deal Origination & Qualification

* **Minimum $20M+ TCV**
  — identify and qualify large deal opportunities within engineering services, working closely with account teams, sales, and marketing.
* Assess strategic fit, win probability, margin potential, and delivery feasibility before committing pursuit resources.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of large deal opportunities across existing accounts and new logos.

2. Deal Strategy & Orchestration

* Own the end-to-end deal pursuit lifecycle: strategy, win-theme development, competitive positioning, and governance.
* Assemble and lead virtual pursuit teams spanning solution architects, delivery leaders, pricing/commercial, legal, and finance.
* Define and drive the pursuit roadmap, milestones, and go/no-go decision gates.
* Lead deal reviews with senior leadership/executive sponsors at key stage gates.

3. Solutioning & Value Proposition

* Partner with technical/solution architects to shape differentiated, delivery-ready engineering services solutions across sectors such as Life Sciences, Aerospace, Rail, Mining, Energy, Industrial Products, and Automotive.
* Translate client business and technical requirements into a compelling, feasible solution and value proposition.
* Ensure solutions balance client needs, win probability, commercial viability, and delivery risk.

4. Commercial Structuring & Negotiation

* Lead commercial modeling, pricing strategy, and deal structuring (fixed price, T&M, outcome-based, managed capacity, etc.).
* Own negotiation of commercial terms, SOWs, MSAs, and contractual frameworks in partnership with legal and finance.
* Optimize deal structure for margin, risk allocation, and long-term account growth potential.

5. Stakeholder & Executive Relationship Management

* Serve as a trusted advisor to client-side executives (CXOs, VP Engineering, procurement) throughout the deal cycle.
* Manage internal executive stakeholders, ensuring alignment, timely decisions, and escalation resolution.
* Build long-term relationships that extend beyond a single deal to support account growth.

6. Deal Closure & Delivery Handover

* Drive deals to signature, managing final negotiations and internal approvals (pricing, legal, risk).
* Ensure a structured, well-documented handover to the delivery organization, including solution assumptions, commercial commitments, and risk registers.
* Support early delivery governance to ensure a smooth transition and client satisfaction.

7. Governance, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

* Maintain accurate, timely pipeline and forecast data in CRM for all large deals under pursuit.
* Report deal status, risks, and financials to senior leadership through regular governance forums.
* Capture lessons learned and contribute to playbooks, templates, and best practices for large deal pursuits.

**Required Qualifications**

* 18+ years of experience in engineering services, technology services, or related industries, with at least 5–7 years focused on large/complex deal pursuits ($20M+ TCV).
* Proven track record of independently closing large, multi-year engineering services deals in one or more of the following sectors: Life Sciences, Aerospace, Rail, Mining, Energy, Industrial Products, Automotive.
* Strong understanding of engineering services delivery models (onshore/offshore, agile, outcome-based, managed teams) as applied across asset-heavy and regulated industries.
* Demonstrated experience in commercial/pricing structuring, contract negotiation, and risk management.
* Excellent executive presence with experience engaging and influencing CXO-level client stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional leadership skills — able to mobilize and align teams without direct authority.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep domain expertise in one or more target sectors — Life Sciences (medical devices, pharma engineering), Aerospace & Defense, Rail & Transportation, Mining & Heavy Industry, Energy & Utilities, Industrial Products, or Automotive.
* Familiarity with deal governance frameworks and structured bid/pursuit methodologies (e.g., Shipley, Miller Heiman, or internal equivalents).
* Experience with global delivery models and offshore/onshore team structuring.
* Exposure to legal/contracting frameworks (MSA, SOW, SLAs) in a services context.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Deal strategy and orchestration
* Commercial and financial acumen (pricing, margin modeling, TCV/ACV)
* Technical fluency across engineering services domains
* Executive stakeholder management and negotiation
* Cross-functional leadership and influence
* Risk assessment and mitigation
* Storytelling and executive-level presentation skills

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Total Contract Value (TCV) of deals won
* Win rate on qualified large-deal pursuits
* Deal cycle time (from qualification to signature)
* Margin/profitability of closed deals vs. target
* Quality of delivery handover (client satisfaction post-transition)
* Pipeline health and forecast accuracy

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Flow
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About Flow by ServiceNow**
Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We’re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You’ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are.
  
  
Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us.
  
  
****Job Description****
We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support.
  
  
Ready to be the person who turns “we’re stuck” into “we’re live”? We’re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next.
  
  
****What You Will Do****
**Technical Solutions**

* Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow.
* Build, test, and launch automations with Flow’s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow.
* Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers.
* Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery.
* Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations.

**Customer Success and Adoption**

* Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day.
* Monitor usage, conversation allowances, and automation results in Flow analytics, using the data to demonstrate value and identify new automation opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to expand Flow from an initial use case into a broader self-service service desk.
* Translate customer pain points and requests into clear product requirements, then partner with product and engineering to refine and shepherd them through delivery.

**Support and Reliability**

* Own first-line triage for trial and enterprise customers, answering technical questions and escalating issues when deeper product or engineering support is needed.
* Be the go-to person when customers encounter API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, or failed automations, and drive issues from initial diagnosis through resolution.
* Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them.
* Monitor health, audit, and activity logs to identify outages or issues that prevent customers from using Flow fully.
* Use Flow audit and activity logs to diagnose complex customer issues, confirm what happened, and drive the issue to resolution.

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with comfort testing them using tools such as Postman or cURL.
* Working knowledge of single sign-on and identity providers, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID.
* Experience with enterprise service management or collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams.
* Familiarity with AI and workflow automation, including prompt design and how AI systems retrieve information from documents.
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders from IT directors to system administrators and security engineers.
* See how Flow fits into a customer’s broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow’s plans.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of customer outcomes while partnering effectively across product, engineering, support, and customer teams.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Experience with service desk offerings.
* Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products.
* Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software.
* Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required.

Additional Information

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Sales Operations Technologist Manager to lead the design and implementation of scalable Sales Operations solutions across CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, and AI platforms. This role combines deep Sales Operations domain expertise with solution architecture, systems integration, automation, delivery leadership, and practical application of Agentic AI.

The Manager will lead client engagements, shape solution strategies, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to the growth of our Sales Operations and commercial technology capabilities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
As a Manager, you will lead multidisciplinary teams and work directly with client executives, commercial leaders, business stakeholders, IT organizations, data teams, and technology partners to deliver measurable business outcomes. You will be responsible for shaping solutions from strategy and discovery through design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.
  
  
You will lead and oversee work across the following areas:
  
  

* Translate Sales Operations requirements into scalable solutions supporting territory and account alignment, segmentation and targeting, quota and incentive planning, sales forecasting, pipeline and opportunity management, account planning, field productivity, pricing and quoting, approvals, and commercial performance reporting.
* Define enterprise solution architectures and delivery approaches integrating CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, workflow, and AI platforms.
* Lead implementations and solution delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and other enterprise applications.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, APIs, data models, workflows, accelerators, and delivery standards that can be deployed across client environments.
* Identify, prioritize, and oversee practical Agentic AI use cases, including sales planning assistants, forecasting and pipeline analysis agents, next-best-action recommendations, account and territory intelligence, automated opportunity and CRM hygiene, quoting and approval support, and sales performance insights.
* Define and oversee human-in-the-loop controls, access controls, auditability, evaluation criteria, monitoring, and escalation paths for AI-enabled solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops, process assessments, design sessions, demonstrations, executive discussions, testing, deployment planning, and adoption activities.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives and key stakeholders, facilitate difficult decisions, manage expectations, and communicate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly.
* Manage delivery quality, scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and financial performance across workstreams or engagements.
* Coach and develop consultants and senior consultants through structured feedback, hands-on leadership, and opportunities to expand their domain and technology expertise.
* Establish solution roadmaps, implementation plans, operating models, adoption strategies, governance approaches, and measurable value cases.
* Support and lead pre-sales activities, including account planning, proposals, statements of work, solution demonstrations, estimates, client presentations, and pursuit strategy.
* Contribute to market eminence, intellectual capital, reusable assets, accelerators, and offerings that strengthen our Sales Operations and commercial technology portfolio.
* Ensure solutions reflect life sciences-specific requirements related to HCP/HCO data, field force structures, regulatory expectations, data privacy, commercial compliance, and data governance.

**The team:**
Step into our
**Sales & Service**
team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 10+ years of consulting or industry experience, including significant experience leading Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, CRM, CPQ, business transformation, or technology implementation initiatives.
* Experience leading end-to-end client engagements or major workstreams, including delivery planning, team leadership, quality management, risk management, and executive communication.
* Strong understanding of Sales Operations processes and performance drivers, including territory and account alignment, segmentation, targeting, quota and incentive planning, forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, pricing, quoting, approvals, and performance reporting.
* Experience implementing or integrating two or more CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, or analytics platforms.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data integration, workflow automation, enterprise solution architecture, and delivery governance.
* Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, AI orchestration, or related enterprise AI patterns.
* Ability to convert business requirements into solution strategies, functional designs, technical specifications, implementation plans, roadmaps, and value cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead workshops, influence senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve issues, and make sound delivery decisions.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing consulting or technology delivery teams
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare commercial operations.
* Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, SAP CPQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and low-code/no-code automation platforms.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent monitoring, responsible AI practices, and enterprise controls.
* Consulting, systems integration, product management, enterprise architecture, or operating model design experience.
* Experience developing proposals, estimates, solution demonstrations, reusable assets, or market-facing points of view.
* Relevant Salesforce, Veeva, CPQ, cloud, data, architecture, or AI certifications.

**Success Measures**
Success in this role will be measured by:
  
  

* Delivery of high-quality Sales Operations solutions that achieve agreed client outcomes, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Adoption, usability, and sustained business value of implemented solutions.
* Reduction in manual processes, disconnected workflows, and operational friction.
* Improved CRM, Sales Operations, and commercial data quality.
* Faster planning, forecasting, quoting, approval, and decision-making cycles.
* Reusability and scalability of solution components across platforms, business units, and clients.
* Demonstrated business value from AI-enabled capabilities with appropriate controls and monitoring.
* Effective management of data privacy, compliance, security, delivery, and operational risks.

title: FGBS ACES Sr CI Expert, FGBS ACES
description:
**Description**
At Amazon we strive to be Earth’s most customer obsessed company. Our passion for invention leads us to continually pioneer and globalize new businesses and customer offerings. As a result, Amazon continues to grow and evolve across many different business lines.
  
  
In supporting this growth and evolution, Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) goal is to deliver seamless procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, and payroll processes that enable geographic and market expansion across all Amazon’s businesses, from Retail, Digital, and Advertising through to AWS and Logistics, while ensuring regulatory and legal compliance. As part of this growth, we now seek a Customer Obsessed, Results Driven Sr Business Development Expert for our Amazon Customer Excellence Services (ACES) team within Finance Global Business Services (FGBS).
  
  
The ACES Business Development team is a project discovery task force that specializes in linking business strategy to opportunity identification and project selection. We believe the future of successful project management involves doing the right projects — not just doing projects right. That means making excellent decisions about which opportunities should become projects. The business development strategy uses a combination of voice of the customer, voice of the business, voice of the employee, and voice of the process to capture improvement opportunities in complex interdependent business functions.
  
  
This role leads the identification, quantification, and definition of project opportunities between FGBS verticals and FGBS ACES Black Belts. You will apply a mixture of qualitative, quantitative, networking, and leadership skills to drive a culture of exploration, opportunity creation, and continuous improvement. The program strategy is defined, but the business problem and solution may not be. You deliver independently, seeking direction on strategic priorities.
  
  
You will leverage AI as a force multiplier across the entire business development lifecycle — from AI-powered data mining and predictive opportunity identification, to automated process analysis and intelligent stakeholder engagement. You do not simply use AI; you deliver business development differently because of it.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Will Span The Following Core Dimensions**
Strategic Opportunity Identification & AI-Augmented Discovery
  
  
Lead project discovery and define phases of high-impact Lean Six Sigma projects (DMAIC, DFSS, Kaizen, FMEA, etc.), partnering with FGBS business teams to identify opportunities related to cost saving, revenue leakage, and efficiencies.
  
  
Leverage AI tools to accelerate and enhance opportunity identification — using AI-powered data mining, predictive analytics, and automated process analysis to identify patterns and opportunities that manual analysis would miss.
  
  
Manage a portfolio of improvement projects, including auditing of transitioned projects to ensure that process improvements are sustained and benefits are realized.
  
  
Develop quantitative and qualitative process maps to describe how various people and teams within a business are involved in a process, objectively evaluating process workflows to understand the current state.
  
  
Discover and assess automation initiatives, regulatory compliance opportunities, and other critical business decisions.
  
  
Cross-Organizational Partnerships & Influence
  
  
Develop cross-organizational partnerships to drive identification, quantification, and definition of project opportunities between FGBS verticals and FGBS ACES Black Belts.
  
  
Work closely with FGBS and corporate partners (Finance, Accounting, Legal, HR, Facilities, Safety, IT, Customer Service) to secure support and resources for savings opportunities.
  
  
Represent FGBS ACES in local and global meetings/conference calls and with network-wide projects.
  
  
Influence customers, roadmap priorities, and decisions across multiple teams.
  
  
Data Analytics & Quantification
  
  
Conduct advanced data mining to conclude if defects will lead to excessive costs, reduced revenue/GMS, or increased audit/controllership risks.
  
  
Read and transform organizational data to evaluate process details, prioritize fixes, and continually track workflows.
  
  
Leverage AI to automate data extraction, pattern recognition, and predictive modelling for opportunity assessment.
  
  
Provide periodic updates to senior management, including opportunity pipeline metrics, impact projections, and strategic recommendations for project selection.
  
  
Training & Development
  
  
Mentor team members on business development methodology, data analytics, and AI-augmented discovery approaches.
  
  
Coach new team members on Lean, Six Sigma, and project management fundamentals.
  
  
Promote a culture of exploration, opportunity creation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Share business development best practices and AI-augmented approaches across the ACES community.
  
  
Communication & Influence
  
  
Contribute to team and organization documents (e.g., opportunity assessments, project charters, MBR/QBR, roadmaps).
  
  
Translate complex data sets into actionable strategies and compelling narratives for stakeholders.
  
  
Influence managers and peer teams without authority, driving alignment on project selection and prioritization.
  
  
Communicate effectively across an increasing diversity of business and technical audiences.
  
  
A day in the life

description:
**Role overview and responsibilities:**

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. **Job Category**
Professional

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
The Key Account Manager – Immunology is a target-carrying account owner responsible for launching and scaling the Tremfya franchise (PSO, PsA / psoriatic disease and the emerging IBD opportunity) across government / institutional reimbursed accounts. The role follows a focused launch-and-scale model: establish IL-23 leadership in high-readiness accounts, convert accessible patient pools into treated and continued patients.
  
  
Central access creation (Rate Contracts, registrations, listings, GTE and tenders) is owned by the Central Account Team; the incumbent facilitates that access at account level and converts it into procurement and reimbursed sales. Launch priority accounts are Army, CGHS and Railways, expanding to ESI, States, Autonomous institutes and PSU as the business scales. The unifying discipline is: Map deeply → Facilitate access → Shape protocol & biologic sequencing → Identify opportunity pool.
  
  
**Major Duties & Responsibilities**
In order of importance, briefly describe, in sentence form, the major responsibilities of this position as it exists today. Describe the job, not the person in the job. Each item should be a major responsibility, not a day-to-day activity. Typically no more than seven or eight major responsibilities ranked in order of highest percentage time to least.
  
  
**Approximate**
**Major Duties / Responsibilities**
Reimbursed Business Delivery & Tremfya Commercial Ownership
  
  

* Accountable for achieving Tremfya reimbursed sales targets (PSO, PsA and IBD SKUs) in assigned accounts, in line with the RB incentive plan
* Own the account outcome: grow account budget share and drive quarter-on-quarter reimbursed growth.
* Ensure accurate demand forecasting, order fulfilment coordination and timely account receivables in partnership with the Value and Supply teams.
* Map each account end-to-end — PsD / IBD patient pool, treating specialists, formulary and access status — and build a prioritized 360° launch account plan.
* Apply account-archetype logic: Army (early adoption / biologic leadership), CGHS (referral roadmap + formulary), Railways (scalable platform), ESI (future pathway), Autonomous / State (setting pathway and discussions for Franchise (Product promotion) & Medical Team for advocacy & protocol inclusion)

Facilitate Access & Navigate Reimbursement Pathways
  
  

* Facilitate the Value Team’s central access (Army RC, CGHS listing, Railway AMI/registration, GTE inclusion) at account level via account intelligence, documentation and ground follow-up — the KAM facilitates and utilises access.
* Navigate account-specific approval and procurement processes (e.g., Army MMF / PVMS, CGHS STC / non-STC, local-purchase routes) to minimise access-to-treatment timelines.

Value, Influence, Stakeholder Orchestration & Compliance
  
  

* Deliver the differential IL-23 value proposition vs IL-17 / anti-TNF competition, engage KOLs and government decision networks, and build advocacy for formulary and protocol inclusion .
* Act as cross-functional ‘quarterback’ across Medical, Franchise and Value; ensure ethical, compliant engagement and adherence to SOPs on tender interactions and HCC.

**Quality, Regulatory & Compliance (QRC) Responsibilities**
Describe important QRC responsibilities applicable for this job.
  
  

* Ensure all account and commercial activities comply with the J&J Credo, Health Care Compliance (HCC) policies, anti-bribery / anti-corruption standards and applicable local regulations.
* Adhere to SOPs on tender management, sales-achievement documentation, interactions with government officials and pharmacovigilance / adverse-event reporting requirements.

**Key Performance Indicators**
Primary measures of success for this position.
  
  

* Tremfya reimbursed business growth % and target achievement (PSO, PsA, IBD SKUs) vs. plan and vs. the incentive threshold.
* PsD / IBD accessible-pool conversion: eligible → treated patients, and account budget-share growth.
* New patient starts and patient continuation / persistence rates on Tremfya.
* Biologic-adoption progress: protocol inclusion, IL-23 share vs IL-17 / anti-TNF, and Stelara-to-Tremfya IBD upgradation.
* Access utilisation of Value-Team-secured RCs, listings and formulary inclusions (facilitation, not ownership).
* Quality of launch account plans, forecasting accuracy and KOL / stakeholder engagement.

**Functional Competencies**
Competencies (skills, knowledge and attributes) required to perform the job.
  
  

* Commercial / Target Delivery & Selling
* Biologic Adoption & Scientific Selling
* Strategic Account Management
* Access & Reimbursement Pathway Navigation
* Market & Policy Knowledge and Compliance
* Financial Acumen & Forecasting

**Behavioural Competencies**
Behavioural and leadership competencies required to perform the job (Leadership Imperatives).
  
  

* Collaboration and Partnering
* Influence and Impact
* Decision Making
* Customer & Patient Insights
* Change Management
* Ethical Conduct

**Key Working Relationships**
The most important working relationships inside and outside the company.
  
  
Internal
  
  
Value Team, Immunology Franchise, Medical Affairs (MAF), Market Access, Supply Chain, HCC and Finance teams.
  
  
External
  
  
Dermatologists, rheumatologists, gastroenterologists, KOLs, institutional decision-makers, government / scheme authorities, empanelled hospitals, distributors and service providers.
