title: SLIMS Technical Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic, and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications, and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek - so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com.
  
  
**OpenLab Sync (formerly SLIMS)**
is a platform that allows supervision of all stages a sample follows to the result.
**OpenLab Sync**
captures information about the sample, requests for measurements, and follows its entire workflow through the lab, supervising manual operating procedures, automated instrument steps, and calculations until the final report.
  
  
If you decide to join our team, you will be working closely with our clients. The tasks to be performed are multifaceted, and a creative mind is needed to be able to identify and implement customer solutions and improve the quality of life in the lab environment. Want to learn more about OpenLab Sync? Visit OpenLab Sync for more information and even some videos.
  
  
This role is ideal for candidates who combine hands-on laboratory experience with technical software implementation skills. Successful candidates typically have experience working in laboratory informatics, scientific software, LIMS, ELN, LES, or laboratory automation environments.
  
  
As an
**Application Engineer**
part of the Customer Success team in India, you will support our valued customers across our Lab informatics product solutions. This role offers you the opportunity to travel and explore a variety of labs, so it is vital to have an appetite for continuously learning about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. In addition, applying communication skills, creativity, and a can-do approach is vital.
  
  
**Your main responsibilities will be:**

* Analyze customers' needs and translate them into OpenLab Sync workflows
* Configure the OpenLab Sync platform to match the lab's requirements
* Build plugins for connecting instruments or displaying custom forms or portals
* Act as the customer voice to influence future product design to meet customer needs
* Script a lab's in-silico tools into our integration framework

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has a keen interest in Lab Informatics and is seeking a new challenge. A curious individual who is driven to learn and has the desire to understand and solve customer problems to deliver customer success will succeed in this position.
  
  
**Qualifications**
We are looking for motivated individuals with the following background:
  
  

* University Degree in Life Sciences, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Scientific Informatics, or a related discipline (or alternatively solid relevant experience in this application engineering field)
* Hands-on laboratory experience in analytical chemistry, biobanks, pharma, biopharma, genomics, NGS, Academia, etc.
* Preferred experience with LIMS, ELN, LES, SDMS, CDS, laboratory automation, scientific software, or laboratory workflow management systems.
* You have knowledge of programming languages such as Java or Python with proven coding skills
* Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, laboratory users, or cross-functional project teams is highly desirable.
* Full proficiency in English.

On a personal level, you possess great
**problem solving**
/
**analytical skills, and**
you are
**eager to learn**
about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. You have
**communication/interpersonal skills**
to interact at various levels, and you strive to provide excellent customer support. You enjoy both
**working within a team**
and
**autonomously**
.
  
  
We will make sure
**you get all the training and development opportunities you need to become the best in your field!**
**Additional Details**
This job has a full time weekly schedule.
  
  
Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

50% of the Time

Day

No End Date

Services & Support

description:

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. You will be a key contributor in planning and building Engineering Excellence deliverables, and ensuring the smooth and successful execution of initiatives by coordinating with cross-functional teams. * Engaging with Technology, Business stakeholders and Senior Leadership to drive product roadmap, define the priorities and deliver products with best quality for a high scale use.

* Innovation and Research: Stay updated on emerging technologies, assess their relevance to the business, and propose innovative solutions.
* Vendor and Partner Management: Evaluate and manage relationships with technology vendors and partners to ensure they support the organization's strategic objectives.
* Work closely with process experts to analyze and design solutions based on business requirements.

**What We’re Looking For...**
You get excited by the possibilities that technology creates and how it can improve people’s lives. Applying your analytical skills and expertise to solve complex problems is personally rewarding. No stranger to working in a fast-paced environment, you convey a sense of urgency and balance multiple opposing priorities with ease, never missing a deadline.
  
  
**You’ll Need To Have**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in one or more of Data Science, LLM, Gen AI
* Master’s degree from an accredited college or university preferred
* Established experience delivering information management solutions to large numbers of end users
* Development and testing of Generative AI solution both through Agentic and non-AgenticAI
* Deep understanding of frameworks like LangGraph, AutoGen, LangSmith

* Identify new process opportunities, while quickly assessing feasibility.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills able to effectively communicate technical details to a non-technical audience.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:
  
  

* Familiarity with Graph DB Concepts
* Familiarity with one or more Data Platforms - CloudEra, Snowflake, DataBricks etc.

40

title: Growth Manager
description:
**About Turium AI**

**Turium AI is an enterprise technology company building next-generation AI-powered business platforms designed to transform how organisations operate, automate and make decisions.**

**Our flagship ERP platform, Turium Orbit**
, brings together enterprise financial management, procurement, human capital management, asset management, budgeting and intelligent automation in a unified ecosystem.

We are expanding our global sales operations and seeking an ambitious, commercially driven Growth Managerr based in Hyderabad to accelerate international growth.

**The Opportunity**

**We are looking for a high-performing enterprise software sales professional with proven experience selling ERP solutions to medium and large enterprises across international markets.**

**The ideal candidate understands the global ERP landscape, has experience competing with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Workday or similar enterprise platforms, and can independently build pipelines, engage C-level decision-makers and close complex enterprise deals.**

**This is a revenue-generating, hands-on sales leadership role, not a sales coordination or account support position.**

**You will take ownership of international ERP sales opportunities, from prospect identification through commercial negotiations and contract closure.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Global ERP Sales & Revenue Growth**

* Drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth for Turium Orbit across international markets.
* Develop and execute territory-specific enterprise sales strategies.
* Own the complete B2B enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through proposals, negotiations and closure.
* Build a strong pipeline of qualified enterprise ERP opportunities.
* Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales and revenue targets.
* Identify ERP replacement, legacy modernisation and digital transformation opportunities.

2. Enterprise Customer Acquisition

* Engage CIOs, CFOs, CTOs, CHROs, Procurement Directors and other senior executives.
* Position Turium Orbit as a modern alternative to traditional ERP platforms.
* Conduct discovery meetings, executive presentations, product demonstrations and commercial negotiations.
* Develop strategic relationships with large enterprises, multinational organisations and government agencies.
* Navigate complex buying processes involving procurement, finance, IT, security and executive stakeholders.

3. ERP Solution Selling

* Sell enterprise solutions across:Finance, General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable
* Procurement, Purchase-to-Pay and Contract Management
* Human Capital Management, HR and Payroll
* Budgeting, Forecasting and Financial Planning
* Enterprise Asset Management
* AI-powered workflow automation, reporting and analytics
* Understand customer business processes and translate requirements into compelling ERP value propositions.
* Work closely with solution architects, presales consultants and product teams to deliver demonstrations and proposals.
* Develop business cases, ROI models and competitive positioning against established ERP vendors.

4. Global Partnerships & Market Expansion

* Identify and establish relationships with system integrators, consulting firms, technology partners and channel distributors.
* Develop ERP sales opportunities through strategic alliances and referral partnerships.
* Support entry into new international markets and industry verticals.
* Build relationships with enterprise transformation consultants and influential technology decision-makers.

5. Sales Operations & Execution

* Maintain accurate opportunity pipelines, revenue forecasts and CRM records.
* Prepare proposals, responses to RFPs/RFIs and commercial presentations.
* Collaborate with marketing to execute outbound campaigns, account-based marketing and lead-generation programs.
* Track competitors, market developments and customer purchasing trends.
* Report sales performance, pipeline conversion, strategic accounts and revenue forecasts to executive leadership.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 8–15+ years of B2B enterprise software sales experience, including at least 5 years in ERP or major enterprise applications.
* Demonstrated success selling ERP solutions such as
  **SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Workday, NetSuite, Infor or comparable platforms**
  .
* Proven experience selling to customers outside India, preferably across Australia, North America, Europe or the Middle East.
* Strong track record of achieving sales quotas and closing high-value enterprise software contracts.
* Experience managing long, complex enterprise sales cycles and multiple decision-makers.
* Ability to communicate effectively with C-level executives.
* Strong commercial acumen, negotiation capabilities and understanding of SaaS, subscription licensing and enterprise software contracts.
* Experience using CRM platforms and structured sales methodologies.
* Excellent written and spoken English, presentation skills and executive communication.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, Finance or a related field. MBA desirable.

**Preferred Experience**

* Existing relationships with international enterprise customers or ERP partner ecosystems.
* Experience selling into government, public sector, financial services, manufacturing or large corporate environments.
* Proven success positioning emerging ERP products against established global vendors.
* Familiarity with AI-driven ERP, business process automation and cloud enterprise applications.
* Experience building a new territory or scaling international enterprise software revenue from India.
* Understanding of ERP implementation, migration, integration and transformation programs.

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 90 Days**

* Develop a global target-account strategy and territory sales plan.
* Build a qualified pipeline of enterprise prospects.
* Establish executive-level conversations with prospective customers and partners.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of Turium Orbit and its competitive positioning.

**First 6–12 Months**

* Convert qualified opportunities into contracted customers.
* Develop a predictable international sales pipeline.
* Establish strategic channel and enterprise partnerships.
* Consistently deliver against agreed revenue and sales performance targets.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build the global sales business for a next-generation AI-powered ERP platform.
* Direct engagement with founders and executive leadership.
* Exposure to international enterprise and government markets.
* Ownership of major enterprise sales opportunities and market expansion.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked sales incentives.
* High-growth technology environment with significant career progression opportunities.

**Work Location & Expectations**

**This is a full-time, office-based position in Hyderabad, India**
.

The successful candidate must be comfortable working across international time zones, engaging directly with global customers and travelling internationally when required.

We are looking for a self-driven professional who thrives in an ambitious, performance-oriented environment and takes accountability for generating revenue.

* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)

* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high pressure environment

title: Chemistry account manager
description:
**Company Description**
Waters India Pvt. Limited is part of the global Waters Corporation, a leader in analytical instruments, chemistry, and software solutions for laboratories across pharmaceuticals, life sciences, food and environmental testing, and other industries. The company focuses on helping customers improve scientific outcomes through robust technologies, application expertise, and reliable service. Teams at Waters India collaborate closely with clients to optimize workflows, enhance data quality, and meet regulatory requirements. The organization emphasizes continuous learning, ethical business practices, and customer-centric innovation. Working at Waters India offers exposure to advanced laboratory technologies and the opportunity to contribute to impactful scientific and industrial applications.

**Role Description**
The Chemistry Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with customers using Waters chemistry products and solutions in and around Hyderabad. This full-time, on-site role involves engaging with laboratories and organizations to understand their analytical needs, recommend suitable chemistry and consumable solutions, and support them in achieving optimal performance from Waters systems. Day-to-day activities include visiting customer sites, conducting product presentations and demonstrations, coordinating technical discussions with internal application specialists, and preparing proposals and quotations. The role also includes tracking opportunities, managing the sales pipeline, negotiating commercial terms within company guidelines, and ensuring timely order closure. The Chemistry Account Manager collaborates with service, applications, and marketing teams to support installations, training, and ongoing customer satisfaction while maintaining accurate records in the CRM system and reporting market trends to management.

**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry, chromatography (e.g., HPLC, UPLC), and laboratory workflows; ability to understand and discuss technical applications with customers.
* Proven account management or technical sales experience in scientific instruments, reagents, or laboratory consumables; ability to manage a sales territory and meet targets.
* Skilled in customer relationship building, stakeholder management, and consultative selling; comfortable interacting with laboratory staff, scientists, and decision-makers.
* Competence in using CRM tools, MS Office, and digital communication platforms; ability to prepare clear proposals, reports, and presentations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; strong presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently in the field, plan visits, and prioritize opportunities; strong time management and problem-solving capabilities.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
* Prior experience in the Hyderabad or broader regional market and familiarity with pharmaceutical, biotech, or analytical testing industries is an advantage.

* Support cost-performance trade-offs and optimization
* Work with procurement for cost benchmarking

* Strong experience in electrical design of transformers (400kV+)

* Knowledge of IEC, ANSI/IEEE standards

****Engineering Awareness****

* Basic understanding of mechanical constraints and layout
* Basic understanding of control systems and interfaces

****Professional Competencies****

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to think beyond conventional solutions
* Effective communication and collaboration
* High ownership and execution focus

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 3 years and above in transformer electrical design

An electrical design expert who combines strong theory, deep calculations, commercial awareness, and execution capability.

title: Technical Enablement Specialist
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a technically strong and business-oriented
**Technical Enablement Specialist**
with experience in Graph Database technologies, Data Engineering, and technical product enablement.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of graph database concepts, data modeling, query development, database architecture, and technical troubleshooting. Experience with platforms such as
**Neo4j**
,
**TigerGraph**
,
**AWS Neptune**
, or other graph database technologies is highly preferred.
  
  
In this role, you will develop deep expertise in the TigerGraph platform—understanding its architecture, functionalities, product capabilities, and new feature releases—and translate this knowledge into effective technical and business-oriented training programs. You will work closely with Sales, Presales, Product, Engineering, Delivery, Developers, and Clients to enable stakeholders to understand, position, implement, and leverage TigerGraph solutions effectively.
  
  
We seek someone who seamlessly combines hands-on technical expertise with strong communication, presentation skills, stakeholder management, and business acumen.
  
  
**Requirements**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Graph Database & Technical Expertise
  
  

* Graph & Data Engineering: Demonstrate a strong understanding of graph database concepts, architecture, data modeling, graph traversal, and graph analytics using technologies like Neo4j, TigerGraph, or AWS Neptune.
* Query & Performance Optimization: Utilize query languages (e.g., GSQL, Cypher, Gremlin) while demonstrating a strong grasp of database performance, query optimization, data integration, and distributed systems.
* TigerGraph Mastery: Develop hands-on expertise in TigerGraph products, architecture, capabilities, and ecosystems. Analyze new product releases and updates to translate them into practical learning modules.
* Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis: Independently investigate, troubleshoot, and identify root causes for technical issues, performance bottlenecks, query failures, and configuration challenges in graph implementations.
* Product & Engineering Collaboration: Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to understand technical defects, enhancements, and product behaviors.
* Documentation & Knowledge Base: Create technical FAQs, troubleshooting guides, knowledge repositories, and best-practice documentation.

Technical Training & Enablement
  
  

* Program Design & Delivery: Design, develop, and deliver structured technical training programs, workshops, product demonstrations, and hands-on technical bootcamps on TigerGraph products and graph technologies.
* Multi-Stakeholder Enablement: Tailor enablement programs for diverse internal and external groups:

+ Sales & Presales: Product capabilities, business value, competitive positioning, use cases, and solution demos.
+ Product Teams: Product architecture, new features, functionality, enhancements, and technical dependencies.
+ Developers & Engineering: Graph modeling, query development, implementation, debugging, integrations, and best practices.
+ Clients & External Stakeholders: Product onboarding, solution understanding, technical adoption, and implementation guidance.

* Content & Assessment Creation: Develop engaging training presentations, technical documentation, practical assignments, hands-on lab environments, assessments, and product demo materials.
* Gap Analysis: Continuously evaluate training effectiveness and identify capability gaps across teams to refine enablement strategies.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

**Drive Now on Now GTM execution and field activation**

**Create demand for Now on Now engagements**

**Build and activate a strong practitioner and executive community**

**Translate ServiceNow’s Customer Zero experience into compelling customer stories**

**Partner with Digital Technology and solution teams**

**Orchestrate high-impact customer engagements**

**Develop reusable GTM assets and enablement**

**Use engagement and customer-demand data to identify trends and opportunities**
, including emerging solution areas, customer priorities, practitioner demand, and opportunities to scale successful engagement patterns.
  
  
**Track and communicate the business impact of Now on Now**
, developing dashboards and executive insights around engagement volume, customer demand, practitioner activation, strategic account penetration, and influenced business outcomes.
  
  
**Continuously improve the Now on Now engagement model**
, removing friction, simplifying how field teams access Customer Zero expertise, and developing scalable approaches that increase the program's reach and impact.

**GTM Expertise:**
Demonstrated experience developing and executing programs that connect product capabilities, customer needs, and field sales motions.

**Storytelling:**
Strong ability to translate complex technology and transformation initiatives into clear, compelling business narratives appropriate for executive and customer audiences.
  
  
**Cross-functional Leadership:**

**AI & Enterprise Technology:**

**Analytical Skills:**
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with experience using engagement, customer, and business data to identify trends, prioritize opportunities, and measure program impact.
  
  
**Communication:**
Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with audiences ranging from practitioners to senior executives.
  
  
**Adaptability:**
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities, technology, and customer needs evolve quickly.
  
  
**Education:**
Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. MBA or advanced degree preferred.

title: Program Director
description:
**The Experience**

As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior individual contributor and a foremost expert in delivering intended business value. This is a fully-billable, high-impact role deployed as a Delivery Leader to our strategic and complex customer engagements.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end success of programs, with a primary focus on maximizing platform adoption, demonstrating ROI, and mitigating revenue or license attrition risk. You will ensure that emerging capabilities, including agentic and generative AI programs, are delivered on time, within budget, and with a strict focus on quantifiable business outcomes.

You will act as the key strategic advisor and point of accountability, building trust with executive stakeholders and ensuring the customer's long-term success on the platform.

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Program Accountability: Assume ultimate accountability for establishing, executing and overseeing program governance to deliver strategic value-realization and recovery plans for strategic customer accounts, ensuring clear governance frameworks for complex multi-cloud and enterprise AI implementation roadmaps.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Engage directly with C-level stakeholders to build trust, define success metrics, and demonstrate measurable platform ROI. You will lead all executive stakeholder forums, like Steering Committees, focusing heavily on Performance Evaluation & ROI to help customers quantify the financial and operational business value of their AI investments.
* Strategic Advisory: Serve as the primary, billable expert providing strategic oversight to ensure program delivery aligns with the customer's core business objectives.
* Risk & Scope Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage program risks, dependencies, and scope changes. You will own the executive-level escalation process and translate complex technical issues—such as AI compliance, data readiness, and security boundaries—into clear business implications.
* Commercial Acumen: Lead and support pre-sales teams in initial scoping, change management, and identifying opportunities for expansion of the running program, accurately sizing the organizational change management and delivery effort required for generative AI and digital agent rollouts.
* Delivery Governance: Define, structure, and oversee complex engagement models (e.g., T&M, Fixed Price), ensuring all delivery commitments, milestones, and scope are meticulously managed. You will champion an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology from a management perspective, tracking program health, team velocity, and delivery efficiency.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Provide expert guidance and strategic direction to customer, partner (SI), and internal teams (e.g., MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs) to ensure cohesive and successful program outcomes.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a deep subject matter expert on the platform, including new products, industry trends, and best-practice implementation strategies involving custom development, integration, and data migration.
* Contract Management: Prior experience in understanding and working with MSA/SOW and ensuring delivery is compliant to the terms laid out there.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience: 15+ years of experience, predominantly in consulting or strategic advisory roles, managing large-scale, complex SaaS/CRM program implementations.
* Platform Expertise: Deep expertise in the platform and ecosystem, including common implementation patterns, integration challenges, custom development, and data migration strategies, and foundational understanding of Agentforce use cases and data cloud dependencies.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to build C-level relationships, navigate difficult conversations, and negotiate high-stakes outcomes.
* Account Recovery: Proven experience in strategic account recovery, risk mitigation, and driving platform adoption in complex, at-risk customer environments.
* Cross-cultural experience: Must have prior experience working in a multi-cultural environment with teams and stakeholders geographically spread.
* Team management: Prior experience leading the program pre-sales & delivery team by fostering continuous learning and ensuring members are well-trained, while supporting and driving career growth, personal and team development, well-being, diversity, and inclusion.
* Methodology: Demonstrated mastery of program management methodologies (Agile, Hybrid) and the ability to apply them to complex enterprise environments, including adapting agile frameworks to support the iterative testing and validation loops unique to generative AI solutions.
* Mindset: A self-starting, individual contributor mindset with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and influence across matrixed organizations.
* Leadership: Ability to lead a team of consultants in a matrix environment towards a common goal while navigating customer & internal organizational landscape.
* Education: Degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Certifications: Must have at least either of these Project management certification (PMI-ACP / PMP / PgMP / Prince 2). An AI Associate or related AI/ML delivery credential is highly valued.

**Position Summary**
**Tax Consultant II**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and help clients improve cross-border trade operations through Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) solutions. This role focuses on translating global trade compliance, logistics, and business requirements into scalable Oracle GTM configurations, workflows, and integrations. You will support compliant and efficient trade processes across areas such as screening, classification, licensing, duty and tax determination, documentation, and reporting. title: Oracle Channel Revenue Management - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an Oracle Channel Revenue Management Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement Oracle's suite of applications, and provide training and support to validate seamless integration and utilization, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on Oracle's tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As a Manager, you will build meaningful client connections and inspire your teams, navigating complex situations with confidence. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward is unclear. You will leverage a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will deepen your understanding of the business context, interpret data to inform insights, and uphold professional and technical standards, contributing to the firm's purpose and values.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of Oracle Fusion Cloud Channel Revenue Management implementations, rollouts, upgrades, and support engagements, spanning sell-side and buy-side channel flows from discovery through design, build, test, deployment, and hypercare.
* Own the overall solution design and delivery approach for channel incentive processes, ensuring solutions are scalable, reusable, auditable, and aligned with business requirements, pricing policy, and revenue recognition standards.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales, and Finance stakeholders, translating commercial objectives into effective channel program strategies and recommending appropriate program structures, eligibility rules, accrual treatments, and settlement approaches.
* Lead the design and configuration of Customer Channel Management programs, including customer rebates, customer promotion programs, annual and tiered volume programs, customer volume programs, annual co-op programs, lump sum payments, off-invoice promotions, special price agreements, and royalty payments.
* Lead the design and configuration of Supplier Channel Management programs, including supplier rebates, supplier annual rebates, ship-and-debit programs, supplier claim submission and validation, accrual reconciliation, and Supplier Portal collaboration.
* Govern the design of Deductions and Settlement processes, including claims, deductions, overpayments, invoice deductions, non-invoice deductions, manual claims, claim investigation, dispute handling, write-offs, and settlement by credit memo, debit memo, chargeback, check, or Payables payment.
* Oversee configuration of core setup objects including channel settings, channel program types, claim types, claim reasons, claim sources and settlement methods, user statuses, customer trade profiles, supplier trade profiles, approval rules, and claim assignment and ownership rules.
* Provide functional and technical leadership for integrations between Channel Revenue Management and Oracle Order Management, Pricing, Receivables, Payables, Procurement, Inventory, Subledger Accounting, and General Ledger, with a strong understanding of accrual, claim, settlement, and accounting event data flows.
* Lead the design of pricing-related configuration supporting channel programs, including qualifiers, custom qualifiers, modifiers, price lists, and net-of-rebate conditions within Oracle Fusion Pricing.
* Own the accrual and liability management design, including trade fund budgets, fund allocation, accrual creation and adjustment, accrual balances, earnings versus payments reconciliation, pay-over-earnings thresholds, and period-end close support.
* Manage multiple concurrent workstreams, projects, and stakeholder priorities while ensuring agreed quality, scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables are effectively managed.
* Establish and enforce quality assurance and release management processes, including configuration reviews, unit testing, SIT, UAT, integration testing, regression testing for quarterly Oracle updates, deployment readiness, and post-deployment monitoring.
* Lead data migration and conversion strategy for programs, accruals, claims, trade profiles, master data, and open transactional balances using FBDI, ADFdi, CSV loaders, REST services, and other Oracle Cloud data-loading mechanisms.
* Provide oversight for operational execution of scheduled processes such as accrual generation, claim settlement, mass settle and mass update claims, and accounting event sweeps, and proactively resolve data, integration, configuration, performance, and failed-processing issues.
* Lead analysis of channel performance and operational metrics, including program effectiveness, accrual accuracy, claim ageing, deduction recovery rates, settlement cycle times, and unclaimed rebate exposure, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* Partner with business and technology teams to define and enhance reporting, dashboards, and KPIs using OTBI, BI Publisher, and analytics platforms to provide visibility into channel program performance and financial exposure.
* Assess new Oracle Channel Revenue Management capabilities delivered through quarterly updates and recommend adoption of features that improve automation, control, scalability, and user experience.
* Establish and maintain solution governance standards, including configuration workbooks, naming conventions, change control, environment management, documentation, and access management.
* Promote appropriate data quality, master data, and control practices across customer, supplier, item, pricing, and program data supporting channel processes.
* Develop standard operating procedures, solution documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, reusable accelerators, and best-practice frameworks to improve consistency and reduce delivery effort.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation, reducing manual claim handling and settlement activities and improving overall efficiency and scalability of channel operations.
* Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex order, pricing, accrual, claim, settlement, and accounting integration issues, coordinating with internal technology teams, Oracle Support, and other stakeholders as required.
* Manage and mentor a team of Associates and Senior Associates, providing technical guidance, work allocation, quality reviews, coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities.
* Review team deliverables and provide appropriate oversight to ensure implementations meet expected functional, technical, quality, security, and operational standards.
* Facilitate stakeholder meetings, requirement workshops, design and solution reviews, status discussions, issue-resolution sessions, and leadership updates.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and recommended mitigation actions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support pursuits, proposals, solution demonstrations, estimation, and capability building as required.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Overall experience of 8-12 years in Oracle applications, with strong hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Channel Revenue Management across at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations or equivalent large-scale support and enhancement engagements.
* Strong hands-on configuration experience across Customer Channel Management, Supplier Channel Management, and Deductions and Settlement, including channel settings, program types, claim types, claim reasons, settlement methods, and customer and supplier trade profiles.
* Deep domain understanding of channel incentive processes, including customer and supplier rebate management, trade promotions, accrual management, claims management, deductions and settlement, and indirect sales management.
* Strong understanding of the Order-to-Cash and Procure-to-Pay process flows and the integration of Channel Revenue Management with Order Management, Pricing, Receivables, Payables, Procurement, and General Ledger.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Pricing, including price lists, qualifiers, modifiers, and custom pricing rules supporting channel programs.
* Understanding of Subledger Accounting, accounting events, accrual accounting, credit and debit memo processing, write-off treatment, and period-close implications of channel transactions.
* Experience managing complex implementations involving multiple business stakeholders, Oracle pillars, integrations, and dependencies.
* Demonstrated experience in requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, data migration, testing, deployment, production support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Proficiency in Oracle Cloud data-loading and integration mechanisms, including FBDI, ADFdi, CSV loaders, REST and SOAP web services, and file-based integrations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to perform root-cause analysis and recommend sustainable solutions rather than tactical fixes.
* Experience defining and monitoring operational metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and performance reports for channel and trade processes.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business-relevant information.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and stakeholders in a dynamic delivery environment.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and developing team members and reviewing technical and functional deliverables.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with adjacent Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM modules such as Order Management, Global Order Promising, Inventory Management, Procurement, and Supply Chain Financial Orchestration.
* Experience with Oracle E-Business Suite Channel Revenue Management and Trade Management, including chargebacks, third-party accruals, budgets and offers, and claims, particularly in EBS-to-Cloud migration scenarios.
* Industry experience in consumer goods, distribution, high tech, industrial manufacturing, or life sciences where trade promotions, chargebacks, and gross-to-net processes are material.
* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), middleware, EDI transactions, and enterprise integration patterns supporting partner and distributor data exchange.
* Experience with OTBI, BI Publisher, Oracle Analytics Cloud, or comparable reporting and data visualization solutions.
* Understanding of revenue recognition, trade spend governance, financial controls, audit requirements, and segregation-of-duties considerations for channel programs.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies, including requirements management, sprint planning, backlog management, testing, release management, and defect resolution.
* Oracle Cloud SCM, Order Management, or Channel Revenue Management certifications are desirable.

Manager-Level Leadership Expectations
  
  
The successful candidate will be expected to operate beyond configuration and demonstrate ownership across people, delivery, technology, and stakeholder management. The individual should be able to independently manage complex workstreams, provide direction to delivery teams, challenge and refine requirements, identify risks early, recommend scalable solutions, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
  
  
The Manager should also contribute to building the capability of the wider team through coaching, knowledge sharing, standardization, reusable solutions, quality governance, and continuous improvement, while maintaining a strong focus on delivery excellence and business outcomes.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

Help us transform and bring innovation to Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance!

In this role, the candidate will support the overall delivery of Vault Safety for our customers. They will define and drive business processes, support the project team in delivering the solution, and guide our customers throughout the implementation programs.

* Support life sciences customers in the rapid configuration and implementation of Vault Safety.
* Execute workshops and lead customer discussions of the Vault Development Cloud.
* Lead gap analyses, workshop preparation and delivery, requirements gathering, configuration, validation, and customer training.
* Gather customer functional and technical requirements to support business processes; translate requirements into system configuration.

* Provide Argus / Aris data model expertise in migrating customers’ existing data into Vault safety.

description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Salesforce is currently seeking a Manager, Technical Consulting to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. Our Manager, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team. We are key players in this objective, as they can use Industry Cloud functionality to deliver customer requirements quickly with minimal customization.
  
  
In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Industries practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.
  
  
This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a technical architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Industries Cloud.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You’ll have up to 15 direct reports under your scope of responsibility.
* You will be required to deliver technical work (as a technical architect) on Industries projects at 50% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants, Architects, and Managers.
* You’ll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest-quality solutions that meets the customers’ needs, ensuring continuous team enablement across modern AI coding environments.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering model across your delivery team.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Industries Cloud, Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Experience Cloud, guiding teams on the effective use of AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to maintain delivery speed and code health.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by defining metric frameworks to measure the business value of client AI workloads.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with SFI and Salesforce.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors.
* 5+ years of people management experience.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Salesforce Industries Cloud (Energy & Utilties), Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, and Vlocity OmniStudio or respective domain, with a foundational familiarity with Agentforce architectures being a plus.
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Platform Security (Must have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
* Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others).
* Proficiency in English.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect)
* OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, specifically keeping pace with AI-assisted delivery trends and data compliance practices.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation metrics, and outcomes.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Oracle CDP/Unity- Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an Oracle CDP/Unity Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on working with Oracle's suite of applications and tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, marketing automation, and customer experience solutions to meet the specific needs of an organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and marketing automation solutions to optimize client operations
* Analyzing client needs to develop tailored software solutions that enhance customer experience and satisfaction
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle applications
* Managing the entire customer journey from lead generation to revenue realization using Oracle's suite of tools
* Building meaningful client connections and fostering relationships to understand and anticipate client needs
* Navigating complex situations and using critical thinking to solve problems and generate new ideas
* Upholding professional and technical standards, including PwC's code of conduct and independence requirements
* Utilizing analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
* Collaborating with teams to deliver quality and strategic objectives in business application consulting
* Embracing change and leveraging digital tooling to enhance client service delivery

What You Must Have
  
  

* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands-on and leadership experience in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform (CDP) implementations.
* Experience leading at least 2–3 end-to-end Oracle Unity/CDP implementations.
* Good working experience with Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation, particularly integrations between Unity, Eloqua, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, data modelling, integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, administrators, data engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Customer Data Platforms, Customer 360, CRM, Marketing Automation, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, Data Warehouses, and enterprise integrations.

**Role And Responsibilities**

* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, and support of Oracle Unity solutions.
* Work closely with business, marketing, sales, service, IT, data, and architecture teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Unity solutions.
* Own technical design decisions and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data governance, and performance standards.
* Lead requirement-gathering and solution-design workshops and provide recommendations based on Oracle Unity capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution design documents, integration specifications, source-to-target mappings, test strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Unity workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, feedback, and guidance to developers, consultants, administrators, and end business users.
* Perform solution and design reviews and establish reusable development, integration, and configuration standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, data-quality issues, integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support and other vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, and technical escalations.
* Work with marketing teams to define how customer segments and attributes from Oracle Unity can be activated through Oracle Eloqua campaigns and marketing programs.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and communicate scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for Oracle Unity initiatives.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM, Data, Analytics, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Unity solution architecture and define scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable CDP solution patterns.Design end-to-end data ingestion, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, integration, and Customer 360 architecture across enterprise systems.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and capability showcases for Oracle Unity use cases and platform features.Present Customer 360, identity resolution, segmentation, intelligent attributes, dashboards, integrations, and activation flows to business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define Unity solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, integrations, and resource requirements.
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Oracle Unity projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.

**Oracle Unity / CDP Technical Responsibilities**

* Design the overall Oracle Unity data architecture, including source systems, ingestion strategy, data models, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and downstream integrations.
* Design and configure data feeds and ingestion jobs to bring customer, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and other enterprise data into Oracle Unity.
* Define and review source-to-target mappings between source systems, data warehouses, Oracle Unity, CRM, Marketing, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, and other downstream platforms.
* Configure and extend Oracle Unity data models based on business, reporting, analytical, and activation requirements.
* Maintain strong understanding of Oracle Unity data objects, relationships, attributes, metadata, and query capabilities.
* Design and configure Identity Resolution rules, including match rules, survivorship rules, master entity identification, and resolution of duplicate or conflicting customer records.
* Review and troubleshoot MCPS queries and optimize queries for performance and scalability.
* Design and create Intelligent Attributes and use them in calculations, segmentation, personalization, analytics, and activation use cases.
* Define and implement customer segmentation strategies using demographic, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and predictive attributes.
* Create, configure, and manage Data Science and Machine Learning models available within Oracle Unity and assess their applicability to business use cases.
* Configure and manage address validation, standardization, enrichment, and data-quality processes.
* Design and develop Customer 360 dashboards using rules, sub-rules, data source views, calculated attributes, and custom widgets.
* Develop dashboards for customer engagement, segmentation, campaign performance, customer behavior, and other business KPIs.
* Design and manage integrations between Oracle Unity and enterprise applications such as Oracle Sales, Salesforce, Oracle Service, Oracle Loyalty, Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Infinity, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Analytics platforms, and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Unity REST APIs, batch integrations, outbound activation mechanisms, webhooks, and integration patterns.
* Define and manage Access Control, users, roles, permissions, and security governance within Oracle Unity.
* Establish data-governance standards covering data ingestion, customer identity, data quality, data privacy, retention, consent, security, and downstream data activation.
* Monitor Unity ingestion jobs, data pipelines, identity-resolution processes, segmentation jobs, calculations, data-science processes, and integrations.
* Perform root-cause analysis and drive resolution of data-processing, integration, identity-resolution, API, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Review platform usage and recommend performance, scalability, and operational improvements.
* Define customer-data activation patterns to support Customer 360, personalization, lead generation, cross-sell, up-sell, churn management, customer engagement, and next-best-action use cases.

**Oracle Eloqua Exposure**

* Good understanding of Oracle Eloqua architecture, campaign management, contacts, custom objects, segments, forms, landing pages, and lead-nurturing programs.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with Oracle Eloqua for customer segmentation, campaign activation, audience synchronization, and marketing personalization.
* Understand the data flow between Unity, Eloqua, CRM/Salesforce/Oracle Sales, and other downstream marketing systems.
* Support marketing teams in using Unity customer attributes, Intelligent Attributes, and segments within Eloqua campaigns.
* Good understanding of Eloqua integrations, APIs, native connectors, and data synchronization mechanisms.
* Support troubleshooting of data synchronization, campaign activation, contact-management, and integration issues between Unity and Eloqua.
* Understand lead management, lead scoring, campaign responses, and lead hand-off processes between Eloqua and CRM systems.

**Integration And Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Oracle Unity REST APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with:
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Salesforce
* Oracle Service
* Oracle Loyalty
* Oracle Eloqua
* Oracle Infinity
* Data Warehouses
* Enterprise Data Lakes
* Analytics platforms
* External marketing and customer-engagement platforms

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Assurance FAAS – Manager – Controllership Transformation (Core)**
**The opportunity**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provides advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support. Within EY FAAS practice, the Finance Transformation Experts team build and develop client relationship with our regional stakeholders. We are part of an integrated global network of professionals who develop, design and optimise client service business processes for efficiency and high performance. We leverage and improve various frameworks, methodologies, solutions specific to our offerings and articulate presentations that communicate proposals, strategies, plans and outcomes.
  
  
**Qualification Requirement**

* CA, MBA (Finance) with Commerce Background, CWA, CMA, CFA, M.Com

**Job Responsibilities**
**Technical, Delivery & Subject Matter Areas**

* The primary focus of the role is using deep techno functional knowledge to drive transformation in any or all record to report areas which may not necessarily involve any technology implementation. The role is not focused on hands on technology implementation rather driving transformation in record to report areas holistically as a transformation lead (not PMO).
* Deep end to end techno functional knowledge on record to report data structure & how record to report process flows end to end in leading ERP solutions like SAP FI,CO, COPA, Closing Cockpit, SAP BPC, SAP Group Reporting, SAP FI/CO integration with SAP MM, SAP SD, SAP PP, Oracle Fusion Financial etc) transforming record to report process areas of i) Revenue Recognition ii) Accurals iii) Intercompany reconciliation iv) Manual Journal Entries & their automation v) Asset Accounting vi) Chart of Accounts & Accounting Master Data vii) Account reconciliation in the areas of cash & bank, sales, etc viii) Sub ledger accounting ix) Consolidation process x) Production & filing of financial statements xi) Notes & disclosures to accounts. Xii) Cost Accounting & Inventory xiii) Profitability Analysis
* Provide Subject matter expertise & lead delivery teams in Record to report transformation/Implementation in process areas mentioned above.
* Deep techno-functional knowledge of ERP platform integration with AI based technologies. Hands on experience of designing AI solution for record to report areas based on SAP platform.
* Intensive knowledge of consolidation process and how consolidation data structure is set up & how consolidation process runs in leading consolidation tool like SAP Group Reporting, SAP BPC, Oracle FCCS etc & how operational chart of accounts are mapped to Group Chart of Accounts in BPC or FS Items in SAP Group Reporting
* Lead delivery teams or workstream in large projects for a one or more solution areas.
* Solid knowledge of AI solutions availability & applicability in record to report area. Knowledge & experience of AI solutions development in record to report area is preferred.

**Business Development & Solution Development Areas**

* Lead pursuit teams to understand client problem statements & formulate that in solutions
* Lead developing client specific solutions for the engagement team
* Lead proposal building or lead proposal teams
* Lead collaboration with market teams to develop relationship to secure more business for EY
* Collaborate cross service lines to ensure smooth execution of the project.
* Lead development of internal capability development and lead training sessions to coach internal teams to develop capability
* Lead operational initiatives within the practice areas

**People Management Areas**

* Directly manage team of 5-8 FTEs in one or more solution areas.
* Develop people through coaching, motivation & guided training
* Develop career path & have career conversations with FTEs to keep them engaged.

**Skills**
**Subject Matter & Technical Skills & Knowledge**

* Deep knowledge in Record to report, invoice to pay and Order to cash areas
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in ERPs like SAP S/4 HANA FI/CO/COPA, SAP Central Finance, Oracle Fusion Finance, Oracle Netsuite
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in digital finance solutions like Blackline, Trintech, High Radius, Different RPA solutions
* Knowledge about AI/ML/Gen-AI & Analytics solution in finance space particularly in Record to Report areas.
* Knowledge of consolidation, reporting, inter-company and ERP data structures
* Have experience in current state analysis (As is), future state analysis (To be), process optimization, data optimization, data analytics, data management

**Business Skills & Knowledge**

* Strong business development skills
* Very strong solution conceptualization/ideation skill
* Strong olution/product build skills
* Strong project management skills

**Human Skills**

* Excellent written & oral communication & articulation
* Flexible work attitude
* Proven ability to lead diverse team over multiple geographies
* Strong collaboration skills
* Ability to comprehend complexity quickly & apply solutions
* Comfort in dealing with ambiguity
* Strond entrepreneurial skills in terms of ownership of problem & solutions
* Strong problem solving skills
* Ability to work under stress & produce results
* Willingness to travel for short or long duration at short notice

**Experience Requirement & Profile**

* 7-10 Years of relevant consulting experience in record to report transformation (not Industry user experience)
* Experience of working with international clients preferred
* Experience with previous multinational consulting firms or Big4 firms

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Upwork Bidder
description:

**Web & App Development, UI/UX & Graphic Design, and Digital Marketing/SEO**
services. Your proposals will directly shape our revenue and client base.

**Why Join Techdome?**

* Real ownership: your bids and conversions are visible and valued
* Incentives: performance-based rewards tied to deals you close
* Collaboration: work closely with technical and creative teams to build winnable pitches
* Growth: a clear path to senior Business Development roles
* Flexibility: hybrid work setup

title: GTM Engineer (Paid Growth and Go-To-Market)
description:
**About The Role**
Most companies run ads. We want someone who builds the machine behind them.
  
  
As our Growth & GTM Engineer, you will own the path from “who should we target?” to “which campaign brought us this customer?” You will identify our best-fit customers, sharpen how we position each product and service, choose the channels that deliver, and turn ad spend into a predictable flow of qualified leads and revenue.
  
  
Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) will be your main channel, supported by Google, LinkedIn, and newer platforms. You will manage the budget, read the numbers, and keep doubling down on what works.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Go-To-Market Strategy**

* Define our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and identify the highest-potential segments.
* Build positioning and messaging for each product and service.
* Choose the right channel mix for every offering.
* Run launches end to end, from planning to live campaigns.
* Work with design, product, and sales so our story stays consistent everywhere.

**Paid Growth**

* Run Meta Ads end to end: audiences, creative testing, bidding, and scaling.
* Plan, launch, and scale campaigns on Google, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
* Own the ad budget and make sure every rupee earns its place.
* Build and optimize the full funnel, from first click to closed deal.

**Tracking & Analytics**

* Set up and maintain tracking: pixels, Conversions API, event tagging, and UTM structures.
* Monitor CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS in GA4 and other analytics tools.
* Run A/B tests on ads, landing pages, messaging, and audiences, and document the learnings.
* Keep CRM data clean and share performance reports the team can act on.

**AI & Automation**

* Use AI tools to speed up ad copy, creative production, campaign optimization, and reporting.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Cost per qualified lead falls while lead volume and quality rise month on month.
* Tracking is reliable, and every lead can be traced back to its source.
* Winning campaigns are scaled, and losing ones are stopped quickly.
* Leadership gets a clear weekly view of spend, pipeline, and revenue impact.

**Your First 90 Days**

* Month 1: Audit existing tracking, campaigns, and funnel. Fix gaps in the pixel, Conversions API, and UTMs. Draft the ICP and messaging.
* Month 2: Launch ICP-based test campaigns on Meta and one other platform. Start structured creative and landing page tests.
* Month 3: Scale what works, cut what doesn’t, and set up a regular reporting rhythm with sales and leadership.

**What You Bring**
**Must have**

* 1.5+ years in digital or performance marketing.
* Hands-on experience running and scaling Meta Ads.
* Experience across more than one ad platform (Google, LinkedIn, or similar).
* Exposure to GTM work such as positioning, segmentation, or product launches.
* Comfort owning a budget and being accountable for results.
* A solid grasp of funnels, audience segmentation, and retargeting.
* Working knowledge of GA4 and a CRM or marketing automation tool.
* Familiarity with AI tools for copywriting and creative.
* Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills.
* Clear communication and sharp analytical thinking.
* A bias for action and excitement about building from zero.

**Nice to have**

* Basic SQL.
* Experience with Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar product analytics tools.
* Background in pricing, product positioning, or marketing automation.
* Interest in predictive modeling or AI-driven marketing analytics.

**Why Join Techdome?**

* Real ownership: Your work moves company revenue directly.
* Autonomy from day one: Decide fast, without layers of approval.
* Cross-team collaboration: Work daily with product, sales, and design.
* Open culture: A flat team where good ideas win and learning is fast.
* Room to grow: A clear path to senior GTM or marketing leadership.

**This Role Might Not Be for You If**
You prefer fixed playbooks, heavy approval chains, or work that is only about execution without owning the numbers.

title: Archt II-Solutions Archt (INTL)
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Type of Work: Highly consultative, collaborative with internal Sales and architectural . The daily focus is on independently leading technical pre-sales for mid-to-large enterprise accounts, leading whiteboarding sessions, and designing hybrid telecom/cloud networks. You will also play a critical role in identifying and scoping automation opportunities within customer deployments.
* Expected Volumes: Managing a robust pipeline of concurrent enterprise deals independently, while partnering with Architect IIIs on specific components of global strategic accounts. You will oversee technical discovery, design full network topologies, and guide Architect Is in building the corresponding lab/PoC environments.
* Risk & Criticality: Moderate-to-High commercial risk. You are independently designing solutions and scoping out automation requirements for significant revenue-generating accounts. Inaccurate scoping, missed requirements during discovery, or flawed architectural designs can lead to delivery delays, margin erosion, or lost competitive bids.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Mid-to-Large Deal Ownership: Act as the primary technical lead for mid-to-large enterprise deals. Take full ownership of the technical sales cycle, from initial discovery and requirements gathering to the final solution presentation.
* Automation Scoping & Strategy: Move beyond basic scripting to identify strategic automation opportunities. Assess customer environments and internal workflows to scope out where zero-touch provisioning, API integrations, or RPA can be applied. Define these requirements clearly for the Automation Team or Architect I to execute.
* Technical Discovery & Whiteboarding: Lead interactive customer workshops and whiteboard sessions with IT Directors and Network Managers. Uncover deep technical pain points and map them directly to our SD-WAN, cloud, and modern telecom portfolio.
* Solution Architecture & Validation: Design comprehensive, scalable network architectures. Oversee the generation of accurate Bill of Materials (BOMs) and technical RFP responses, ensuring everything is technically viable and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* Mentorship: Guide the Architect I in understanding the actual customer requirement and solution design
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as a bridge between Sales, Delivery, and Product. Ensure the solutions you architect are deployable by the delivery team and provide structured feedback to Product Management on mid-market feature requests.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* 4 to 6 years of relevant experience in the telecom or tech industry, with at least 2-3 years in a customer-facing pre-sales, systems engineering, or solutions architecture role.
* Advanced Networking Knowledge: Deep understanding of enterprise architectures, including SD-WAN, complex routing/switching (BGP, OSPF), firewalls, VPNs, and legacy telecom transitions.
* Automation Acumen: Strong ability to identify automation scope. You must understand how APIs work (REST/JSON) and how tools like Python, Terraform, or Ansible integrate into a network, even if you are no longer writing the code from scratch every day.
* Cloud Integration: Practical experience designing networks that connect securely to public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding cloud-native networking constructs.
* Presentation Skills: Proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value for mid-level technical decision-makers (Directors of IT, Network Managers).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Mid-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Security), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, MEF SD-WAN Professional, or equivalent.
* Experience navigating the transition of legacy MPLS networks to modern, internet-first SD-WAN or SASE architectures.
* Experience managing or orchestrating vendor relationships (OEMs) for specific components of a larger deal.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Enterprise AI Architect
description:
