title: Startup Account Manager - Greenfield, India Startups Team
description:
**Description**
Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all. We give founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world’s largest companies. With nearly two decades of experience, gained from supporting hundreds of thousands of startups, the AWS Startups team helps founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible, at any stage of growth, and any level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, choose to launch on AWS.
  
  
AWS continues to rapidly grow and we seek a Startup Account Manager to earn trust and help drive growth with well-funded and high-potential startups. In this fast-moving business, the core responsibility is to ensure that new and high-potential startups choose AWS as their cloud platform to transform and accelerate their business. We work backwards from the customer and partner with technical team members, business development, and stakeholders to lead scaled Go-to-Market strategies, accelerate adoption and drive customer success.
  
  
The ideal candidate has a passion to work with innovators and new technologies, has a strong sales background, and has the technical aptitude to learn and discuss the latest technologies, such as generative AI, machine learning, artificial intelligence, data services, and sustainable computing. This is a fast-paced role. We work at the speed of startup founders, are able to engage personas from developers to technical founders and CXOs. You will work along side Solution Architects and Product Specialists, Inside Sales, Business Development, and technology and services partners. You will be a self-starter, travel for in-person meetings, and attend events. You will develop and execute against a territory coverage plan and consistently deliver on quarterly revenue targets and measurable business objectives.

* Ensure customer success with early and mid stage startups

* Accelerate customer adoption through well-developed sales engagements and successful GTM Strategy

* Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.
* Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services.

title: Architect Manager
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Management
  
  
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
  
  
Model - Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
  
  
Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
  
  
Care - Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
  
  
Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
  
  
Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes, and ensures that proposed solutions are aligned with broader organizational strategy. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.
  
  
Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Uses broad patterns of feedback to develop strategic and actionable insights and presents a compelling business case to program managers that influences product roadmaps and decision making. Contributes to Microsoft-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
  
  
Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. Mentors peers and teams on best practices around internal resources usage. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.
  
  
Architecture Design and Deployment
  
  
Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.

description:

.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

* 3 years of experience working in projects leveraging generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agentic automation to transform enterprise business workflows and support operations.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Ability to deliver business transformation AI programs in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with excellent organizational and project management skills.
* Ability to build strong relationships with clients and act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner cross-functionally and at the executive level.
* Deep subject matter expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Gemini Enterprise architecture, or enterprise cloud support ecosystems.
* Demonstrated track record of managing large-scale global vendor partnerships (GSIs) and leading multi-disciplinary cross-functional technical or innovation initiatives.
* Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority across a complex matrixed organization.

**About the job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As an AI Transformation Solutions Consultant, you will embody a high-agency, founder-mindset to bridge frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities with global vendor operational delivery. You will move beyond legacy vendor oversight to co-create, test, and jointly deploy automated, high-velocity support AI solutions directly alongside strategic Global System Integrator (GSI) delivery partners. You will drive strategic direction with a deep understanding of technical capabilities, resolve operational blockers, and work through the complexities required to shift vendor service models from traditional labor arbitrage to AI-first intelligence orchestration. You will have a proven track record for developing elegant solutions with evidence of domain expertise (e.g., quality, training, support operations, knowledge), a passion for generating impact by leveraging AI and automation, and a skill for delivering on improvement opportunities inside a process or organization.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop a multi year AI roadmap and strategy to transform a high-volume transactional environment into an automated, strategic engine to enable cloud Value Management Office (VMO) to drive value realization and performance.
* Partner with internal Google Cloud Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA), and Support teams to co-create and embed agentic AI-motivated VMO modules, including AI-Assisted Case Review, Autonomous Support Agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-grounded diagnostic tools.
* Design and implement next-generation governance and quality frameworks, shifting from managing to agreement to consultative, outcome-based performance metrics.
* Act as a strategic leader and technical advisor for vendor strategy, addressing execution gaps and increasing partnership maturity.
* Drive outcomes focus on operational efficiency, tokenization, automation realized through Gemini Enterprise, and measurable business impact.

description:

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
  
  
THE ROLE
  
  
The Technical Marketing Engineer for AMD-AECG is an adaptable, self-motivated individual who drives the Vivado and next-generation tool product roadmap to best serve customer needs. This role is responsible for feature specification, planning, validation, documentation, early training materials, and key customer support. Technical Marketing works closely with Product Planning, R&D, Applications Engineering, and top-tier customers to improve the FPGA and Adaptive SoC design process and enable next-generation designs and methodologies. The environment is fast-paced, global, and focused on emerging technologies.
  
  
THE PERSON
  
  
The successful Technical Marketing Engineer plays a critical role in defining, planning, and supporting
**Run-Time Reconfiguration (RTR)**
flows in the Vivado Design Suite for AMD FPGA and Adaptive SoC products. This includes maintaining Run-Time Reconfiguration Intellectual Property (IP), enabling advanced use cases that reduce compile time, ensuring compliance with PCI Express standards, and driving the next generation of the Vivado tool roadmap.
  
  
This individual understands customer requirements and pain points across Run-Time Reconfiguration, design partitioning, module reuse, and preservation-based incremental compilation flows, and translates those insights into innovative product capabilities. The ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate across global teams is essential. We operate with an agentic, AI-first mindset and expect team members to actively incorporate AI into how they work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define best-in-class development flows, features, and methodologies for Run-Time Reconfiguration across AMD FPGA, Zynq™, and Adaptive SoC tools and libraries.
* Drive Run-Time Reconfiguration, design partitioning, module-level reuse, and compile-time reduction methodologies from feature specification through validation.
* Maintain and enhance Run-Time Reconfiguration IP and associated tool flows to support advanced customer use cases.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product Planning, Sales, and customers to define and deliver innovative tool features.
* Provide technical expertise to field teams and customers by developing training materials, tutorials, application notes, and user guides.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to internal stakeholders and customers, including architecture, implementation tradeoffs, and design recommendations.
* Gather and analyze customer and field feedback, identify opportunities for new features and product improvements, and work closely with Planning and Engineering teams to drive implementation.

**Preferred Experience**

* Strong knowledge of the complete FPGA design flow and Vivado tool suite.
* Hands-on experience with Run-Time Reconfiguration or similar modular and reconfigurable design methodologies.
* Understanding of design partitioning, module reuse, incremental compilation, and preservation-based implementation flows.
* Expertise in System-on-Chip (SoC) development.
* Experience applying AI/ML technologies, including AI-assisted design, automation, debug, or agentic engineering workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and solve complex system-level technical challenges, both independently and in collaboration with strategic customers.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with geographically distributed, cross-functional teams.

* Provide a bullet point list of the responsibilities and duties of this job
* Design Implementation experience should include ASIC design using industry-standard tools (Placement, Optimization, CTS, Routing)

* Tool knowledge (preferred): STA (Primetime, Tempus),

description:

title: EYP-Working Capital-Assistant Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Parthenon – S&E - WCAS (Assistant Manager)**
**Working Capital Advisory Services (WCAS)**
WCAS is a cornerstone of EY's Transformation offerings to clients, working in tandem with other EY practices to drive top line and bottom-line growth with measurable cash benefits.
  
  
Our team is committed to improving the cash-impacting processes of EY clients globally. We aim to help clients enhance their liquidity, resulting in increased Free Cash Flow (FCF) from operations. Our approach includes in-depth analysis and benchmarking, data-driven diagnostics of Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Forecast-to-Fulfil processes using EY's market leading methodologies and tools, and interventions focused on liquidity, such as Cash Flow Forecasting support.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We seek Assistant Managers with expertise in Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), inventory optimization, and/ or supply chain management. Ideal candidates will have 4-7 years of experience in operational improvements with a strategic, transformation-oriented mindset, demonstrated by:
  
  

* Analyzing market/industry trends.
* Ideating from the client's perspective and strategizing with a 'big picture' approach.
* Aligning with client objectives for value, differentiation, ease of implementation, and long-term enablement.
* Experience in key sectors (e.g., Life Sciences and Healthcare, Advanced Manufacturing/ Industrials, Technology, Consumer Products or Retail).
* An end-to-end and transformational approach during pursuits, proposals, and engagements.

As a contributor to our performance improvement, and strategic growth initiatives, you will use your advanced skills in operational and financial data modelling to provide strategic insights to clients and internal stakeholders
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support in executing WCAS engagements either individually or as part of a team to support key conclusions in developing and executing Working Capital optimization opportunities, support strategy and process optimization programs and Cash positioning
* Analyze historical transactional and financial data and market trends to create accurate and reliable opportunity and benefits measures
* Working closely with client teams and GDS leads to tailor models to specific client needs.
* Present deliverables and solutions to clients, clearly communicating assumptions, methodologies, and implications for their business.
* Contribute to the development of proposals and participate in client presentations for new business opportunities.
* Engage in continuous learning and development to stay abreast of best practices in Working Capital and Cash management
* Maintain the highest standards of quality and compliance with EY's ethical guidelines and professional standards.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts in developing their analytical skills and understanding of methodologies
* Data analysis with extensive use Power BI / Alteryx / PowerPoint and advanced MS Excel
* Working knowledge of AI assistants such as copilot for developing automation agents for business development and other use cases

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Inventory Management Expertise: Experience in inventory turnover analysis, just-in-time inventory practices, and demand forecasting to reduce holding and shortage costs
* Credit and Receivables Management: Knowledge of credit policies, credit analysis, and accounts receivable management through Quote-to-Cash process analysis and designing strategies to minimize days sales outstanding (DSO).
* Payables and Disbursements Management: Expertise in managing accounts payable and optimising the Procure-to-Pay cycle. Experience in implementing efficient payment processes to maximise days payables outstanding (DPO).
* Supply chain management: Functional knowledge and experience within Plan, make, source, deliver pillars of supply chain management is a plus
* Data Analytics: Experience in working with large volumes of transactional data to develop segmentation and opportunity models (Must have- Power BI, Alteryx/SQL, MS Office applications; Good to have - Python/R, VBA, Snowflake/Databricks)
* Experience of working with stakeholders in global landscape
* Excellent problem solving and interpersonal skills
* Willingness to Travel: Openness to international travel for business purposes.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Post Graduate degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, computer science or related field from a premier institute with 4-7 years of applicable industry / analytics and/or consulting experience
* Track record of delivering performance improvement projects related to supply chain/inventory optimization, sourcing/procurement or sales/accounts receivable that deliver tangible results (cost take out, revenue growth, increased cash flow, etc.).

**What You Can Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EYP practices globally with running businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
EY is committed to being inclusive in all dimensions of diversity to ensure every employee is able to be and bring their authentic self to work, every day.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Key Accounts Manager – Cross-Border Payments (B2B)
description:
About GlocalPe™

GlocalPe™ is a B2B cross-border payments and financial infrastructure platform being developed by Dhaniti™ Fintech Solutions Private Limited. Its business proposition covers international
**pay-ins (collections) and pay-outs (payments)**
for businesses and ecosystem partners.

Dhaniti's broader portfolio includes DhanitiPay™, a platform combining UPI-led digital payments with responsible credit enablement. We focus on building technology-enabled financial solutions with an emphasis on trust, transparency, compliance, and reliable service.

About the Role

**Can you win new customers, activate their business, and grow the relationship?**

We are looking for a commercially driven B2B sales professional to acquire and grow customers for GlocalPe™.

This is an
**acquisition-led sales role**
, not simply an account-servicing position. You will identify businesses with international collection and payment requirements, engage decision-makers, win new customers, support onboarding and initial transactions, and grow the business routed through GlocalPe.

The role covers the complete customer journey:

**Prospecting → Customer Acquisition → Solution Selling → Onboarding → Activation → Account Growth → Retention → Cross-sell → Referrals**

What You Will Do1. Find and acquire new customers

* Identify and approach SMEs, enterprises, exporters, importers, and other businesses with cross-border payment requirements.
* Build your own sales pipeline through market mapping, direct outreach, referrals, industry networks, events, and professional relationships.
* Engage business owners, founders, CFOs, finance heads, and treasury teams.
* Understand customers' payment flows, transaction volumes, business requirements, existing arrangements, and pain points.
* Present suitable GlocalPe solutions, handle objections, negotiate, and close new business.

2. Onboard and activate customers

* Coordinate with Operations and Compliance teams to facilitate customer onboarding and documentation.
* Guide customers through onboarding requirements, payment processes, and transaction workflows.
* Help new customers complete their initial transactions and address barriers to activation.
* Follow up until acquired customers become active sources of business.

3. Grow accounts and increase transaction volumes

* Understand customers' eligible cross-border payment business and identify opportunities to increase the share routed through GlocalPe.
* Develop customer relationships to expand transaction volumes, frequency, and recurring business.
* Identify opportunities across both pay-ins and pay-outs, subject to product availability and customer eligibility.
* Monitor declining or inactive accounts and take corrective action to improve engagement and business activity.
* Develop repeat business, cross-sell opportunities, and referrals.

4. Deliver business results

* Own assigned targets for new customer acquisition, customer activation, transaction volumes, and revenue.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular updates on prospects, conversions, forecasts, and business performance.
* Work with Product, Operations, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to address customer requirements and resolve issues.
* Share market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitor insights to support business development.
* Follow applicable KYC, RBI/FEMA, and other relevant compliance requirements. Sales targets must never override compliance obligations.

Must-Have Qualifications

* **5+ years of experience**
  in B2B business development, enterprise sales, key account management, or relationship-led sales in fintech, payments, forex, remittance, trade finance, or related financial services.
* Proven experience in
  **new customer acquisition**
  , not just servicing an existing customer portfolio.
* A demonstrated track record of achieving sales, revenue, transaction-volume, or acquisition targets.
* Good understanding of B2B payment flows and the business requirements associated with international collections and payments.
* Experience managing customer relationships from prospecting and acquisition through onboarding, activation, and account growth.
* Ability to engage business owners, founders, CFOs, finance heads, and other senior decision-makers.
* Strong prospecting, presentation, negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently build a pipeline, follow through on opportunities, and take ownership of business targets.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings and business development as required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with cross-border payments, international payments, forex, remittance, or payment platforms.
* Existing relationships with SMEs, exporters, importers, enterprises, or businesses engaged in international trade and services.
* Experience in trade finance, treasury, foreign exchange, or international transaction services.
* A professional network among founders, CFOs, finance heads, and treasury professionals.
* Familiarity with payment processing, APIs, integrations, reconciliation, settlement, or technology-enabled financial services.
* Experience growing transaction volumes, increasing customer share of business, and generating referrals.
* Exposure to CRM tools, sales automation, data-driven account management, or AI-enabled sales tools.
* Working knowledge of applicable RBI/FEMA requirements for cross-border payment activities.
* Availability to join immediately

You do not need to be a technology specialist, but you should be comfortable explaining payment solutions in business terms and coordinating with technical teams when required.

What Success Looks Like

* A consistent pipeline of qualified prospects and newly acquired B2B customers.
* Successful onboarding and activation of new customers.
* Growth in recurring transactions, transaction volumes, and revenue.
* Increased share of eligible customer business routed through GlocalPe.
* Strong retention, account expansion, cross-sell, and referral business.
* Achievement of assigned commercial targets while maintaining compliant business practices.

Why Join GlocalPe™?

* **Build new business:**
  Acquire customers and develop your own portfolio rather than relying solely on inherited accounts.
* **Own the customer relationship:**
  Stay involved from the first conversation through onboarding, activation, and account growth.
* **Work across payment use cases:**
  Develop experience across international collections, payments, and B2B financial infrastructure.
* **Grow with the business:**
  Strong performers may take on larger customer portfolios, broader commercial responsibilities, and leadership opportunities as the business expands.

What to Expect if Shortlisted

1. **Initial screening:**
   Discussion of your experience, sales track record, location, and availability.
2. **Business discussion:**
   Assessment of your acquisition approach, cross-border payments knowledge, customer network, and commercial achievements.
3. **Leadership discussion:**
   Conversation about customer acquisition, account growth, business ownership, and your approach to targets.
4. **Offer and onboarding:**
   For selected candidates.

How to Apply

Please submit an updated resume highlighting:

* Your B2B sales, business development, and account management experience.
* Previous acquisition, transaction-volume, or revenue targets and actual achievements, wherever available.
* Customer segments, industries, and cross-border payment use cases you have handled.
* Your current location, notice period, and earliest possible joining date.

**We are looking for hands-on B2B sales professionals who can win new customers, convert opportunities into active business, and grow customer relationships into sustainable revenue.**

Dhaniti™ does not charge candidates any fee at any stage of the recruitment process.

Key Focus Areas

**B2B Sales | Business Development | Cross-Border Payments | International Pay-ins & Pay-outs | Customer Acquisition | Enterprise Sales | Key Account Management | Account Growth | Forex | Trade Finance | Import-Export | Payment Solutions | Fintech**

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

You'll build on top of Saras IQ Product to own the solution and the build for a client requirement - from the first requirements conversation and live customer demos to validated data, one trusted set of metrics, live dashboards, and clean data every morning - as the accountable owner of what gets built as a repeatable product capability.

**About Saras Analytics**

Saras Analytics is an AI and data analytics firm built for ecommerce and omnichannel brands. We help fast growing SMBs and mid-market brands turn disconnected, messy data into decisions — covering ingestion, transformation, and consumption, backed by our own products (Daton and Saras IQ) as the data infrastructure in every engagement.

**Why Now**

Saras is profitable and bootstrapped. We run flat: talent and good ideas move fast here regardless of tenure or title. AI-assisted tooling now lets one engineer take a client from the first requirements conversation to a live, trusted dashboard without waiting on a queue of hand-offs. The Forward Deployed Engineer role is built around that: one owner, end to end, with the tooling to make it fast. Because you build on top of our products rather than around them, what you create for one client requirement becomes capability that every client can use. An FDE joining now helps define what that role looks like at its best.

**The Role**

You'll own the solution and the build for one client account, reporting to an FDE Lead. You build on top of our product, Saras IQ, extending it with software you design and code. You are responsible for interacting directly with the customer — running discovery, demoing what you build, and presenting it to client stakeholders — as well as with the product teams, and you contribute to the product roadmap. Whatever you build, you then become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product: you create repeatable solutions that expand what the product can do and maximize revenue impact. On that account you work alongside a Strategic Account Manager, who owns the client relationship and the commercial outcomes, and a Product Manager, who owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it. You own what gets built and whether it is right — requirements, software, data, metrics, dashboards, and data quality — with our AI-assisted tooling and our SME leads behind you for the hardest problems.

**The Bar**

Speed & Delivery quality are the top priorities for this role: what you ship is correct, validated against the source of truth before the client sees it, and there on the date you committed to. Speed matters because clients feel it — the shortest path from signed-off requirements to a live, trusted dashboard — but never at the cost of numbers the client can rely on. You build to product standard: what you write is well designed, tested, version-controlled, and reusable, because it is part of the product. You surface risks before they block delivery, and you close every issue with a root cause and a fix, you internally escalate the dependencies on time. The lanes are explicit: you own the solution and the build; the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial outcomes; the Product Manager owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Own discovery and requirements.**
Join the sales handover to close open questions and call out risks early. Run discovery sessions directly with client stakeholders on the client's core use cases — sales and marketing, contribution margin, customer cohorts, product and inventory — co-design the solution with them, and write the business requirements and metric definitions using Saras' standard templates, reviewing them internally before client sign-off. Build the mock-ups that let clients react before anything is built, demo working builds live to the client at every milestone and take their feedback directly, write the test cases every requirement will be validated against, and track change requests so scope stays visible to you and the Account Manager.

**2. Own the data build.**
Set up integrations and access with our data-ingestion team, translate requirements into technical specifications, and build the staging, master, and presentation datasets with Saras' AI-assisted data-engineering tools, following our data-model conventions (dbt, BigQuery, Git). Apply PII masking, and keep the data dictionary and lineage documentation current. When a problem goes beyond your account — a complex architecture choice or a platform limit — take it to the senior data-engineering lead with a proposed workaround, and keep ownership of the outcome.

**3. Build on top of the product, end to end.**
You are not only modelling data: you build complete solutions on top of Saras IQ, and that takes software & data engineering & Analytics skills. Design and code the services, APIs, integrations, automation, and application logic around the data layer, and apply sound engineering practice — modular design, code review, automated tests, version control, and CI/CD. Write code that others can maintain and extend, because it may become part of the product.

**4. Turn what you build into product.**
Whatever you build, you become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product. Package it as a repeatable, configurable solution rather than a one-off, document it, and help other FDEs and accounts adopt it, so each engagement expands what the product can do and maximizes its revenue impact.

**5. Own the client's metric definitions.**
Configure one certified set of metrics and dimensions for each client in Saras IQ's semantic layer, so that every dashboard, self-serve question, and AI answer draws on the same definitions.

**6. Own validation before anything reaches the client**
. Reconcile every dataset against its source of truth, certify it, and run the internal sign-off against agreed criteria for sending work back. Set up the data quality and completeness checks, validate against the requirement test cases and against a benchmark set of business questions the AI analyst must answer correctly, then walk the Account Manager through the build in a final review before it goes to the client.

**7. Own the consumption layer.**
Build dashboards natively in Saras IQ (and in Tableau, Luzmo, or Power BI where the contract specifies), drawing their metrics from the client's certified definitions. Build and maintain the business context that powers Saras IQ Analyst, our AI analyst; set it up and provision it for client users in Slack and their AI tools; and keep refining that context from what users ask it. The Account Manager leads the launch and adoption, and the Product Manager leads enablement.

**8. Own data quality every day.**
Run the daily data-quality cycle: confirm the overnight pipelines and checks have completed, resolve what they flag, escalate anything still open — or late upstream data — to the senior data-engineering lead, re-run and re-test what you fixed, and send the client a routine data-quality status (with any help you need from them), copying the Account Manager. Configure latency and dashboard alerts, and close every bug and change request with a root cause and a fix. When an issue breaches its SLA or stays open past a day, the Account Manager takes the client escalation and you drive the fix.

**9. Run your delivery hygiene.**
Keep your onboarding and project documentation, task tracker, and timesheets current, so anyone can see where your account stands.

**10. Partner across the lanes.**
Be the direct technical voice to customers and to the product teams, and contribute to the product roadmap. Support your Account Manager with the technical answers behind success criteria, client acceptance testing, and adoption, and demo what you built and walk client users through its logic yourself, while the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial conversations; work with the Product Manager and the product teams to turn what you hear from customers and learn from your builds into roadmap priorities; and work with our data-ingestion and data-engineering teams to unblock ingestion, data quality, and architecture issues.

**What Winning Looks Like**

**First 90 days:**

you know your account's data and metric definitions in depth, you run the daily data-quality cycle reliably, and you've taken at least one deliverable from signed-off requirements to a validated, live dashboard on your own, demoing it to the client yourself.

**Steady state:**

you deliver datasets and dashboards independently and on the committed date, your validation catches issues before clients ever do, your client's mornings start with clean data, your FDE Lead trusts what you ship without re-checking every number, your teammates enjoy working with you, what you've built is reusable and part of the product, you contribute to the roadmap, and you're ready to own a new account launch end to end.

**Who Thrives Here**

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them, you bring 3+ years (typically 3–6) of hands-on data and software work — some of it building in SQL and code, and some of it facing clients, including demos.

• You've been a business or data analyst who wrote requirements and specifications, worked hands-on in SQL, and are ready to own the build as well as the brief.

• You've been an analytics or data engineer who built layered data models — raw, staging, masters, presentation — and are ready to own the client conversation as well as the pipeline.

• You've delivered data or BI projects in an analytics consulting or services firm, end to end, directly with clients.

• You've been a software engineer who built backend or full-stack applications and data-heavy products, and are ready to take on analytics, data modelling, and the client conversation.

**Whichever route you come from, you have:**

• A degree from a reputed engineering college.

• Strong SQL and data-modelling fundamentals across the raw → staging → master → presentation layers.

• Software engineering fundamentals: proficiency in Python (or a comparable language such as Java, TypeScript, or Go), data structures, and the ability to write clean, modular, tested, maintainable code.

• Software design skills: you can design the architecture of an end-to-end solution — services, APIs, data flows, and integrations — weigh the trade-offs, and build it to be reusable and extensible.

• Engineering practice: code review, unit and integration testing, CI/CD, and debugging in production. • Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool — Tableau, Power BI, or similar.

• A foundational understanding of statistics — enough to know when a number is meaningful and when it isn't.

• Working knowledge of dbt and BigQuery (or the ability to ramp up quickly), and everyday use of Git.

• Comfort with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot — we'll train you on Saras' own tooling.

• The ability to turn an ambiguous client ask into clear, testable requirements and a technical specification.

• Clear, confident client communication — you can own a delivery conversation without a go-between, run live product demos, and present to client and product stakeholders.

• The ability to work with product teams and contribute to a roadmap: you can turn customer needs and what you've built into reusable product capabilities.

**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:**

• An engineering degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Analytics, or Data Science.

• Ecommerce data fluency: you know how contribution margin, customer cohorts, attribution, and inventory are really calculated — and where the source data misleads.

• Experience with a semantic or metrics layer, or with data-quality and observability frameworks.

• Dashboards you've built that clients actually use, and the instinct for what makes one trustworthy.

• Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• Experience building APIs, integrations, or full-stack applications, and with cloud services (GCP preferred) and containerization.

• You've presented analysis directly to a client or senior stakeholder, not just to your own team.

**Location**

Hyderabad. Standard working hours are noon to 9 PM IST.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses, comprehensive health insurance, relocation support, and ongoing professional development. Saras Analytics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace for all. If you want to own what gets built, end to end, on top of our product, and see it land with the client, then make it part of the product, we want to talk to you.

* Experience designing KPI frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
* Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches – capability, process, or technology maturity – and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
* Familiarity with IT governance frameworks (e.g. COBIT, ITIL) and ability to design practical governance structures including RACI models and interaction frameworks
* Understanding of GCC tooling ecosystems – ITSM platforms, project portfolio management tools, reporting and analytics platforms
* Awareness of AI adoption in software delivery including AI-assisted development tools and their implications for GCC workforce and process design
* Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills

title: Lead - MENA Finished Dosage
description:
The Lead - MENA Finished Dosage Business Development will lead Finished Dosage business development across MENA, with responsibility for market development, customer acquisition, opportunity conversion, strategic partnerships and sustainable commercial growth.

The incumbent will translate geography-specific demand, regulatory requirements, competition, customer portfolios and supply capability into executable product, registration, partnership and revenue plans for finished dosage formulations across relevant oral solid, liquid and other approved dosage forms.

Key Responsibilities

1. MENA Finished Dosage Growth Strategy

· Develop country and customer priorities for the Finished Dosage portfolio across MENA.

· Assess demand, competition, pricing, margin, registration requirements, payment risk and manufacturing fit.

· Build annual plans and a multi-year qualified pipeline with clear stage gates.

2. Finished Dosage Business Development and Market Entry

· Identify new Finished Dosage customers, distributors, agents and strategic partners.

· Originate opportunities through new molecules, alternate-source needs, lifecycle requirements, site transfer and long-term supply.

· Coordinate market-entry, sampling, qualification, registration and commercialization plans.

3. Finished Dosage Technical Commercialization

· Align specifications, documentation, samples, methods, validation and qualification with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Manufacturing.

· Translate technical requirements into feasible commercial proposals, timelines and supply plans.

· Monitor portfolio attractiveness, price erosion, competition, capacity and lifecycle priorities.

4. Customer, Contract and Account Management

· Build senior relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturers, formulators, distributors and partners across MENA.

· Lead RFQs, pricing, negotiations, forecasts, supply terms and contract coordination.

· Drive retention, wallet share, query resolution and structured account reviews.

5. Forecasting, Supply and Commercial Discipline

· Own opportunity forecasts and reliable S&OP demand inputs.

· Coordinate samples, launch quantities, regular supply and backorders with SCM, Planning, Operations and Quality.

· Manage price realization, margins, payment terms, receivables, credit exposure and partner performance.

6. Market Intelligence, Governance and Teamwork

· Track MENA demand, competitors, pricing, regulatory developments and investments relevant to Finished Dosage.

· Represent in customer visits, audits, conferences and industry forums.

· Maintain ethical partner practices, documentation, action closure and governance.

Success Metrics

· Finished Dosage revenue, gross margin and growth across MENA.

· Pipeline value, stage progression and conversion rate.

· New customers, product awards and long-term supply agreements.

· Sample, qualification, filing / registration and commercialization milestone adherence.

· Forecast accuracy, OTIF, supply continuity and service performance.

· Price realization, DSO, collections and credit exposure.

Candidate Profile

Experience

· 10-15+ years in pharmaceutical Finished Dosage sales, business development or key-account roles.

· Demonstrated MENA-facing experience and relevant customer / partner relationships.

· Understanding of Finished Dosage qualification, regulatory documentation, quality expectations, contracting and supply models.

· Evidence of converting technical-commercial opportunities into recurring business.

· Experience in registration-led entry, dossier / licensing partnerships, tenders, distributors and institutional channels is preferred.

Education

· B.Pharm / M.Pharm / MSc Chemistry / Chemical Engineering / Life Sciences degree.

· MBA / postgraduate qualification in Marketing or International Business preferred.

Core Competencies

· MENA pharmaceutical-market knowledge.

· Finished Dosage business development and technical-commercial acumen.

· Customer acquisition and strategic-account management.

· Portfolio prioritization and market entry.

· Pricing, negotiation, contracts and receivables discipline.

· Coordination with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Manufacturing, SCM and Finance.

* Recommend bid or no-bid decisions based on opportunity assessment, risk, investment, and expected business value.
* Develop account-specific and industry-specific presales strategies.

* Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and stakeholder discussions to understand customer business and technical requirements.
* Analyse Requests for Proposal, Requests for Information, Requests for Quotation, and other procurement documents.
* Translate customer requirements into clear functional, technical, operational, and commercial solution components.
* Identify gaps, assumptions, dependencies, risks, constraints, and clarification requirements.
* Ensure that proposed solutions address the customer’s current challenges and long-term business objectives.
* Solution Development and Architecture
* Lead the design of end-to-end IT services solutions in collaboration with solution architects and delivery teams.
* Develop solutions covering areas such as application development, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and analytics, enterprise applications, managed services, automation, and digital transformation.
* Define the solution scope, architecture, operating model, implementation approach, delivery methodology, governance structure, and service management framework.
* Ensure alignment between customer requirements, proposed technologies, delivery capabilities, service levels, and commercial commitments.
* Review and validate solution designs, effort estimates, staffing models, transition plans, and implementation schedules.
* Promote the use of reusable solution components, accelerators, frameworks, and industry best practices.
* Proposal and Bid Management
* Lead the preparation and submission of high-quality technical and commercial proposals.
* Manage cross-functional bid teams involving sales, technology, delivery, finance, legal, procurement, HR, and partner organisations.
* Define proposal structure, response strategy, responsibilities, review cycles, and submission timelines.
* Develop executive summaries, solution narratives, transformation roadmaps, case studies, and differentiators.
* Ensure that all proposal responses are accurate, compliant, consistent, and aligned with customer expectations.
* Conduct solution reviews, proposal reviews, risk reviews, and executive approval sessions.
* Support contract negotiations and clarification discussions until deal closure.
* Commercial Solutioning
* Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive and sustainable pricing models.
* Review effort estimates, resource plans, delivery locations, subcontractor costs, technology costs, and risk provisions.
* Support the development of fixed-price, time-and-material, managed services, outcome-based, and consumption-based commercial models.
* Evaluate deal profitability, gross margin, cash flow, investment requirements, and commercial risks.
* Recommend pricing strategies and optimisation opportunities without compromising delivery quality.
* Ensure alignment between solution commitments, pricing assumptions, service levels, and contractual obligations.
* Customer Engagement and Presentations
* Act as a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders throughout the sales cycle.
* Lead customer presentations, solution workshops, technical discussions, and executive briefings.
* Present complex technical solutions in clear business language.
* Articulate the business value, expected outcomes, return on investment, and transformation benefits of the proposed solution.
* Lead or coordinate demonstrations, prototypes, proofs of concept, and solution validation sessions.
* Address customer questions, objections, risks, and concerns with confidence and credibility.
* Build relationships with business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, procurement teams, and technology decision-makers.
* Industry and Technology Leadership
* Maintain a strong understanding of industry trends, emerging technologies, customer priorities, and competitive offerings.
* Provide inputs for service portfolio development, solution innovation, and go-to-market strategies.
* Develop industry-specific and technology-specific solutions, propositions, and sales materials.
* Collaborate with technology partners, cloud providers, software vendors, and alliance organisations.
* Represent the company at customer events, industry forums, webinars, and internal knowledge sessions.
* Support the creation of thought leadership content, case studies, white papers, and solution briefs.
* Sales and Business Development Support
* Support account planning, pipeline development, and opportunity creation.
* Participate in strategic account reviews and business planning sessions.
* Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing customer accounts.
* Support the development of new service offerings and market-entry strategies.
* Provide presales inputs for sales forecasts, revenue planning, and business reviews.

  Identify and build long-term relationships with schools, colleges, coaching institutes, and language academies within target catchment areas to strengthen regional presence.
* **Partnership Activation:**
  Activate and nurture key institutional accounts through well-defined engagement plans and continuous follow-through.
* **Account Planning:**
  Maintain a structured pipeline of institutional partners, mapping their academic calendars to ensure timely and relevant engagement activities.

**2. Local Demand & Lead Generation**

* **Outreach Initiatives:**
  Plan, coordinate, and execute a range of student outreach initiatives, including seminars, workshops, and webinars within partner institutions.
* **Event Management:**
  Organise and drive student participation for branch-level events, in-house education fairs, and university delegate visits.
* **Activity Calendar:**
  Calendarize the local city-level activities and monthly outreach schedules to ensure consistent market presence and efficient resource deployment.

**3. Hyperlocal Marketing Execution**

* **Identify Local Branding Opportunities:**
  Identify local branding opportunities including standees, posters, kiosks and outdoor branding.
* **Offline Visibility Campaigns:**
  Coordinate branch-level offline visibility campaigns near coaching hubs and educational clusters.
* **Tactical Activations:**
  Support local promotions and tactical activations to increase walk-ins (e.g., experiential pop-ups and student networking sessions).
* **Social Amplification:**
  Act as the social media champion for the local branch, capturing high-quality content and student testimonials during events for digital amplification.

**4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Reporting**

* **Sales Alignment:**
  Work collaboratively with the Branch Manager Sales and counselling teams to ensure seamless lead handovers, timely follow-ups, and a cohesive student conversion journey.
* **Budget & ROI Tracking:**
  Manage the assigned outreach budget efficiently, tracking the return on investment (ROI) and effectiveness of all local marketing activities.
* **Data & CRM Hygiene:**
  Ensure all event records, partner contacts, and performance metrics (lead volume, event participation) are accurately maintained within the CRM system.

**About the Candidate (including required competencies)**

* **Relationship Management:**
  Proven capability to network with senior stakeholders, institutional heads, and academic partners.
* **Execution & Autonomy:**
  Strong event coordination skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple engagements in a fast-paced environment.
* **Public Speaking:**
  Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to deliver engaging seminars to large student audiences.
* **Commercial Acumen:**
  Result-oriented mindset with a clear focus on data, performance reporting, and pipeline metrics.

**Requirements & Qualification**

* **Education:**
  University degree required; a Master’s degree or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.
* **Experience:**
  3–8 years of experience in field marketing, institutional sales, educational partnerships, or business development.
  *(Experience within the international education, study abroad, or EdTech sectors is highly desirable)*
  .
* **Mobility & Local Expertise:**
  Must be highly mobile, well-versed with the geography of the local city, and fluent in the local language. Willingness to travel frequently within the designated territory is essential.

title: Presales head - India (HCM Functional presales)
description:
Darwinbox is competing for the most complex enterprise HCM transformations in the market and the conversation is changing. As we move toward an AI-native HCM future and launch Cortex, our AI product, we need a Presales leader who can connect business problems, enterprise transformation, product capability, and commercial value into a story CXOs cannot ignore
  
  
We’re not looking for someone who simply presents the product.
  
  
We’re looking for someone who can shape the customer's thinking before they shape the solution.
  
  
Your role as India presales head is to make Darwinbox impossible to ignore in the enterprise HCM + AI conversation - shaping deals early, elevating the quality of customer conversations, increasing win rates, and building a presales organization that can scale with the business.
  
  
**What This Role Is**

* You will lead India Presales and a team of ~10-15, partnering closely with Sales and senior leaders to shape strategic enterprise and mid-market deals. You will be the person in the room who can understand what a business is trying to change, challenge the way it is thinking about the problem, and translate that into a compelling Darwinbox solution and business case.
* This is equal parts transformation advisor, deal strategist, and presales leader with the opportunity to influence how Darwinbox takes its next generation of HCM and AI capabilities to market.

**What Work Looks Like**

* Shape the deal before the demo. Partner with Sales from the earliest conversations to understand the account, shape the buying journey, qualify opportunities, and build a differentiated solution and value story.
* Be a CXO-level transformation advisor. Engage business leaders across functions, understand their strategic priorities, and connect HCM transformation to measurable business outcomes.
* Make complexity simple. Translate complex enterprise requirements into clear solution narratives, compelling demonstrations, POCs, and transformation roadmaps.
* Lead the India Presales engine. Set the strategy, operating rhythm, standards, resource model, and talent agenda for a 10-15-member organization; build capability and future leaders.
* Create a winning market motion. Define solution-led GTM strategies for new markets and product lines, strengthen competitive positioning, and identify what will move enterprise buyers.
* Turn the market into product insight. Bring customer and competitive intelligence into Product, influence roadmap discussions, and ensure market needs are represented in product decisions.
* Build AI-native presales. Use AI and modern tooling to improve research, discovery, solutioning, demos, POCs, and presales productivity—and help the organization operate differently as Darwinbox becomes AI-native.
* Drive initiatives. Participate and lead organizations initiatives as they come up from time to time

**Role expectations**

* Think beyond the RFP. Help customers rethink the problem before responding to the requirement.
* Own the commercial outcome. Balance customer value, solution quality, deal strategy, and presales investment to improve revenue, win rates, and sales velocity.
* Raise the talent bar. Build a high-performing team through coaching, capability building, succession planning, and strong standards for enterprise solution consulting.
* Influence without waiting for authority. Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership to move strategic opportunities and market priorities forward.
* Have a point of view. Bring conviction on enterprise HCM trends, competitive dynamics, AI, and how customers will buy and operate differently in the future.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 12–15+ years of experience with significant enterprise presales / solution consulting leadership; proven ability to lead and scale presales teams.
* strong understanding of HCM and enterprise technology; exceptional executive presence and storytelling; strong deal strategy and cross-functional influence; and a demonstrated ability to use AI and modern tooling to improve how presales operates.

**Why this role is different**
You won’t just help sell what Darwinbox has built. You’ll help shape how the market understands where enterprise HCM is going—and how Darwinbox, including Cortex, can lead that shift.
  
  
**About Darwinbox:**
Darwinbox is Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1400+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries.
  
  
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.

title: Senior Consultant - Cloud Infra & AI
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solution - Global Center for Innovation and Delivery (GCID) delivers end-to-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000+ exceptional people, MS GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles. The ideal consultant is passionate about technology, has breadth rather than specific product depth, and has the drive and courage to articulate and stand up for a great solution delivering true value for the client.
  
  
As a Microsoft Sr consultant, you will deliver quality engagements with your expertise, either as an advisor, reviewer, contributor, or resource in high profile projects to ensure customer value. The ideal candidate must have the ability to combine their technical skills, creativity, and customer focus to deliver great solutions to the customers and ensure they get the best out of our technologies and solutions. Consulting Delivery professionals bring subject matter and solution expertise to architectural teams, customers, and partners. They apply deep technical and business knowledge to accelerate the adoption of Microsoft devices and services by ensuring strategic, architectural, and operational alignment to customer and partner
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* As a full Stack Infrastructure Consultant, design, build, and optimize endtoend cloud and onpremises infrastructure solutions, ensuring secure, scalable, and highperforming environments across the entire technology stack.
* Responsible for technical quality assurance, identification, and mitigation of technical risk across customer or partner deliverables delivery technology strategy aligned solutions
* Applies technical experience and industry-specific knowledge to develop solutions, based on an analysis of how the proposed approach affects the business objectives of customers and partners.
* Applies information-compliance and assurance policies to ensure stakeholder confidence.
* Identifies new processes and innovations to help customers or partners build and accelerate capabilities by using Microsoft technologies.
* Identifies the best practice approach for a project, across a wide scope of technical issues, and develops or reuses intellectual capital with customers, world-wide, and for programs and initiatives across Microsoft.
* Defines engagements and opportunities to use Intellectual Property (IP) and address product gaps, while leveraging existing IP and community resources to ensure consistency and improve predictability.

**Qualifications**

* 9-13 years of industry experience with a minimum of 9+ years of Azure Infrastructure experience
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience; advanced technical certifications or higher education preferred.
* Mandatory Microsoft Azure Administrator certification (AZ104); Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ305) highly preferred.
* Terraform Associate certification strongly valued, with proven experience in InfrastructureasCode (IaC) automation.
* Cloud AI certification such as Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI‑900) or equivalent is a strong advantage, with practical understanding of AI/ML workloads on cloud platforms.
* Experience across both application architecture and cloud infrastructure domains, with the ability to bridge development and operations teams effectively.

AI First Infrastructure Skills
  
  

* Proficiency in Python for automation, AI integration, and scripting across infra workflows
* Experience with Azure AI Services (AI Foundry, AI Agent services, Azure AI Search, Vision, Speech, Translation,) leveraged as infrastructure components for applications
* Understanding of containerized AI workloads with strong hands-on expertise in AI Developer Tools from Microsoft- Visual Studio, GitHub Copilot, Azure AI Studio, Azure AI Foundry or similar third-party
* Ability to integrate OpenAI/Frontier models into cloud environments with secure and scalable infrastructure patterns (from applied AI delivery examples)

Azure Cloud Strategy, Networking and Devops
  
  
Cloud Strategy & Architecture
  
  

* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft’s Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
* Proven experience in designing, implementing, and deploying Azure Landing Zones.

Landing Zone and Networking
  
  

* Hands-on experience with Azure IaaS and PaaS services across compute, storage, and networking.
* Expertise in deploying business mission-critical applications on Azure.
* In-depth knowledge of Azure networking components including VNet, ExpressRoute, vWAN, ingress/egress patterns, and Network Virtual Appliances (NVAs)

DevOps & Automation
  
  

* Proficiency in Azure DevOps, including YAML-based pipeline configuration.
* Experience with at least one CI/CD platform: GitHub, GitLab, or Jenkins (working knowledge of others is a plus).
* Strong automation skills using ARM templates, Bicep, Terraform, PowerShell, and Azure CLI.
* Experience deploying infrastructure using a modular, reusable approach.

Multi Cloud Migration & Modernization
  
  

* Multi-Cloud Migration experience. Hands-on experience in AWS or GCP to Azure migration.
* Experience with large-scale cloud migration projects using tools like Azure Migrate.
* Familiarity with all stages of the migration lifecycle, including assessment, planning, execution, and optimization.
* Experience with container migration and modernization initiatives.

Infrastructure Security and Zero Trust Practices
  
  

* Strong command of network segmentation, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link, VPN/ExpressRoute security, and Zero Trust networking.
* Implement secure connectivity and encrypted network flows across hybrid and cloud environments.
* Implement Azure Policy, Blueprints, governance guardrails, and secure by design patterns.
* Experience in meeting compliance standards and performing cloud security assessments.
* Deploy secure landing zones following CAF & WAF (Cloud Adoption Framework & Well‑Architected Framework) principles ensuring governance, resiliency, and secure adoption paths
* Ensuring alignment with industry frameworks like Zero Trust principles

Consulting & Delivery Mindset
  
  

* Strong interest in continuous learning and technical certifications
* Curiosity to explore emerging data and AI technologies
* Willingness to receive feedback, grow technical depth, and expand ownership over time
* Demonstrated success in delivering customer-facing projects in large-scale enterprise environments
* Experience conducting technical workshops, envisioning sessions, and solution design engagements.
* Exposure to multiple industries and sectors, with the ability to tailor solutions to diverse business needs.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Passion for mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
* Proven adaptability to new technologies and evolving customer requirements.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Embody our culture and values
  
  
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Business Devolpment Executive
description:
We’re Hiring!Business Development Executive

About TripMeld

TripMeld is a Travel Technology and SaaS platform built to help travel agencies and tour operators manage their businesses more efficiently and grow faster. Our platform brings together lead management, customer follow-ups, quotations, websites, communication, automation, and business operations into one connected system.

We combine travel industry expertise, technology, AI, and automation to help travel businesses move from manual processes to smarter, more scalable ways of working. As we expand across India, we are looking for ambitious professionals who want to build careers in Business Development, SaaS, Travel Technology, and B2B Sales.

The Opportunity

Business Development Executive

* Location: Hyderabad
* Experience : Minimum 2 years
* Department: Sales & Marketing
* Industry: Travel Technology / SaaS
* Employment: Full-Time

You will help expand TripMeld's presence among travel businesses. You will connect with travel agencies and tour operators, understand their business challenges, introduce TripMeld's technology solutions, conduct product demonstrations, and help convert qualified prospects into customers.

The role combines travel industry knowledge with technology and business development. You will work closely with sales, marketing, and product teams to understand the market, generate opportunities, and contribute directly to business growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Business Development & Market Expansion

• Identify and research potential travel agencies, tour operators, travel consultants, and other travel businesses.

• Develop new business opportunities within the assigned market.

• Build relationships with travel-business owners and key decision-makers.

• Understand customer requirements, business processes, and operational challenges.

• Identify opportunities where TripMeld's technology can create value.

• Customer Engagement & Product Demonstrations

• Connect with prospects through meetings, calls, WhatsApp, email, and other channels.

• Visit prospective travel businesses when required and build face-to-face relationships.

• Conduct engaging and professional demonstrations of the TripMeld platform.

• Explain how TripMeld can improve lead management, follow-ups, quotations, communication, websites, and operations.

• Understand customer objections and communicate the value proposition effectively.

Sales & Conversion

• Manage prospects throughout the business development journey.

• Follow up consistently with qualified opportunities.

• Convert prospects into paying TripMeld customers.

• Work toward individual and team business development targets.

Market Intelligence

• Develop a strong understanding of the travel-agency ecosystem in Hyderabad.

• Identify market trends, customer needs, and emerging opportunities.

• Track competitor offerings and communicate relevant market insights to the team.

• Provide feedback that can improve TripMeld's product, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.

CRM & Business Reporting

• Maintain accurate prospect and customer information in TripMeld CRM.

• Record meetings, demos, follow-ups, opportunities, and conversions.

• Track pipeline and performance against targets.

• Share regular updates with the Business Development team.

What Makes This Role Different?

Preferred Educational Background

• BBA / MBA – Tourism & Travel Management

• BBA / MBA – Marketing

• Hospitality or related business programs

Experience

Freshers are welcome. Candidates with 1–2 years of experience in business development, sales, travel, tourism, hospitality, customer success, or other client-facing roles are also encouraged to apply.

• Performance-based incentives may be applicable based on the role and achievement.

How to Apply

Send your updated resume to:
hr@tripmeld.com

title: GTM(Go-To-Market Strategy) Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
At Techdome, growth is a system we build, not a campaign we run once. As our GTM Engineer, you will design and operate that system: figuring out which customers matter most, shaping how we talk to them, picking the channels where they actually pay attention, and turning ad spend into a predictable stream of qualified leads and revenue.
  
  
Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) will be your primary playground, alongside Google, LinkedIn, and emerging channels. You will own budgets, measure outcomes, and keep refining what works. If you like owning outcomes, thinking in numbers, and building growth engines from scratch, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Go-To-Market Strategy
  
  

* Define Techdome’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and pinpoint the segments with the highest potential.
* Craft sharp positioning and messaging for each product and service.
* Select the right channel mix for every offering.
* Lead launches end to end, from planning through live campaigns.
* Partner with design, product, and sales so our story stays consistent everywhere.

Paid Advertising
  
  

* Own Meta Ads from start to finish: audiences, creative testing, bidding, and scaling.
* Plan, launch, and scale campaigns on Google, LinkedIn, and new platforms.
* Manage ad budgets and make sure every rupee is working hard.
* Build and refine the full funnel, from first touch to closed deal.

Tracking & Analytics
  
  

* Set up and maintain tracking: pixels, Conversions API, event tagging, and UTM structures.
* Monitor CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS using GA4 and other analytics tools.
* Run A/B tests across ads, landing pages, messaging, and audiences, and document the learnings.
* Keep CRM data clean and report performance clearly to the team.

AI & Automation
  
  

* Use AI tools to accelerate ad copy, creative production, campaign optimization, and reporting.

**What You Bring**

* 1.5+ years in digital or performance marketing.
* Strong hands-on experience running Meta Ads.
* Track record of scaling campaigns across more than one ad platform.
* Experience building or executing go-to-market plans, including positioning, segmentation, and launches.
* Comfort owning a budget and being accountable for results.
* Solid grasp of funnels, audience segmentation, and retargeting.
* Working knowledge of GA4 and CRM or marketing automation tools.
* Familiarity with AI marketing tools such as copywriting assistants and creative generators.
* Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills.
* Clear communication and sharp analytical thinking.
* A proactive mindset and genuine excitement about building from zero.

**Nice to Have**

* Basic SQL.
* Experience with Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar product analytics tools.
* Background in product positioning, pricing, or marketing automation.
* Interest in AI-driven marketing analytics or predictive modeling.

**Why Join Techdome?**

* Real ownership: Run GTM strategy and campaigns that directly move company revenue.
* Autonomy from day one: Make decisions without waiting for layers of approval.
* Cross-team collaboration: Work side by side with product, sales, and design.
* Open culture: A flat team where new ideas are welcome and learning is fast.
* Career growth: A clear path to senior GTM or marketing leadership.
