title: Forward deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Company:**
Trida Labs

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**About Trida Labs**

Trida Labs builds AI-native products that help organizations work with enterprise data, analytics, and intelligent applications.

Our products include TridaPad, an AI-native data collaboration platform for querying, analyzing, visualizing, and managing enterprise data; AgentSQL, an agentic AI analytics solution for natural-language interaction with enterprise data; and TridaPad MCP Server, which enables AI assistants and MCP-compatible clients to interact with TridaPad capabilities.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers and turn business and technical requirements into working solutions using Trida Labs products.

You will work across customer discovery, data integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting. You will understand customer workflows, data environments, security requirements, and business needs, then configure and integrate our products to solve real-world problems.

You will also support customer pilots, technical demonstrations, and pre-sales engagements, validating solutions against customer-specific use cases and collaborating with engineering teams when product-level changes are required.

This is a customer-facing engineering role focused on configuring and extending existing capabilities rather than building customer-specific forks.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Understand customer workflows, technical requirements, data environments, and operational constraints.
* Translate business requirements into practical Trida Labs solutions.
* Identify required data sources, integrations, permissions, configurations, and deployment requirements.
* Assess technical feasibility, explain trade-offs, and define reusable implementation approaches.

**2. Pre-Sales, Pilots & Proofs of Concept**

* Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, pilots, and proofs of concept.
* Demonstrate how TridaPad and AgentSQL address customer use cases.
* Configure representative customer environments and validate technical requirements.
* Identify integration, security, and deployment constraints and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

**3. Product Implementation & Data Integration**

* Deploy and configure TridaPad and AgentSQL for customer requirements.
* Configure data sources, database connections, permissions, schemas, and analytics workflows.
* Integrate enterprise databases and platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks.
* Understand customer data models, relationships, and business metrics.
* Validate data accessibility and troubleshoot connectivity, permission, schema, query, and integration issues.

**4. AI & Analytics Implementation**

* Configure existing AI and analytics capabilities for customer use cases.
* Adapt prompts, context, tools, and application workflows where appropriate.
* Validate natural-language analytics, SQL generation, analytical results, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries.
* Diagnose unreliable AI outputs and distinguish data, configuration, context, model, and product issues.
* Collaborate with specialist engineering teams when core product changes are needed.

**5. Security, Access & MCP Integrations**

* Support customer security questionnaires, technical reviews, and access requirements.
* Coordinate VPN, IP allowlisting, private connectivity, restricted network, and other environment-specific requirements.
* Support self-hosted deployments in customer cloud or on-premises environments where applicable.
* Apply least-privilege principles and follow requirements for handling production data, PII, credentials, logs, and debugging information.
* Configure and validate MCP integrations with AI assistants, internal applications, and customer workflows, including authentication, permissions, and tool access.

**6. Customer Evaluation & Validation**

* Build customer-specific golden question sets containing representative business questions, expected SQL, and verified analytical results.
* Test customer configurations against schemas, terminology, metrics, permissions, and real-world questions.
* Rerun relevant tests after product, model, prompt, or configuration changes.
* Validate SQL, analytics, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries against expected outcomes.
* Track regressions, communicate actionable findings, and maintain versioned customer-specific configuration artifacts.

**7. Deployment & Production Troubleshooting**

* Prepare implementation plans and technical validation checklists.
* Support deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot application, API, database, AI, integration, and deployment issues using logs, traces, errors, and reproduction steps.
* Validate fixes against customer-relevant scenarios and support releases, upgrades, and post-deployment checks.
* Coordinate infrastructure and platform-level issues with the appropriate engineering teams.

**8. Customer Feedback & Engineering Collaboration**

* Identify recurring customer problems and distinguish implementation needs from core product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback with technical details, reproduction steps, expected behavior, and customer impact.
* Identify opportunities to convert repeated implementation work into reusable product capabilities, tools, or documentation.
* Collaborate with AI, AI Agent, Data & AI, Backend, Platform, NLP/ML, and Product teams.
* Reduce customer-specific workarounds and avoid unnecessary product forks.

**Role Ownership**

* **Forward Deployed Engineer:**
  Owns customer discovery, solution design, implementation, integration, configuration, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer-facing technical delivery.
* **AI Engineer:**
  Owns reusable user-facing AI features and AI-powered application experiences.
* **AI Agent Engineer:**
  Owns agent orchestration, behavior, tool workflows, and core agent capabilities.
* **Data & AI Engineer:**
  Owns data connectivity, schema and metadata systems, semantic representations, and cross-database data correctness.
* **NLP/ML Engineer:**
  Owns model-level NLP and generation quality, including SQL-generation capabilities.
* **Platform Engineer:**
  Owns infrastructure, model access, deployment systems, observability, security, and platform-level connectivity.
* **Backend Engineer:**
  Owns core backend services, APIs, business logic, and shared application services.

The Forward Deployed Engineer configures and extends existing capabilities, validates customer deployments, and escalates core product changes to the appropriate teams rather than maintaining customer-specific forks.

**Customer Engagement Expectations**

* Work directly with customers across different technical and business environments.
* Support customer meetings and deployments across relevant time zones when required.
* Be willing to travel for customer meetings, workshops, deployments, and go-live activities when necessary.
* Manage multiple implementation activities while maintaining clear priorities and communication.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technical consulting, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience with APIs, databases, backend services, enterprise applications, and data integrations.
* Strong understanding of data workflows, SQL, and technical troubleshooting.
* Experience working with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams.
* Familiarity with LLMs, Generative AI, and AI-powered applications.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate issues using logs, errors, configurations, and reproduction steps.
* Strong communication skills and comfort supporting customer environments and production deployments.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and competing priorities effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Technical Implementation.
* Experience supporting product demonstrations, pilots, or proofs of concept.
* Experience with AI analytics, natural-language-to-SQL, or enterprise data applications.
* Experience with AI agents, tool calling, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
* Experience with MCP and AI assistant integrations.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker and cloud or deployment platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Render, or Vercel.
* Experience with production deployments, AI evaluation, regression testing, observability, or production AI troubleshooting.

**Key Skills**

Python | SQL | APIs | Databases | Enterprise Data | System Integration | Generative AI | LLMs | AI Applications | Natural-Language-to-SQL | Data Analytics | AI Agents | MCP | Docker | Cloud | Customer Deployment | Production Troubleshooting | Technical Implementation | Technical Communication

**Why Join Trida Labs?**

At Trida Labs, you will work directly on real AI systems solving enterprise data and analytics problems.

You will collaborate with customers and engineering teams across solution design, AI implementation, enterprise data integration, evaluation, production troubleshooting, and product improvement—helping turn real customer requirements into reliable, reusable product capabilities.

**Equal Opportunity**

Trida Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

title: Senior Consultant
description:
GAEC ABROAD is an international education consulting firm specializing in academic counseling for students aspiring to study abroad and providing comprehensive global education services. We are committed to offering personalized guidance to students across India, helping them make informed decisions about their international academic journeys.

Our team works closely with students to understand their academic backgrounds, career aspirations, and personal goals, recommending suitable universities and programs worldwide. At GAEC ABROAD, we prioritize personalized counseling, ethical practices, effective marketing, and long-term student success in the global education landscape.

**Role Description**

GAEC ABROAD is seeking an experienced and results-driven
**Senior Consultant – Overseas Education & Marketing**
to join our team in Hyderabad. This is a full-time, on-site position requiring a minimum of
**4 years of relevant experience**
in overseas education consulting, student recruitment, marketing, or related fields.

The candidate will be responsible for student counseling, university admissions, lead generation, marketing campaigns, and business development. The role requires an individual who can effectively counsel students, develop marketing strategies, generate quality leads, convert inquiries into enrollments, and contribute to the overall growth of GAEC ABROAD.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Student Counseling & Admissions**

* Provide personalized counseling to students regarding international universities, courses, admission requirements, and career opportunities.
* Evaluate student profiles and recommend suitable universities and programs based on academic backgrounds, budgets, and career goals.
* Guide students through applications, documentation, offer letters, and admission timelines.
* Provide updated information on international education trends, admission policies, and visa procedures.
* Follow up with students and parents to convert inquiries into successful enrollments.
* Maintain accurate student records, application updates, and follow-up activities using CRM systems.

**Marketing & Lead Generation**

* Plan and execute marketing strategies to promote GAEC ABROAD's overseas education services.
* Generate student leads through digital marketing, social media, educational events, seminars, webinars, and other promotional activities.
* Coordinate with digital marketing teams to develop campaigns across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google.
* Support the creation of marketing content, promotional materials, advertisements, and student success stories.
* Identify new marketing opportunities, student segments, and potential business partnerships.
* Organize and participate in education fairs, school and college visits, workshops, and student recruitment events.
* Monitor marketing campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and return on investment.
* Build brand awareness and strengthen GAEC ABROAD's presence in the overseas education market.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Minimum
  **4 years of relevant professional experience**
  in overseas education consulting, student recruitment, marketing, or business development.
* Strong knowledge of international education destinations, university admissions, and student visa processes.
* Experience in lead generation, student conversion, digital marketing, or promotional campaign management.
* Excellent communication, counseling, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Understanding of social media marketing, online advertising, and marketing campaign performance.
* Ability to manage multiple student cases, marketing activities, and deadlines.
* Proficiency in CRM platforms, student management systems, and standard office software.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Marketing, Management, Business Administration, Education, or a related field.
* A proactive, target-oriented mindset with strong organizational and relationship-building skills.
* Commitment to ethical counseling, transparent marketing, and delivering a positive student experience.

title: Senior Manager, Growth and Commercial Delivery
description:
**Opportunity Overview**
We are seeking a high-caliber, results-oriented
**Senior Manager, Growth and Commercial Delivery**
to sit at the intersection of sales, account management, and implementation. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end commercial lifecycle for health plan (payer) clients—from driving growth and supporting late-stage sales cycles to leading complex, cross-functional implementations. You will be responsile for ensuring that our commercial commitments translate into operational success and long-term revenue growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Growth & Commercial Strategy: Partner with executive leadership and sales teams to accelerate the growth pipeline, design commercial proposals, and define go-to-market strategies for health plan clients.
* Deal-to-Delivery Transition: Serve as the primary bridge between the sales pipeline and operations, owning the transition from contract signing to live operational delivery.
* Implementation & Delivery Leadership: Oversee cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Data Science) to deploy our AI-driven utilization management solutions on time, within scope, and aligned with client metrics.
* Relationship Management: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and clinical leaders at partner health plans, managing governance structures and steering committees.
* Value Realization & Retention: Define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and clinical value metrics to prove ROI, drive contract renewals, and identify upsell opportunities.
* Process Scaling: Build and refine repeatable playbooks, governance models, and delivery frameworks to support rapid company scaling.

**ISMS Roles And Responsibilities**

* Good knowledge of Information security
* Oversee specific business processes within the ISMS.
* Responsible to manage the ISMS documentation, conduct risk assessments, and implement risk treatment plans.
* Risk Owners are responsible for identifying, assessing, and managing risks within their areas of responsibility.
* They are also responsible for implementing risk treatment plans.
* Conduct the BCP and other test related to information security continuity along with CISO
* Responsible for monitoring and reporting on the performance of the ISMS.
* Responsible for implementation of security policies and procedures and report any issues to the CISO.

**What You’ll Need**

* Experience: 6–9 years of professional experience, with at least 3–4 years in healthcare management consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or specialized healthcare firms) or a commercial delivery/implementation role at a high-growth digital health/health tech company.
* Payer Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of US health insurance operations, utilization management, prior authorization, payment integrity, value-based care, or network management.
* Project Management Skills: Proven track record of managing large-scale, multi-million dollar software implementations or strategic transformations with health plans.
* Analytical Rigor: Strong financial and operational acumen with the ability to translate complex data and clinical outcomes into a compelling business case for clients.
* Communication Style: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with comfort navigating difficult conversations and aligning diverse stakeholders.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Engineering, or related field required. An MBA or MHA is highly preferred.

**Ability To Commute/relocate**

* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

* Connect with Talent Acquisition
* Meet with the Hiring Manager
* Behavioral Interview(s)
* Case Study
* Interview with Senior Leadership
* Subject to change

Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI-powered solutions connect health plans’ strategic goals and providers’ needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we expanded our AI-native platform with a comprehensive Payment Integrity Suite that spans data mining, clinical and coding validation, authorization and claims reconciliation, and end-to-end payment integrity services across pre- and post-pay workflows. By connecting clinical and payment insights, our transparent, AI-powered solutions help health plans proactively improve payment accuracy, reduce waste and vendor dependency, strengthen provider relationships, and build smarter, more efficient payment integrity programs.
  
  
Cohere Health’s innovations continue to receive industry-wide recognition. We’ve been recognized on TIME’s World Top HealthTech Companies 2025 list, the 2025 Inc. 5000 list, in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022-2025), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 & 2024.

* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.

Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Clinical Data domain. You will drive impactful product communication and champion customer success with our Clinical Data Management applications, Veeva EDC and Veeva DQS, partnering closely with our customers in India. You will also continuously grow your own expertise by staying at the absolute cutting edge of AI and digital transformation in clinical trials.
  
  
As part of the global Product Expert team, you will play a key role in the Product organization. Most importantly you will:
  
  

* Build and foster highly engaged Users Communities; regularly engage with the customers in a range of forums to provide clear and impactful communication that drives shared understanding & education, promotes product adoption, and delivers customer value.
* Represent the Product organization in customer meetings, online communities, and at industry events.
* Drive increased customer value through release education and product capability promotion.

+ AI & Digital transformation
+ Risk-based decision making
+ Regulatory compliance
+ A culture of continuous improvement
+ Excellence across the pharmaceutical industry

* Collaborate effectively with Veeva field teams to drive customer success, product excellence, best practices, and Veeva Product success.

To apply for this role, you must have recent hands-on experience in either Veeva EDC or Veeva DQS.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Be the product evangelist and provide subject matter expertise for the Veeva EDC and Veeva DQS products, staying up to date with the latest features and communicating Product roadmap directions.
* Act as a champion for Veeva's key product enhancements (for example, learning the overarching Veeva AI and RBQM visions to effectively guide customers through their transformation journeys together with Veeva colleagues).
* Provide product education to Veeva Clinical Data customers in meetings (in a range of forums) and our online communities (Veeva Connect); Ensuring we are communicating the problems we are solving, value delivered and product functionality.
* Be the customer advocate internally. Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer feedback. Feed these insights into release planning, contributing to future product innovations.
* Collaborate with Product teams to deliver valuable content and resources for product and release communication.

We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
  
  
**What You'll Do At Pega**
**Technical Sales Strategy and Execution**

* Use Pega AI Blueprint and Predictable AI to help our customers across Financial Services, Insurance, Communications, Healthcare and Manufacturing to drive outcomes, innovate, reduce costs and modernize their legacy estate.

* Lead the team in execution of Pega Sales strategy with focus on Blueprint and the Solution Designer approach.
* Secure execution and compliance with Solutions Consulting tasks and goals (Spending time with and at our customers, Blueprint adoption, Training and use of Pega's sales automation system).
* Drive and support the innovation and adoption of initiatives, reusable assets, selling programs, enablement, to scale the success of Pega's core technologies.
* Collaborate and foster strong partnerships with internal leaders in Specialists, Product Development, Product Marketing, Alliances, Industry Business Units, and other peer Specialist organizations globally at Pega.

**People Development**

* Lead the team towards the best Solution Designers in the industry.
* Cultivate your team of direct reports through coaching, goal-setting, and performance management, with a focus on developing expertise in their chosen domain or the client they support
* Develop and maintain cutting-edge Solutions Consultant knowledge of Pega AI Blueprint, Pega Platform, GenAI capabilities, and other core Pega technologies in partnership with the Product teams.

Oversee the Solutions Consultants to ensure accurate planning and coordination of all requests for resources from the sales field to ensure a balanced workload across the team.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* An ambitious leader, coach and someone who will roll up sleeves to work on their own account with an understanding and background in one or more of the following domains - Financial Services, Insurance, Communications, Healthcare and Manufacturing
* Passionate about people, Pega AI Blueprint, technology, and the transformative potential of workflow and Predictable AI.

* You proactively develop relationships with prospects by understanding, anticipating and showcasing AI-powered solutions that meet the unique business needs customers in these fields
* Willing to travel throughout the region to support the business.

You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
* You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

title: Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering
description:
**Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering**

**Field**

**Detail**

**Job Title**

Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering

**Function / Practice**

Digital, Data & AI — Technology & Solutions

**Reports To**

Head of Architecture / Practice Head — Digital & AI

**Experience**

15+ years in software, data and cloud engineering, including 5+ years in an architect capacity

**Location**

Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Pune (Hybrid), with travel to client sites as required

**Employment Type**

Full-time, Permanent

**Grade / Band**

Principal Architect

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Cyient is looking for a Principal Architect who can operate at the intersection of cloud platform engineering, agentic AI and modern data engineering — and who is equally comfortable in front of a customer as in a design review.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing architecture role. You will own end-to-end solution architecture for strategic engagements, shape winning proposals and RFP responses, build demos and proofs of concept alongside the delivery team, and set the technical direction that engineering teams execute against. You will also mentor architects and senior engineers, and partner with fellow architects across practices to drive reusable assets, accelerators and an active innovation agenda.

Success in this role looks like architecture decisions that survive production, customers who ask for you by name, proposals that convert, and a bench of engineers who are measurably stronger because you invested in them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution & Cloud Architecture**

* **Own end-to-end architecture**
  for large, multi-workstream programs spanning cloud infrastructure, data platforms and AI services.
* **Design cloud-native solutions**
  on Microsoft Azure (or AWS ) covering compute, networking, identity, integration, observability, cost management and security.
* **Define the non-functional architecture**
  — scalability, resilience, latency, availability, disaster recovery and multi-tenancy — and hold designs accountable to it.
* **Establish architecture governance**
  : reference architectures, design standards, review checkpoints, a technology radar and architecture decision records (ADRs).
* **Drive cloud modernisation**
  and migration strategy — landing zones, containerisation, microservices, event-driven patterns and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / Bicep / ARM).

**Agentic AI & Applied GenAI**

* **Architect agentic AI systems**
  — multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, planning and reflection loops, memory, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* **Select and integrate the AI stack**
  : LLM providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight models), orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP-based tooling) and vector / retrieval layers.
* **Design production-grade RAG**
  and knowledge-grounding pipelines — chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citation.
* **Define AI evaluation and guardrails**
  : accuracy and hallucination benchmarks, red-teaming, prompt-injection defence, PII handling, cost and token governance, and model observability.
* **Operationalise LLMOps**
  — prompt versioning, CI/CD for AI assets, regression evaluations, drift monitoring and safe rollout patterns.
* **Champion Responsible AI**
  principles — transparency, traceability, bias assessment and auditability — aligned to client and regulatory expectations.

**Data Engineering & Platform**

* **Architect modern data platforms**
  — lakehouse and medallion architectures on Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake or equivalent.
* **Design batch and streaming pipelines**
  using Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, Azure Data Factory and dbt, with clear SLAs on freshness and data quality.
* **Establish data governance**
  : cataloguing, lineage, master data management, quality frameworks and access control (Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview).
* **Model data for both analytics and AI consumption**
  , ensuring the same governed assets serve BI, ML and agentic workloads.
* **Optimise for cost and performance**
  — partitioning, storage tiering, compute right-sizing and workload isolation.

**Customer Engagement & Presales**

* **Act as the senior technical face to the customer**
  — run discovery workshops, architecture reviews and executive briefings for both engineering and CxO audiences.
* **Translate business problems into solution options**
  , with honest trade-offs on cost, risk, time-to-value and long-term maintainability.
* **Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs and proactive proposals**
  — solution narrative, architecture diagrams, delivery approach, effort estimation, staffing model and risk register.
* **Build compelling demos and proofs of concept**
  with the team — tightly scoped, built fast, and mapped to a measurable customer outcome.
* **Support deal shaping**
  alongside sales and account teams: value articulation, differentiation, competitive positioning and defence of the proposed architecture.
* **Own the technical narrative post-win**
  , ensuring that what was sold is what gets designed and delivered.

**Leadership, Mentoring & Innovation**

* **Guide and mentor**
  architects, tech leads and senior engineers through design reviews, pairing, structured feedback and career conversations.
* **Collaborate with peer architects**
  across practices and geographies to align on standards, resolve cross-domain design conflicts and avoid duplicated effort.
* **Drive the innovation agenda**
  : identify emerging technologies, run experiments and spikes, and convert successful ones into reusable accelerators, frameworks and IP.
* **Build the capability bench**
  — define skill paths, run internal enablement sessions and raise the architectural maturity of the practice.
* **Represent Cyient externally**
  through whitepapers, conference talks, partner forums and customer advisory sessions.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of overall IT experience, including 5+ years in a formal architect role on large-scale distributed systems.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure (preferred) or equivalent depth in AWS or GCP — demonstrable production ownership, not design-deck experience alone.
* Proven delivery of at least one production agentic AI or applied GenAI solution, from architecture through evaluation, guardrails and go-live.
* Strong data engineering background: lakehouse architectures, distributed processing (Spark), streaming and enterprise-scale data governance.
* Demonstrated presales and customer-facing track record — owned technical solutioning on proposals and RFPs that converted.
* Hands-on coding credibility in Python and one of Java / C# / Scala; able to build a POC personally when it matters.
* Experience with DevOps and platform engineering practices: CI/CD, IaC, containerisation, Kubernetes and observability tooling.
* Track record of mentoring senior technical talent and leading architecture communities of practice.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to hold a room of engineers and a room of executives with equal effect.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Azure certifications: Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or AI Engineer Associate (AI-103); equivalent AWS certifications equally valued.
* Databricks, Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric certification.
* Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent interoperability standards and enterprise agent platforms.
* Domain exposure in one or more Cyient focus verticals: Aerospace & Defence, Rail & Transportation, Energy & Utilities, MedTech / Healthcare, Semiconductor or Communications.
* Experience building reusable accelerators, platforms or IP adopted across multiple accounts.
* Prior work in a services, consulting or systems-integrator environment with multi-client, multi-geography delivery.
* Published thought leadership, patents or active open-source contribution.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS SNAPSHOT**

**Area**

**Technologies & Practices**

**Cloud Platforms**

Azure (AKS, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Entra ID, Monitor); AWS or GCP equivalents

**Agentic AI / GenAI**

Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight LLMs; LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP; RAG, vector stores, evaluations, guardrails, LLMOps

**Data Engineering**

Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake; Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, ADF, dbt, Delta Lake; Purview, Unity Catalog

**Architecture Patterns**

Microservices, event-driven, domain-driven design, API-first, lakehouse / medallion, multi-tenancy, zero-trust security

**Engineering & DevOps**

Python, SQL, Java / C# / Scala; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform / Bicep, Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry

**Consulting Skills**

Discovery workshops, solution storytelling, estimation, RFP response, POC and demo build, executive communication

**Company Description**
Bounten is a premium water softener brand dedicated to improving quality of life through better water. The company provides eco-friendly, cost-effective, and long-lasting water softening solutions for homes, businesses, and industries across India. With its advanced Zoftnor range, Bounten transforms hard water into soft, healthier water that helps protect skin, hair, clothes, appliances, and plumbing systems. Its technology reduces scaling, corrosion, and bacteria without chemicals or water wastage, delivering comfort, health benefits, and savings. Thousands of customers rely on Bounten for a smarter, cleaner way of living with soft water.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad for Tele Callers and Field Executives. Tele Callers will handle outbound and inbound calls, explain Bounten’s products and services, qualify leads, schedule appointments or demos, and maintain accurate records in CRM or call logs. They will follow up with potential customers, respond to basic queries, and coordinate with the sales team to support conversions. * Candidates should possess customer service, relationship management, and basic sales or lead conversion skills.

* Candidates should possess presentation and product demonstration skills, along with the ability to explain technical concepts in simple terms.
* Candidates should possess time management, planning, and follow-up skills to handle daily call targets and field visits.
* Comfort with field work in Hyderabad, including travel to customer locations, and willingness to work on-site full time.
* Prior experience in telecalling, field sales, or customer-facing roles in consumer products or home solutions is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification of high school completion; a diploma or bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* Proficiency in English and local languages commonly spoken in Hyderabad, with a professional and respectful approach to all customers.

* Experience in a customer-facing Solutions Architect, Partner Solutions Architect, Presales Architect, Consulting Architect, or equivalent role
* Experience supporting complex enterprise bids, tenders, RFPs, or strategic pursuits
* Proven ability to design and communicate distributed, scalable, secure, and highly available architectures
* Experience working with Global System Integrators (GSIs), including GSI sales, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, modern application architectures, microservices, APIs, data platforms, and DevOps

* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Executive Deal Sponsorship: Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization: Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM: Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* Deal & Technical Escalation: Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* Architectural & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) prior to contract signature.
* Strategic Product Advocacy: Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* AI/Automation Acumen: Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* Comprehensive Core Networking: Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* Advanced Wireless & 5G: Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* Voice/UC Expertise: Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* Cloud Computing Expertise: Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

:

:

:

:

* Consult and support internal and external partners when dealing with complex processes and IT application questions.

* Showing strong transactional experience in SAP R3 and/or S4/HANA (SD / MM)
* Ability to work and navigate in SAP middleware platforms (PO, CPI Integration Suite)
* Provides a deep technical understanding of standard connectivity messages EDI-APIs and programming protocols (supporting e.g. iDocs, XML, EDIFACT, JSON, UI etc.)
* Execute studies in preliminary stages of projects, including evaluation of existing or new solutions
* Familiar with Azure DevOps (or GitHub or similar)
* Consult and support IT analysis (process and/or data), mentoring, modeling, solution design and optimization of related business processes and models
* Coordinate and execute prototyping, configuration and testing of solutions based on BASF requirements, while ensuring quality and security aspects
* Provide structured acceptance, analysis and description of solutions and/or concepts
* Support and/or steer the formulation of more complex costs estimates for efforts spend solution design, testing and implementation of business solutions
* Provides Business support and training (processes, tools, reports, etc.) where required
* Provide guidance and structure to enable day2day operational support incl, advising external support resources
* Extensive knowledge of standard connectivity messages, related business processes and applications

* You can demonstrate fluent communication skills in English (spoken and written)
* Well-developed sense of teamwork in an international team with strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication and conflict resolution skills.
* Business consulting skill with a focus on value generation
* Ambitious, proactive & entrepreneurial character
* Highly developed sense of responsibility
* High customer- and innovation-orientation

**Nice to have:**

* Experiences as project manager
* Experiences in strategic planning and realization
* Experiences in AI Agents and AI based communciation
* Certifications in Agile, SAP S/4

**Language Proficiency:**
Fluent spoken and written English proficiency.

Be part of a global leader in digital transformation, working in a vibrant Digital Hub that values innovation, agility, and cross-functional collaboration. Shape the future of BASF’s digital landscape, contributing to projects that drive sustainability and make a real impact. Thrive in a high-performance culture that supports your personal and professional growth, offering diverse learning opportunities and career development. Enjoy a modern, inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your curiosity and ambition are encouraged. Benefit from flexible working models, international networking, and a strong sense of purpose as we enable our customers’ green transformation and lead the way in digital excellence.

* Enterprise and Growth Strategy consulting experience - Corporate Strategy, Go-to-market (GTM) Strategy, Business Unit Growth Strategy, Roadmap Development, Business Model, Capability Assessment, Efficiency Plays, Cost Take-out, Market Research / Assessment, Business Planning, Business & Digital Transformation, Vendor Assessment, Operating Model Assessment, etc.) within Insurance Industry
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends within the Insurance industry. Interest and knowledge about the current trends in any one of its sectors (Life, Commercial, Personal, Specialty, Reinsurance etc.)
* Demonstrate ability to understand and analyze business issues and leverage technology to solve them
* Preferred experience of engaging in strategic issues with senior-level clients including C-Suite executives
* Exposure to working in non-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders
* Exposure around building dynamic Excel models and macros for market sizing, forecasting, and automation of repetitive analysis and reporting tasks
* Ability to craft structured generative research prompts and use tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude or MS Copilot in Excel/PowerPoint) to streamline research, create slides, synthesize interviews, or simulate models
* Experience in developing and deploying LLM tools to accelerate research, generate summaries, and support slide creation

* Clear and concise communication - Conduct client interviews, participate in workshops / trainings and present recommendations; strong verbal and written skills are critical
* Good client presence – Interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
* Analytical thinking – Comfortable with managing large data sets, ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary), synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data through configurable dashboards; familiarity with Python, and Excel Macro scripting is nice to have
* Logical structuring - Structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline-oriented and quality focused – Support team in development of deliverables, manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Ownership – Take ownership, manage and co-ordinate activities and tasks assigned and drive to completion
* Network - ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.

**#FY27ReferralCampaign**
**Required Qualifications**
**For Consultants:**

* MBA or MS from a premier (Tier-1) school in India or abroad (not more than 6 years post MS / MBA)
* 4 to 5 years of relevant experience (post MS / MBA) in Insurance Industry
* Experience in consulting, or corporate strategy environment strongly preferred
* 3+ years of industry experience with Insurance industry focus (preferably US clients)

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. title: Delivery Consultant - Databases, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms & Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
  
  
You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof-of-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
  
  
Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  
Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  
  
Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  
  
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  
  
Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 & s3)

title: Senior Associate, Strategy and Growth
description:
The Senior Associate, Strategy and Growth is part of the build-out of the Strategy team. This hire adds dedicated capacity across the team's strategy and growth agenda: sizing and prioritizing growth opportunities, evaluating portfolio and pricing performance, building business cases, and preparing executive materials.
  
  
The role sits at the threshold of manager. Projects of moderate complexity are run largely independently, with 80 to 90 percent ownership, and the most complex initiatives are supported alongside the Senior Director, Strategy and Growth, and the team. Exceptional candidates may be considered at Manager level.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Growth strategy and opportunity sizing. Size and prioritize growth opportunities across new products, adjacent markets, partner and channel models, and pricing, using top-down and bottom-up approaches with clearly stated assumptions.
* Project leadership. Run moderate-complexity strategy projects from scoping to final recommendation, and support the Senior Director, Strategy and Growth, and the team on the most complex initiatives.
* Portfolio and product performance. Analyze ARR, retention, bookings, packaging, and price across the product portfolio. Identify the drivers of performance and quantify the levers available to improve it.
* Business cases and scenario modeling. Build financial models and business cases for initiatives, investments, and strategic options, with sensitivities and a recommended path.
* Executive communication. Produce board, executive team, and cross-functional materials with an answer-first storyline, tight visuals, and precise language. Present findings to senior stakeholders.
* Cross-functional partnership. Work with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Pricing teams to gather inputs, test hypotheses, and carry recommendations into planning and execution.
* Strategic planning support. Contribute to annual and long-range planning cycles, offsite preparation, and the tracking of strategic initiatives.
* Market and competitive intelligence. Provide market and competitive perspective to growth work, using research platforms and AI tools to maintain a current view of the landscape.

**Preferred**
Required Skills
  
  

* Experience in enterprise B2B software or SaaS, including subscription metrics, pricing and packaging, and partner or channel models.
* Familiarity with document processing, workflow automation, RPA, or AP automation.
* Fluency with AI tools to compress research, analysis, and synthesis time, with specific examples.
* Experience with research platforms such as Gartner, IDC, Forrester, Capital IQ, PitchBook, or CB Insights is an asset.
* Prior experience in a CEO office, CxO office, or chief-of-staff style role, or in M&A diligence.

Competencies
  
  

* Structured thinking. Frames ambiguous problems into clear questions and tests them with evidence.
* Commercial judgment. Connects analysis to revenue, margin, and customer outcomes.
* Communication. Writes and presents with precision and gets to the point quickly.
* Ownership. Drives work to completion, checks accuracy, and raises risks early.
* Collaboration across time zones. Works effectively with US-based leaders and global colleagues.

**Qualifications**
Required Experience
  
  
**Required**

* 2 to 5 years of experience, including at least 3 years in management consulting, corporate strategy, strategy and operations, or a strategic insights function.
* Demonstrated market sizing and growth analysis, with an example of an analysis that informed a business decision.
* Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with working knowledge of SQL and Power BI to retrieve and analyze data independently.
* Strong PowerPoint and written communication skills, including experience presenting to director level and above.
* Hypothesis-driven approach to problem solving, and the ability to own projects with limited direction.
* MBA or equivalent master's degree preferred.
* Fluent business English, written and spoken.

description:

Cravioo is a growing organization focused on delivering high-quality solutions and services to its clients. The company values collaboration, clear communication, and strong customer relationships to drive successful outcomes. Team members are encouraged to take initiative, contribute ideas, and support continuous improvement across processes. Cravioo offers an environment where individuals can develop their skills while working closely with clients and colleagues. The company is committed to maintaining an inclusive, respectful, and performance-driven workplace.

**Role Description**

The Onboarding Specialist at Cravioo is a part-time, on-site role based in the Greater Hyderabad Area.

In this role, the specialist guides new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth transition from initial sign-up to active use of Cravioo’s products or services.

Day-to-day tasks include conducting onboarding meetings, gathering client requirements, configuring accounts, and walking clients through product features and best practices.

The specialist also responds to client questions, identifies potential issues early, and coordinates with internal teams to resolve them. Maintaining accurate onboarding documentation, tracking progress, and providing clear status updates to clients and stakeholders are key aspects of this position.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, contact, and visit local restaurant owners to introduce them to our platform.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential restaurant partners within assigned territories.
* Conduct outreach through calls, in-person visits, and relationship-building activities to onboard new merchants.
* Clearly explain the app’s features, pricing structure, and value proposition to restaurant owners.
* Demonstrate how the platform can help increase delivery sales and improve restaurant operations.
* Guide restaurant owners through the onboarding process, including account registration and profile setup.
* Assist in uploading menus, adding business information, setting banking details, and configuring operating hours.
* Train restaurant staff on how to use the merchant dashboard and manage incoming digital orders.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for new partners during their first 30 days to ensure a smooth launch.
* Track onboarding progress, resolve merchant issues, and maintain high conversion and activation rates.
* Collaborate with internal teams to improve merchant experience and support growth targets.

* Strong client-facing skills, including Customer Onboarding and Client Onboarding capabilities.
* Excellent Interpersonal Skills and Communication skills for engaging with clients and internal teams.
* Solid Analytical Skills to understand client needs, interpret data, and troubleshoot onboarding challenges.
* Ability to manage multiple onboarding processes, prioritize tasks, and maintain organized records.
* Experience in customer success, account management, or implementation roles is beneficial.
* Comfort working on-site in the Greater Hyderabad Area and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

* Relevant education in business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Mobility**

* Willingness to travel locally to meet restaurant owners face-to-face.

Performance Incentives

You will have opportunity to earn incentives up to ₹25,000 per month based on achievements.

description:

fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
