You'll own a portfolio of our most strategic accounts and guide customers through best practices and hands-on configuration to drive outcomes and deepen adoption. You'll stay technically fluent in Outreach's evolving capabilities, AI included, so you can configure and troubleshoot in real time.
  
  
The role mixes technology and business consulting with solution design and project management. You'll work closely with Customer Success and Account Executives, build rapport fast, and influence customer outcomes.
  
  
You'll own results for your book of business against Managed Services KPIs, and report to a Practice Manager, Managed Services.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators: Manage a book of business with an average QoQ utilization rate of 70%, with a focus on Amplify credit and product consumption — ultimately supporting renewal rates and the minimization of churn and contraction.
  
  
Location: This is a remote role, based in Hyderabad. There may be occasional in-person or team events and if asked to attend, it will be during local IST hours.
  
  
Working Hours: This is a customer-facing role and will require working US-based hours (night-shift allowance provided).
  
  
Your Daily Adventures Will Include
  
  

* Build, configure, and tune new AI Agents (Revenue, Deal, Research, Conversation, Forecasting) beyond initial implementation to expand automation and drive credit consumption
* Design and manage context-aware prompts for each customer's AI Agent use cases
* Be the subject matter expert on Outreach's AI Agents and embed them into customer workflows and sales processes
* Apply and refine agent playbooks, prompt libraries, and implementation frameworks so the practice grows without losing consistency
* Manage configuration for onboarded customers: identify gaps and opportunities, then design, configure, and troubleshoot solutions in real time as their needs evolve
* Train client admins and keep them current on platform use, best practices, and functionality
* Be the Outreach Admin's main point of contact and trusted advisor, and surface value and risk before they ask
* Partner with GTM Account Teams on expansion, renewal, and delivery needs, and share client health insights
* Resolve escalations and at-risk accounts fast; share trends with your Practice Manager to prevent repeat issues
* Stay current on Generative AI and LLM developments relevant to Outreach's Agents
* Track your KPIs and adjust quickly to stay on target
* Mentor and share knowledge with fellow consultants

Our Vision of You
  
  

* 3-5 years in a technical, customer-facing role at a mid-to-large business, ideally SaaS
* Technical and AI fluency with Outreach or a comparable SaaS platform: you configure and apply the AI features yourself
* Experience with prompt engineering, LLM-based tools, and applying generative or agentic AI to real sales workflows
* Proven ability to influence AI and technology adoption inside customer organizations and turn new capabilities into solutions for real business problems
* Track record hitting utilization, consumption, or renewal-linked KPIs
* Experience building trust and client relationships remotely
* Handles tight deadlines and multiple concurrent engagements
* Self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and autonomy, quick to pick up complex concepts
* Passionate about solving client problems and turning customer vision into results in the product
* Sharp written and verbal communicator
* Embodies our core values: Trusted Advisor, Win as One Team, and Take Ownership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in Sales strategy, renewals, or account expansion is a plus
* Knowledge of sales processes such as lead generation, pipeline management, and KPIs
* Experience with the software delivery lifecycle or application implementation
* Skilled at coaching others on sales process best practices
* Skilled at learning a customer's business strategy, processes, and solutions
* Experience delivering Managed Services at a software company

Why You’ll Love It Here
  
  

* Highly competitive salary
* 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave
* Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members
* OPD benefit covered up to INR 10,000
* Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC
* 26 weeks of maternity leave pay, and 15 days of paternity leave pay
* Opportunity to be part of company success via the RSU program
* Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
* Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work

Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
  
  
Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

title: Management Trainee
description:
**About the Role:**

As a Management Trainee, you will support customer enquiries, cost estimation, quotation preparation, and business development activities in a fast-paced aerospace manufacturing environment. The role involves working with cross-functional teams to understand technical requirements, evaluate costs, and prepare accurate and competitive commercial proposals.

**Key Responsibilities:**



* Assist in reviewing customer enquiries, RFQs, engineering drawings, and technical specifications.

* Coordinate with Engineering, Production, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to gather inputs for cost estimation.

* Support costing activities by analysing material, manufacturing, tooling, and other applicable costs.

* Prepare cost sheets, quotations, and commercial proposals under the guidance of senior team members.

* Track customer enquiries, quotation submissions, and follow-ups to ensure timely responses.

* Assist in analysing cost structures, identifying cost optimisation opportunities, and maintaining estimation records.

* Support business opportunity tracking, MIS reports, and management presentations.

* Maintain accurate documentation and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India (On-site).
  

Requirements
  
  

**Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial, or a related engineering discipline, along with an MBA in Finance or General Business Administration (Must be from 2025 graduating batch).

* Candidates with up to one year of relevant professional experience; relevant internships and academic projects will also be considered.

* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills, with a sound understanding of financial concepts and cost analysis.

* Good communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.

**Preferred:**
  

* Candidates from reputed management institutes, particularly Tier-2 IIMs, XIMB, and comparable institutions.

* Exposure to costing, estimation, business analysis, or commercial activities through internships or academic projects.

* Interest in manufacturing processes and technical-commercial analysis.

Benefits
  
  

**What You’ll Gain:**

* Hands-on exposure to customer enquiries, cost estimation, and quotation preparation in aerospace manufacturing.

* Cross-functional learning across Engineering, Production, Quality, and Supply Chain.

* Mentorship from experienced professionals to support your development.

* A foundation for future growth in business development, estimation, and commercial roles.

title: Product Deployment Engineer
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C++, Python).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
* 8 years of experience managing projects and working with analytics, software coding, or customer-side web technologies.
* Practical experience configuring, querying, or troubleshooting CRM architectures (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, or custom internal backends).
* Ability to absorb complex technical concepts and communicate them to a non-technical audience effectively.
* Ability to work independently and to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with effective problem-solving, analytical and project management skills.
* Demonstrated coding ability with Java or Python, and database knowledge with the ability to construct complex SQL queries.

**About The Job**
As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.
  
  
You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.
  
  
The Product Deployment Engineering Team for Measurement Services, gTech Ads GCS, provides exceptional complex measurement implementation for Google’s top GCS advertising clients. This team serves as the critical bridge between GCS customer business requirements and gTech Ads’ service and engineering offerings.
  
  
The core objective of the team is to unlock data foundations, specifically driving the adoption of complex Google data strength products (e.g., ECL, GTG). Team members collaborate with high growth customers on non-standard, complex environments to unlock business growth and defend business. To achieve this, PDEs conduct comprehensive audits and deep-dive sessions to diagnose technical environments, identify customer pain points, and enable product adoption.
  
  
Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video .
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with sales and product leads, evaluate client technical maturity and first-party data strategies to guide scalable solution adoption.
* Uncover custom technical opportunities while funneling critical product gaps and edge cases back to core Ads engineering.
* Translate client needs into clear system architectures, author prototype-grounded requirement documents and standardized deployment playbooks.
* Design durable, privacy-compliant data pipelines—including Google Ads API integrations—and enforce validation frameworks using real-world data subsets.
* Orchestrate cross-functional efforts across gTech and client teams to oversee smooth implementation and successful last-mile activation.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Consultant
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
Join Veeva’s journey on building the industry cloud for life sciences. We are bringing to market a modern cloud solution designed to optimize laboratories with increased efficiency and productivity by streamlining processes. Join the team that will partner with our customers to implement one of Veeva’s newest products in Quality Cloud - Veeva LIMS.
  
  
Passionate about bringing disruptive technology to customers and have novel ideas for successful GxP software implementation? This role will allow you to help our clients to drive new product adoption through successful implementations.
  
  
This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. For a candidate this is a customer-facing role and we have no work location requirement, if you are in close proximity to an airport and able to meet future travel requirements.
  
  
Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in India. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visas for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Participate in projects at life sciences companies designing and deploying Quality & Manufacturing applications
* Support Functional Analysts in workshops and be part of customer discussions of the Vault Qualitysuite (Vault QMS, Vault QualityDocs, Vault Training)
* Quality/Content management solution design, prototyping, configuration, and documentation
* Solution and configuration of Veeva Vault Quality Suite per customer requirements, including workflows, document types, security, fields, page layouts, reports, dashboards, formatted output reports, and notifications
* Leveraging enablement of out-of-the-box or best practices configuration approach to solution strategy
* Assessing the impact of change on the current configuration and working with key stakeholders to make informed decisions in a timely manner
* Represent Professional Services across multiple engagements and workstreams (e.g., solution design and configuration, data migration, systems integration, etc.)
* Ensure customer success from the beginning to the end of the engagement life cycle

**Requirements**

* 3+ years experience working with or for organizations in life sciences or healthcare
* Bachelor's Degree in Life science, computer science, or related degree
* Solid analytical and great interpersonal skills
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
* Strong attention to detail
* Highly organized
* Ability to act with speed to understand business requirements and willingness to "roll up your sleeves" to design and implement a solution
* Exposure to life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements

****Nice to Have****

* Knowledge of Quality operations within the Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotech industry, and/or equivalent

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health & wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
  
  
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

title: District Manager, Visakhapatnam
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The primary objective of the District Manager (DM) (Recon) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.
  
  
The role is intended to provide a development pathway for experienced and successful Sales Personnel moving toward a career in sales management.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent within the operating theatre environment and the incumbent must demonstrate an understanding of this environment and of the role as both a representative of Zimmer and a part of the operating theatre team. The DM is responsible for supporting current business in the Recon range of products, and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent both enhancing current business and development of future business opportunities.
  
  
The DM (Recon) should possess a strong working knowledge of Zimmer and competitor products. As a pivotal role within the organization, the DM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. Marketing, Finance, Operations) whose work impacts or is impacted by field activity.
  
  
As a conduit of information to and from the field, DM must also facilitate the flow of information regarding changes in the industry, customer environments, or competitor activity to others within the larger Zimmer organization.
  
  
Principal Duties & Responsibilities
  
  
**Support and Review Current Business (40%)**

* Actively contact current and potential customers and attend to resulting customer requests.
* Conduct in-servicing and workshops on products.
* Maintain good relationships with key accounts & seek to continue leverage of existing business relationships.
* Responsibility of primary and secondary sales in the designated territory and Key accounts.

**Targeting and Conversion of Business (50%)**

* Establish relationships with key decision makers currently using competitor products, within targeted geographical & product areas.
* Present proposal to decision makers and convert customers to usage of Zimmer products.
* Responsible for the preparation of quotations for sales query as well as documentation for submission of tenders. To engage in the negotiation of prices in line with the guidelines from management.

**Management Reporting(5%)**

* Completion of reports as required by NBM/GSM/SM (or others), including monthly reports & expenses.
* Prepare ad-hoc reports on an as-required basis.
* To liaise with Distributors for effective customer service, order procurement for primary sales and realization of receivables from Distributors/Hospitals of the territory in co-ordination with the Area/Regional Sales Manager and Finance Department.

**Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

* Attendance at relevant workshops and OT , where required, completion of learning assessment exercises.
* Study relevant clinical articles & data to build knowledge base and provide relevant advice to customers & staff.

Expected Behaviour
  
  
The incumbent will be required to demonstrate behavior in accordance with Zimmer Biomet’s Guiding Principles, as listed below;
  
  
We respect you for your individual contributions and your diverse perspectives. We support your professional growth and provide you with opportunities to share in the company's success.
  
  

* Commit to the highest standards of patient safety, quality and integrity.

We commit to the highest standards of patient safety and quality in our products and services and to be recognized for world-class integrity and ethical business practices.
  
  

* Focus our resources in areas where we will make a difference.

We focus our resources in areas where we will make the greatest impact for our customers and patients through our collective knowledge of the disease state or market, established infrastructure, relevant engineering expertise and skillsets.
  
  

* Ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.

We innovate to provide value through effective and efficient solutions for customers and improved outcomes for patients to ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.
  
  

* Give back to our communities and people in need.

We partner with communities where we live and work and support causes and programs that forward our mission for people in need.
  
  
Your Background
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Must Possess The Following**

* Science Graduate with 3 – 5 yrs of work experience
* Preferred Qualifications in B.Pharma, Business, Marketing or Paramedical discipline.

**The candidate must have the following level of experience in, or knowledge of:**

* Previous experience in OR/OT surgical support experience, preferably in orthopedic
* Demonstrated sales abilities & a track record of successful selling to the medical profession

**Expected Areas of Competence (i.e. KSAs)**

* Working level of proficiency in the local language/English/Hindi.
* Product/Technical Knowledge
* Commercial Acumen
* Result Orientation
* Inter-personal and strong communication skills
* Tenacity

Travel Expectations
  
  
90% of the time
  
  
EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

title: Functional Consultant - HRMS Implementation (India / MENA Region)
description:

Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups – Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Adani Wilmar, Swiggy, DLF, Crisil, JG Summit Group, Cebu Pacific Air, Nivea, etc.
  
  
The vision of Darwinbox to build a world-class product company from Asia and is backed by marquee global investors like Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners and Microsoft.
  
  
About the role:
  
  
Lead end-to-end HRMS implementations, partner with clients, manage stakeholders, drive change, and ensure successful project delivery and go-live

+ Coordinate with the Development team and superiors to define any change request from the client and solution for the client-specific use case.

+ Key behavioural traits: Agility, Analytical, Persistence and Ability to stretch.

+ Diligent and can track action items, follow-up, ensure smooth delivery, and manage project documentation.
+ A people’s person who communicates effectively and collaborates with internal and external stakeholders across functions to drive successful outcomes.

title: Senior Commercial Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Commercial Manager acts as a strategic partner to the sales organization, focusing on deal structuring, pricing optimization, risk mitigation and the streamlining of the end-to-end sales process. You will ensure that deals are commercially viable, compliant with corporate policies, and aligned with GE Vernova’s business objectives.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Deal Structuring: Partner with Sales Managers to develop creative, profitable, and competitive deal structures for complex energy projects.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Risk, and Commercial Operations to resolve contract nuances, payment terms, and scope definitions.
* Compliance & Governance: Ensure all deals adhere to corporate delegation of authority (DOA) and internal pricing guidelines.
* Process Optimization: Identify bottlenecks in the "Quote-to-Cash" cycle and implement improvements to accelerate deal velocity.
* Risk Assessment: Evaluate commercial and financial risks associated with specific proposals and provide recommendations for mitigation.
* Data Analysis: Maintain deal reporting and analytics to provide visibility into win/loss ratios, pricing trends, and pipeline health.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: Proven experience of minimum 10 years in commercial operations, sales support/operations, or Pre Sales.
* Analytical Skills: Strong ability to build financial models and analyze complex pricing scenarios.
* Communication: Excellent negotiation skills and the ability to bridge technical requirements with commercial outcomes.
* Technical Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and familiarity with CRM tools (such as Salesforce) and ERP systems.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Digital-Kyriba - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**About EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance practice supports global EY client–serving teams with their reviews across industry sectors, including financial services, manufacturing and technology, among others. Through the right multidisciplinary team of professionals with the sector knowledge and subject matter expertise, EY GDS Assurance enables EY client teams in over 30 countries to help world’s leading companies meet their audit requirements.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provides advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support.
  
  
We are looking for a professional to join EY FAAS to help drive growth and support delivery teams, bring subject matter expertise around Kyriba solution of our FAAS services.
  
  
The Senior should be competent to support a portfolio of clients and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of the work as per EY Global Standards for our Kyriba team. While the Senior will be based out of our Gurugram or Bengaluru or Mumbai offices, the individual will be responsible for supporting EY practices and clients across the Global Market. Also, the individual will be required to travel to other countries (short-term) for executing the client engagements.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
The Senior will manage teams of FAAS professionals during engagements covering a broad spectrum of Kyriba areas. The individual will be responsible for the following tasks:
  
  

* Assist in Kyriba projects, including design, implementation, configuration, and integration of Kyriba modules.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather business requirements, contribute to solution design, and provide expertise on Kyriba functionalities.
* Analyze and optimize treasury processes, identifying areas for improvement and supporting the implementation of best practices.
* Participate in client demonstrations and presentations, highlighting the capabilities and benefits of Kyriba solutions.
* Assist in evaluating and assessing vendor solutions, participating in vendor evaluations, and providing recommendations for Kyriba implementation.
* Contribute to system testing, including creating test scenarios and ensuring successful data migration and validation for Kyriba functionalities.
* Support the development and delivery of training programs and workshops to enhance end-user understanding and proficiency in Kyriba modules.
* Maintain awareness of the latest industry trends, regulations, and advancements in treasury management, and share knowledge and insights with the team.
* Support project management activities, such as project planning, resource allocation, and monitoring project progress.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure successful implementation, adherence to project timelines, and achievement of project goals.
* Provide ongoing support and maintenance for Kyriba modules, addressing functional issues and assisting with enhancements as required.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and industry standards.
* Assist in engagement planning, budgeting, execution, and management.

**Qualifications, Skills And Experience**
**To qualify, candidates must have:**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1+ years of relevant experience in treasury management, preferably with exposure to Kyriba.
* Kyriba Gold, or Platinum, certification and hands-on experience with Kyriba would be advantageous.

**Experience in the following areas:**

* Understanding of treasury and risk management processes, including cash management, liquidity management, debt management, In-House bank/cash, and financial risk management.
* Knowledge in configuring Kyriba functionalities i.e. cash management, payments, bank communication, foreign exchange (FX), intercompany loans, and in-house banking.
* Experience in integrating Kyriba with other systems and external platforms.
* Familiarity with financial instruments, derivatives, and hedging strategies.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, enabling effective collaboration with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Project involvement experience, including the ability to support multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to work in a team and establish credibility as a trusted advisor to clients.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to interact with management at all levels (EY and clients).
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% to 80% of the time

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Associate
description:
**Senior Associate – Admissions (Advanced Management Programmes)**
Department: Admissions & Financial Aid - Advanced Management Programmes (AMPs)
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Associate – Admissions will be responsible for managing and supporting the admissions process for ISB’s Advanced Management Programmes (AMPs). The role involves engaging with prospective candidates, particularly working professionals and senior executives, providing programme guidance, driving quality enrolments, and ensuring a seamless candidate experience from initial enquiry to admission.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Admissions & Enrolment Management
* Manage the end-to-end admissions process for assigned Advanced Management Programmes.
* Engage with prospective candidates through calls, emails, webinars, and other communication channels.
* Understand candidate profiles, career aspirations, and programme requirements to provide relevant guidance.
* Counsel prospective applicants on programme structure, eligibility, curriculum, and admission process.
* Follow up with prospective candidates to support timely application submission and enrolment.
* Work towards achieving programme-wise application and enrolment targets.
* Calling & Candidate Engagement
* Conduct high-quality outbound and inbound calls with working professionals, senior executives, and prospective students.
* Effectively communicate the value proposition, learning outcomes, and career relevance of ISB’s programmes.
* Build meaningful relationships with prospective candidates through professional and mature communication.
* Handle candidate queries with confidence, empathy, and clarity.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective candidates and ensure timely movement through the admissions funnel.
* Identify serious and high-potential prospects and nurture them towards application and enrolment.
* Lead Management & Conversion
* Manage and nurture leads received through digital marketing, webinars, referrals, events, and other sources.
* Ensure timely follow-up and accurate updating of lead status in Salesforce or the designated CRM.
* Track lead progression from enquiry to application, interview, offer, and enrolment.
* Identify reasons for lead drop-offs and recommend improvements to enhance conversion.
* Focus on generating quality applications and enrolments aligned with programme eligibility and profile requirements.
* Coordinate with the Digital Marketing and Sales teams to improve lead quality and conversion outcomes.
* Candidate Counselling & Application Support
* Guide candidates through the application process, including eligibility, SOP, video essay, supporting documents, and deadlines.
* Clarify programme-related queries and provide accurate information to applicants.
* Support candidates in understanding the application requirements and submission timelines.
* Coordinate with the relevant internal teams for application-related concerns.
* Ensure a positive and professional candidate experience throughout the admissions journey.
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Coordinate with Programme Leads, Faculty, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Finance, and other internal stakeholders.
* Support the execution of information sessions, webinars, application guidance workshops, and alumni engagement activities.
* Assist in coordinating candidate interviews, shortlisting, and other admissions-related activities.
* Maintain effective communication with applicants, alumni, corporate representatives, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Reporting & Data Management
* Maintain accurate and updated admissions records in Salesforce or the designated CRM.
* Prepare regular reports on leads, applications, offers, enrolments, conversion rates, and pending follow-ups.
* Analyse admissions funnel performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Track programme-wise targets and provide timely updates to the reporting manager.
* Ensure data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with institutional processes.
* Programme Promotion & Outreach
* Support admissions campaigns and outreach initiatives for assigned AMPs.
* Participate in webinars, candidate engagement activities, alumni interactions, and programme promotion events.
* Leverage alumni referrals, professional networks, and other outreach opportunities to generate prospective leads.
* Communicate programme differentiators, faculty expertise, peer learning, and institutional value effectively.
* Contribute ideas to improve programme visibility, candidate engagement, and enrolment outcomes.
* Process Improvement & Team Contribution
* Identify opportunities to improve admissions processes, candidate communication, and conversion strategies.
* Share insights from candidate interactions to strengthen programme positioning and marketing communication.
* Support team members in resolving candidate queries and operational challenges.
* Contribute to a collaborative, professional, and target-oriented team environment.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions - SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices, using the state-of-the-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
  
  
But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
  
  
If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy & Transactions is your next move.
  
  
**The team**

* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.

Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
  
  
**Work you will do:**
Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
  
  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go-to-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.

**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**

* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* - Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI-powered features end-to-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.

**Core Consulting**

* Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking - Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI-enabled digital transformation, data & AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.

**Preferred:**

* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

title: Sr Regional Business Manager( South), India Region
description:
**SUMMARY**

The role as a Sr. Regional Business Manager is to manage the development of the region’s sales & distribution network and coordinate the sales efforts of the regional sales channels. The main responsibility is to ensure that the forecast is on target, the individual will be responsible for managing and owning to but not limited to order, revenue & margin aspects of the business for Accuray products and solutions. This includes the development of regional sales strategies adapted to the specific market situations and needs based on detailed market analysis. Leading cross functional team building efforts within the Region, in particular the coordination with the Service and Marketing Teams. The Regional Business Manager will work with the Senior Regional Business Director to develop specific sales plans to effectively win orders with new customers and new orders with existing customers and lead the sales process to successful customer acceptance and margin turnovers. The Individual must have a strong sales/commercial track record as individual contributor in medical devices & life Sciences domains.

The work location is in Remote-India preferably in Bangalore, Hyderabad & Chennai.

The role reports into the Senior Regional Business Director – India & Subcontinent.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Responsible for managing commercial and sales targets for the region mainly but not limited to new orders, revenue, margins, upgrades sales & market share aspects of the business. Contribute to timely renewal of service contracts in the assigned territory.
* The individual has to carry out business by accurately positioning Accuray’s products and portfolios in Private market, Strategic Accounts & Govt. accounts while maintaining high visibility in assigned geography to ultimately gain the market share.
* Assess individual markets and develop together with the Marketing, Service teams and Senior Regional Business Director, sales and marketing plans and strategies to achieve business goals with prospects and existing customers for new system sales.
* Develop relationships and build Accuray advocacy within the respective territory.
* Coordinate all regional sales activities to achieve the quarterly and yearly goals. Ability to forecast the business imperatives and maintain linearity of business on Quarter-to-Quarter basis.
* Develop reference centers for the region.
* Assist the sales channels in the preparation of high-level proposals and product/clinical features, advantages, and benefits (FAB) to medical physicists, oncologists, and key administrators.
* Participate in customer training programs, industry symposia and trade shows.
* Build and keep the funnel in SalesForce.com (Customer Relationship Management System) up to date in order to deliver a reliable forecast to the management.
* Ensure safety and quality considerations and requirements are proactively addressed and implemented in marketing & customer requirements.
* Follow the timeline for internal QA-related tasks, like Accuray University.
* Address and report in a timely fashion safety and quality issues raised by customers or staff.
* Supports Accuray’s Quality System and Safety & Health Program by following procedures and mentoring others
* Inform the Regional Business Director about the competitive landscape and advice for pricing strategies for the respective territory.
* Managing accolated quarterly budget for Travel, lodging & business expenses and accurately reporting of same.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor/Master’s degree in biomedical engineering or related field is required.
* Minimum 10 years professional sales experience of medical equipment with specific knowledge of the assigned territory is highly desired. Other related experience may also be considered.
* Familiarity and experience with oncology, radiotherapy, IMRT, Radiosurgery, Medical Physics, and other hospital/healthcare practices.
* Excellent level of English (read, written, spoken). Local language, Tamil, Telegu and Kannada will be an added advantage.
* Experience demonstrating strong written and verbal skills including an ability to present.
* Excellent customer relation skills, problem solving and stakeholder management in a matrixed organization.
* Experience with the use of standard office software programs including spreadsheet, word-processing, email applications and Power Point.
* Ability to be self-motivated and to work independently.
* Capability to work home based while keeping a high standard of motivation, professionalism, and ethic.
* Team worker and loyal team member
* Dynamic, proactive, and driven to high levels of accomplishment.
* Willingness to travel at least 60% of the time.

We offer attractive benefits package to the right candidates. Please send your resume with current and expected salary details and a cover letter quoting the job reference to jobs-asia@accuray.com

All information received will be kept strictly confidential and used for recruitment purposes only.

title: Principal Consultant- Oracle HCM Cloud
description:
**Job Summary**

We're looking for a
**Principal Consultant- Oracle Cloud HCM**
to own the end-to-end architecture and design integrity of complex, high-value HCM transformation programs, including AI-enhanced solutions. You'll be the recognized HCM subject matter expert who shapes solution strategy, guides design decisions, mentors architects and consultants, and makes sure what is designed is what gets delivered. You'll work closely with delivery, client leadership, and Oracle product teams to reduce risk and deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Design end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM architectures across Core HR, Talent Management, Benefits, Time & Labor, Recruitment, and Workforce Management
* Translate business requirements into solution blueprints, target-state process models, and configuration strategies
* Define integration architecture (HCM Extracts, HDL, REST/SOAP APIs, OIC, Payroll, Finance, and third-party systems), data migration strategy, and security and role design
* Build reusable solution accelerators, industry templates, and reference architectures on Oracle Cloud HCM

**Implementation Leadership & Governance**

* Own the solution architecture across the full implementation lifecycle, from discovery and fit-gap through design, build, test, deployment, and hypercare
* Lead fit-gap analysis and drive design decisions, including configuration vs. extension trade-offs
* Serve as the technical and functional escalation point, protecting design intent through delivery
* Establish solution governance: design authority forums, architecture reviews, and change control
* Represent the solution in steering committees and stakeholder reviews

**Pre-Sales & Client Advisory**

* Support strategic pursuits with solution strategy, effort and risk assessment, and technical sections of complex RFP/RFI responses
* Run executive workshops and architecture discussions, translating technical solutions into business outcomes
* Build high-impact demos and POCs that show measurable ROI

**Emerging Technology: Agentic AI & Redwood**

* Architect solutions that integrate Oracle Cloud HCM with Gen AI and Agentic AI capabilities (intelligent process automation, conversational HR assistants, AI-driven talent and workforce insights)
* Guide Oracle Redwood adoption, including UI/UX, personalization, and change and adoption planning
* Advise clients on Oracle's AI and Redwood roadmap and how to sequence adoption

**Team Leadership & Enablement**

* Mentor solution architects, functional leads, and consultants on design standards and best practices
* Drive quality through design reviews, peer reviews, and reusable knowledge assets
* Collaborate with Oracle product management and the partner ecosystem on roadmap alignment and co-innovation

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Deep functional and architectural expertise across Oracle Cloud HCM: Core HR, Talent Management, Benefits, Time & Labor, Recruitment, and Workforce Management
* Proven track record as a lead or architect on multiple full-lifecycle Oracle Cloud HCM implementations or large-scale transformation programs, with named projects and clear ownership
* Strong command of integration, data migration, security, and reporting/analytics (OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts, HDL, OIC)
* Ability to design and speak credibly to solutions integrating Oracle Cloud HCM with Gen AI and Agentic AI
* Hands-on exposure to Oracle Redwood (UI, personalization, adoption)
* Experience leading fit-gap analysis, solution governance, and design authority forums
* Strong communication and storytelling skills, able to explain architecture to both technical and executive audiences
* Strong stakeholder management across client leadership, delivery, sales, and product teams
* Ability to build and deliver demos and POCs with measurable outcomes
* Willingness to travel for client engagements as needed

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Multi-country or global HCM rollouts, including compliance and localization
* Thought leadership in HCM transformation, such as speaking engagements or published POVs
* Working knowledge of commercial structuring, deal shaping, and SaaS partnership models
* Experience partnering with Oracle product management or the partner ecosystem on roadmap and co-innovation
* Oracle Cloud HCM certifications (e.g., Implementation Professional, Cloud Foundations/AI)

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Managed Services
description:
**Job Description**
About Outreach
  
  
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.
  
  
**About The Team**
Managed Services sits within Professional Services. We're Outreach, CRM, and GTM technology experts who help customers get full value from the platform once implementation ends.
  
  
Our Managed Service Consultants are trusted advisors. They drive adoption, flag risk, and grow usage, so customers keep exceeding their goals.
  
  
The Role
  
  
You'll join our India-based Managed Services team, chartered with building our customers' AI Agents beyond what was set up during implementation: opening new use cases and growing Amplify credit and product consumption.
  
  
You’ll own and expand our largest, most complex portfolio of accounts and guide customers through best practices and hands-on configuration to drive outcomes and deepen adoption. You will partner with the leaders and team to set the technical standard for the practice and be a go-to resource when other consultants hit edge cases. You'll stay technically fluent in Outreach's evolving capabilities, AI included, so you can configure and troubleshoot in real time.
  
  
The role mixes technology and business consulting with solution design and project management. You'll work closely with Customer Success and Account Executives, build rapport fast, and influence customer outcomes.
  
  
You'll own results for your book of business against Managed Services KPIs, and report to a Practice Manager, Managed Services.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators: Manage a book of business with an average QoQ utilization rate of 70%, with a focus on Amplify credit and product consumption — ultimately supporting renewal rates and the minimization of churn and contraction.
  
  
Location: This is a remote role, based in Hyderabad. There may be occasional in-person or team events and if asked to attend, it will be during local IST hours.
  
  
Working Hours: This is a customer-facing role and will require working US-based hours (night-shift allowance provided).
  
  
Your Daily Adventures Will Include
  
  

* Build, configure, and tune new AI Agents (Revenue, Deal, Research, Conversation, Forecasting) beyond initial implementation to expand automation and drive credit consumption
* Design and manage context-aware prompts for each customer's AI Agent use cases
* Be the subject matter expert on Outreach's AI Agents and embed them into customer workflows and sales processes
* Apply and refine agent playbooks, prompt libraries, and implementation frameworks so the practice grows without losing consistency
* Manage configuration for onboarded customers: identify gaps and opportunities, then design, configure, and troubleshoot solutions in real time as their needs evolve
* Train client admins and keep them current on platform use, best practices, and functionality
* Be the Outreach Admin's main point of contact and trusted advisor, and surface value and risk before they ask
* Partner with GTM Account Teams on expansion, renewal, and delivery needs, and share client health insights
* Resolve escalations and at-risk accounts fast; share trends with your Practice Manager to prevent repeat issues
* Stay current on Generative AI and LLM developments relevant to Outreach's Agents
* Track your KPIs and adjust quickly to stay on target
* Mentor and share knowledge with fellow consultants
* Set best practices for agent configuration and prompt design across the team, not just your own accounts
* Act as a technical escalation point for peer consultants and partner directly with Product on gaps surfaced by strategic customers

Our Vision of You
  
  

* 6-8+ years in a technical, customer-facing role at a mid-to-large business, ideally SaaS
* Technical and AI fluency with Outreach or a comparable SaaS platform: you configure and apply the AI features yourself
* Experience with prompt engineering, LLM-based tools, and applying generative or agentic AI to real sales workflows
* Proven ability to influence AI and technology adoption inside customer organizations and turn new capabilities into solutions for real business problems
* Track record hitting utilization, consumption, or renewal-linked KPIs
* Experience building trust and client relationships remotely
* Handles tight deadlines and multiple concurrent engagements
* Self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and autonomy, quick to pick up complex concepts
* Passionate about solving client problems and turning customer vision into results in the product
* Sharp written and verbal communicator
* Track record of owning the most strategic or highest-complexity accounts in a book of business
* Experience mentoring or informally leading peers in a customer-facing technical role
* Embodies our core values: Trusted Advisor, Win as One Team, and Take Ownership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in Sales strategy, renewals, or account expansion is a plus
* Knowledge of sales processes such as lead generation, pipeline management, and KPIs
* Experience with the software delivery lifecycle or application implementation
* Skilled at coaching others on sales process best practices
* Skilled at learning a customer's business strategy, processes, and solutions
* Experience delivering Managed Services at a software company
* Experience shaping team-wide playbooks, frameworks or enablement content

Why You’ll Love It Here
  
  

* Highly competitive salary
* 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave
* Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members
* OPD benefit covered up to INR 10,000
* Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC
* 26 weeks of maternity leave pay, and 15 days of paternity leave pay
* Opportunity to be part of company success via the RSU program
* Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
* Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work

Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
  
  
Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

title: Senior Technical Consultant: Salesforce(Automotive Experience)
description:
**Description**
**Executive Summary & Organizational Context**
Within Salesforce Professional Services, the Senior Technical Consultant — Automotive Cloud role occupies a vital strategic position at the bleeding edge of AI CRM and automotive industry digital transformation. As automotive enterprises navigate sweeping market disruptions—from electric vehicle transitions and direct-to-consumer sales models to connected vehicle telemetry and autonomous fleets—this role serves as the bridge between pioneering platform capabilities and real-world enterprise execution.
  
  
Salesforce stands as the #1 AI CRM, defining an ecosystem where humans with agents drive customer success together. It is an organizational environment where ambition meets action, technology meets trust, and innovation functions as an operating principle. As Salesforce leads global workforce transformation in the agentic era, the practice actively seeks Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through artificial intelligence, driving rapid innovation, and keeping core values like trust at the center of every client commitment. Operating in a paradigm where Agentforce represents the future of autonomous and assisted AI interactions, incoming talent directly shapes the trajectory of Salesforce by translating cutting-edge platform capabilities into measurable enterprise value.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant operates as a hands-on advisor positioned directly at the intersection of Salesforce platform architecture and deep automotive domain knowledge. Covering an enterprise scope that spans Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers, the consultant acts as the trusted technical voice for client leadership navigating complex digital transformations. In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.
  
  

* Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes. Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
* Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies.

**Core Automotive Domain Implementation**
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:
  
  

* Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
* Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.
* Fleet Management: Construct scalable multi-vehicle management frameworks that support commercial fleet accounts, enabling centralized tracking of preventative maintenance schedules, driver assignments, telematics alerts, and contract lifecycles.
* Service Scheduling & Retention: Connect vehicle telematics and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) directly into intelligent dealer service scheduling workflows, driving proactive maintenance outreach, reducing customer friction, and maximizing dealer workshop utilization.
* Customer Journey Orchestration: Unify siloed customer data across OEM marketing, dealership sales, and aftersales service channels to execute personalized, multi-channel customer journeys that enhance lifetime customer value and brand loyalty.

**AI-Native Delivery & Future-Proofing**

* Drive continuous up-skilling in AI Fluency and AI-native delivery practices, leveraging Agentforce capabilities to power domain-specific automotive use cases such as intelligent dealer assist, connected vehicle conversational agents, and predictive service recommendations.
* Operationalize advanced AI developer tools and assistants—specifically Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, and Claude—into daily delivery workflows to streamline complex APEX code generation, automate unit test creation, accelerate technical design drafting, and maintain superior delivery velocity and code quality.

**Advisory, Risk Management & Mentorship**

* Provide hands-on advisory leadership during critical project inflection points, rapidly troubleshooting complex technical issues, performing root-cause analyses, and driving technical impediments through to full resolution.
* Manage high-stakes client expectations by negotiating complex technical solutions and architecture trade-offs across executive client leadership, OEM technology groups, and third-party systems integrators.
* Actively mentor junior consultants and technical architects, instilling technical rigor and sharing domain assets to grow and scale the broader Automotive Services Practice.

Executing these technical responsibilities and high-impact work streams requires a proven foundation of enterprise architecture experience, platform mastery, and specialized automotive domain acumen.
  
  

* Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience To maintain high standards of technical delivery and domain credibility, candidates must demonstrate a rigorous combination of enterprise architecture depth, hands-on implementation experience, and specialized automotive sector intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Industry Cloud Delivery: 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce delivery experience with Automotive Cloud or a directly adjacent industry cloud (Manufacturing Cloud or Consumer Goods Cloud), backed by demonstrated automotive domain delivery artifacts.
* Architecture & Delivery Experience: 7+ years of total experience as a Lead Developer or Solution Architect, with a proven track record of delivering complex software solutions within mid-to-large-scale enterprise organizations.
* Automotive Domain Acumen: Deep domain knowledge of core automotive business processes, including vehicle sales and financing, aftersales service operations, dealer network management, commercial fleet operations, or connected vehicle data platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP web services, asynchronous event-driven architectures), Single Sign-On (SSO) federations, Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, and Data Lake/CDP connections.
* Specialized Systems Integration: Proven expertise integrating Salesforce with specialized automotive applications, including Dealer Management System (DMS) platforms (e.g., CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion), telematics ingestion platforms, and proprietary OEM back-end systems.
* Methodology & Process Design: Demonstrated proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, supported by a track record of analyzing, designing, and optimizing complex business processes through technology.
* Executive Communication & Engagement: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate, present, and defend complex technical architectures before developer teams, business steering committees, and C-suite executives.
* Autonomy & Leadership: Ability to operate independently, navigate high levels of organizational ambiguity, and drive project outcomes as a self-starter.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct engagement experience on Salesforce Automotive Cloud implementations, with deep operational mastery of the Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, or Fleet Management modules.
* Hands-on experience with connected vehicle platforms, IoT edge device integrations, or real-time telematics data ingestion into the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Advanced experience leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) to build real-time, unified customer and vehicle data profiles that power personalized experiences.
* Practical exposure to cutting-edge Agentforce implementations within automotive contexts, such as AI-driven service advisors, dealer-facing conversational chatbots, and predictive maintenance agents.
* Direct experience consulting with OEMs, Tier-1 automotive suppliers, or dealership groups at enterprise scale.
* Existing Salesforce Industry Cloud accreditations or certifications in Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or adjacent vertical solutions.

While these baseline and preferred qualifications establish a candidate's operational readiness, long-term success in the practice requires continuous technical credentialing and structured platform upskilling.
  
  

* Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning Maintaining technical mastery within the rapidly evolving Agentforce ecosystem requires an unyielding commitment to continuous learning and formal platform credentialing. Salesforce Professional Services invests heavily in continuous talent development to ensure consultants remain ahead of platform innovation curves.

**Target Certification Requirements**
Candidates are expected to formally achieve the following five Salesforce certifications within their first 3 months in the role:
  
  

* Certified Platform App Builder
* Certified Platform Developer I
* Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
* Certified Integration Architect

*Note: Holding any of the above Salesforce credentials prior to onboarding is considered highly beneficial and serves as a primary key differentiator during the candidate evaluation and selection process.*
Beyond technical certifications and architectural expertise, sustained consulting excellence in high-stakes enterprise environments depends on core leadership behaviors and alignment with corporate values.
  
  

* Leadership Qualities & Core Values To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Senior Technical Consultant must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust. Core Leadership Pillars
* PASSION: Demonstrates an unyielding commitment to Customer Success. The consultant exhibits deep personal investment in seeing automotive clients succeed, transforming complex technology implementations into tangible market wins and measurable business outcomes for OEM stakeholders and dealer networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Maintains a continuous learning mindset. The consultant approaches every complex enterprise engagement, client interaction, and architectural challenge with humbleness, curiosity, and openness—actively dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in automotive technology and consumer expectations.
* ADAPTABLE: Thrives amidst high levels of uncertainty and rapid industry transformation. Recognizing that structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption are permanent constants in the automotive sector, the consultant remains poised, agile, and decisive when navigating ambiguous project environments.
