title: Corporate Relations Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Simandhar Education is a finance-focused edtech organization built at the intersection of AI, innovation, and global finance education. In collaboration with Becker Professional Education, trusted by over 2 million learners worldwide, Simandhar delivers globally benchmarked CPA, CMA, ACCA, EA, and AI-focused programs with strong outcomes in India. The institution is known for its high pass rates, global toppers, extensive corporate partnerships, and thousands of successful placements with Big 4 firms, MNCs, and other global companies. Its Board of Advisors includes senior leaders and CFOs from major organizations such as Reliance Industries, Adobe, Infosys, and NASBA, ensuring strong industry alignment. Through structured mentorship, practical exposure, and AI-integrated learning, Simandhar acts as a career accelerator for aspiring and experienced finance professionals.

**Role Description**
The Corporate Relations Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for strengthening and expanding Simandhar Education’s corporate partnerships and placement networks. This role involves identifying and nurturing relationships with employers, including Big 4 firms, multinational companies, and domestic corporates, to create internship, placement, and collaboration opportunities for students. The Corporate Relations Manager will coordinate corporate events, recruitment drives, and industry interactions, while working closely with academic and placement teams to align programs with employer needs. Day-to-day activities include conducting outreach and meetings with corporate stakeholders, maintaining relationship management records, negotiating partnership terms, and tracking outcomes from corporate tie-ups. The role also includes representing Simandhar at external forums, gathering market insights on finance and AI-related roles, and contributing to strategies that enhance student employability and corporate satisfaction.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Corporate Relations and Business Relationship Management skills to build, manage, and grow partnerships with employers and industry bodies.
* Excellent Communication skills, including presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement, with the ability to interact confidently with senior corporate leaders.
* Foundational understanding of Finance and modern finance roles, preferably within CPA, CMA, ACCA, EA, or related domains.
* Sales and business development skills to identify opportunities, pitch collaboration models, and convert prospects into long-term corporate tie-ups.
* Relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Management, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
* Prior experience in corporate relations, campus recruitment, B2B partnerships, or edtech/education sector preferred.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, outcome-focused environment, with strong planning, organizational, and follow-through skills.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, data reporting, and digital communication platforms to manage relationships and track placement metrics.

title: Pricing Analyst (Asia Pacific)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Pricing Analyst is a seasoned subject matter expert, accountable for supporting growth across deals and analyzes deals to find efficiencies and ensure lower costs and maximum profitability.
  
  
This role participates in pre-sales engagements to support the qualification of deals with a particular focus on the pricing and margin aspects of the pursuit.
  
  
The Pricing Analyst provides input on any complex deal review process related to deals in their assigned area of responsibility.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Provides an analytical breakdown of pricing structures.
* Maintains familiarity with hardware / software licensing and services commercial model in the vendor’s environment.
* Ensures costing optimization with the vendors and regions and work with the Sales team to optimize deals, mitigate risks for the organization and prevent potential channel or country/region conflicts.
* Work across multiple teams to implement pricing and deal packaging guidelines.
* Analyzes data from a variety of sources and using it to derive insights into pricing strategies and market trends.
* Supports with designing competitive pricing proposition of specific client deals.
* Supports deal structuring and/or packaging guidance to Sales, incorporating macro perspective into deal guidance in order to ensure that deals make overall business sense (precedent setting, pricing/discounts across segments/geographies and product family, hardware and software discounts).
* Creates pricing tools that are used to more quickly respond to changing market needs or trends.
* Creates appropriate pricing templates that conform to pricing standards required by the business.
* Performs scenario analysis, what if comparisons, sensitivity analysis, on key deal during deal structuring cycle.
* Supports the transfer of the pricing knowledge to the GDC delivery team to ensure the ongoing management of the commercial aspects of contracts.
* Provides analysis identifying common trends and issues around pricing and competitive situations, learnings from deals, pricing pressures, competitive pressures, loopholes, etc., encountered in day-to-day management of the region.
* Accountable for capturing knowledge into artefacts that can be used to support new pursuits and ensure it is embedded in company's overall approach– e.g. updated costing and pricing policies, models.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Seasoned knowledge and understanding of IT industry environment and business needs.
* Seasoned knowledge of the industry including competitors and market trends.
* Seasoned knowledge of vendor pricing and commercial model (for example. Cisco and Microsoft license model / VMW license model).
* Keen eye for identifying opportunity.
* Seasoned analytical and research skills.
* Seasoned verbal and written communication skills.
* Seasoned negotiations and problem-solving skills.
* High level of drive and ability to work under pressure.
* Seasoned understanding of global commerce and business capabilities and policies for global deals.
* Ability to build and maintain cross-functional relationships with a variety of stakeholders.
* Maintains a high level of knowledge of product and service offerings, including new offerings.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Commercial or related field.

**Required experience:**

* Seasoned experience working with business intelligence software.
* Seasoned relevant experience in similar role within a related environment.
* Seasoned pricing experience as a consultant or practitioner with a history of developing and implementing innovative pricing solutions.
* Seasoned experience in commercial modelling using MS Excel, PowerPoint, etc.

title: Manager – Founder's Office (Growth) (5+ Yrs to 10 Yrs)
description:
**Job Description: Manager – Founder's Office (Growth) (5+ Yrs to 10 Yrs)**
**About Bilvantis**
Bilvantis is a Data & AI engineering services company with teams in the US, India, the UK and the UAE. We don't work as a vendor. We work as an extension of our clients' own teams. We put our solutions and accelerators into every piece of repeatable work, and we choose to grow deep within a small set of accounts rather than spread thin across many.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
Much of Bilvantis growth runs through the CEO's relationships, with clients, prospects, partners and the wider network. The ideas are there: who to reach, how to engage, what to send and when. What's missing is someone who makes sure every one of those threads is researched, followed up and moved forward, every time.
  
  
This role is the CEO's growth shadow. You'll own the rhythm behind every contact, lead, opportunity and meeting, so that nothing slips, the right content reaches the right person at the right time, and every meeting, trip and event turns into real progress.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Pipeline and relationship nurturing:**

* Keep every contact, lead and opportunity the CEO is working on in one place (CRM), each with a clear status, next step and date.
* Run a planned nurture calendar for each relationship, with the right touchpoint at the right time: case studies, articles, newsletters, event invites and updates.
* Draft follow-ups in the CEO’s voice within 24 hours of every interaction, ready to review and send.
* Hold a Daily connect and weekly pipeline review with the CEO: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs the CEO personally.

**Research And Prospect Building**

* Turn the CEO’s ideas on industries, accounts and people into researched target lists and account maps.
* Prepare a short brief before every meeting or outreach: the person, the company, their priorities, recent news, the Bilvantis angle and talking points.
* Track buying signals such as leadership changes, funding, migration plans and partner activity, and flag the right moments to engage.

**Meetings And Action Closure**

* Join all external meetings and growth-related internal meetings (pipeline, account reviews, leadership reviews), virtually by default.
* Capture notes, decisions and actions, and send a clear summary with owners and dates soon after each meeting.
* Follow every action through to completion with internal and external stakeholders, and escalate early when something is at risk.

**Content And Internal Coordination**

* Work with Delivery, Practice, Pre-Sales, Solutions and Marketing to get the right decks, proposals, case studies and updates ready on time.
* Check quality and fit before anything goes to an external contact, so every piece we send is relevant, accurate and on-brand.
* Keep a ready library of content for each industry, solution and partner.

**Travel And Event Planning**

* Plan the CEO’s travel and events around people, clients, partners and growth priorities: which city, which week and who to meet.
* Secure meetings before each trip, build the itinerary, and prepare a brief for every person the CEO will meet.
* Close every trip and event with follow-ups within 48 hours and a short summary of outcomes and next steps.
* Work with the admin or travel desk on logistics; your focus is the purpose and outcomes of each trip.

**Partner And Network Follow-through**

* Support follow-ups with Databricks and Google Cloud partner teams, event contacts, referral partners and advisors.

**Working Hours And Travel**

* Based in Hyderabad, working fixed overlap hours with the US (Central Time), for example 6 pm to 1 am IST or a split shift.
* Travel with the CEO on key US trips and on all India trips; a valid US B1/B2 visa, or willingness to obtain one, is required.

**What You Bring**

* Prior Experience: 5+ years to 10 years in business development, client engagement, consulting or a founder’s / CEO’s office.
* Highly organized and dependable: you keep many threads moving at once and never drop one.
* Strong writing: clear, crisp emails, LinkedIn messages, briefs and meeting summaries, and the ability to write in the CEO’s voice.
* Business sense: enough understanding of Data, AI, cloud and our solutions to choose the right content and message for each person.
* Getting things done without authority: you get busy internal teams to deliver on time, politely and persistently.
* Research skills: quick, sharp research on companies and people using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and the web.
* Communication and presence: confident with senior leaders, both internal and external, in the US and India.
* Discretion and judgement: you work closely with the CEO and senior contacts, and handle confidential information with care.
* Comfortable with tools: CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce), Microsoft 365, Sales Navigator, and AI tools for research, notes and drafting.
* Ownership: you act as if the pipeline is yours, not like an assistant waiting for instructions.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in a founder’s office, CEO’s office or chief of staff role.
* Background in IT services, consulting or Data & AI.
* Experience working with US clients and time zones.
* An MBA or equivalent business qualification.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Every active contact and opportunity has a current status and next step; nothing goes stale.
* Follow-ups sent within 24 hours of meetings and within 48 hours of trips and events.
* Meeting actions closed on time, across internal and external stakeholders.
* Growth in qualified meetings and opportunities from the CEO’s network and nurture programmes.
* Measurable outcomes from each trip and event, such as meetings held, opportunities opened and relationships advanced.
* CEO time saved and redirected to high-value conversations.

**Why Join**

* Work directly alongside the CEO and see how a fast-growing company is built from the inside.
* Real exposure to senior clients, partners and leadership in the US, India, the UK and the UAE.
* A role that can grow into chief of staff, strategy or BD leadership.

title: Deloitte USI - Consulting Services – Strategy Risky & Transactions – Specialist | Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Deloitte USI - Consulting Services – Strategy Risky & Transactions – Specialist | Hyderabad**
**About The Team**
The Consulting Services (GCS) team works globally across practices and borders to support Deloitte’s Consulting business. The team is focused on offering our clients and people the global experience that’s essential in today’s world. Through the Consulting Services team, we provide innovative solutions for cross-cultural, cross-border challenges our teams may encounter around the world. **Overview Of The Role**
The Consultant in the SR&T Special Projects Team will play a key role in supporting SR&T Global Offering leaders and teams in the execution and operations across the global strategic plans and priorities. Collaborating closely with the Special Projects lead, the role will be dynamic and highly collaborative, as special projects will encompass deliverables across the full breadth of SR&T offerings and include liaison across the full team portfolio.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
The professional will work with the India colleagues and senior leaders across Consulting Services practice. They will need to develop a knowledge of the firm’s Consulting Services business, strategic priorities to enable sharing of insights, trends and escalation of issues/variances as appropriate. The professional will analyse quantitative and qualitative data, synthesize findings, and demonstrate solid analytical and writing skills. The professional will also be responsible to develop compelling narrative with clear recommendations based on the research, analysis and findings. The team’s projects are typically high-impact and high-visibility aligned to the global firm and Consulting Services leadership’s strategic priorities. Projects often involve collaboration across workstreams to ensure coordination and alignment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with the Special Projects Lead and Global Program Leads to deliver priorities that create and protect value for Deloitte’s clients, scale the SR&T Offerings, and build connections within SR&T, GCS pillars, and across the firm.
* Deliver accelerated success across SR&T special projects, which will include deliverables such as aligning with GCS, leveraging the go-to-market, and enabling pillars (e.g., leadership meetings, pursuits and sales excellence, KPIs, assets and technology, market eminence, community management etc.).
* Gain and utilise functional knowledge of the required internal reporting tools for revenue, sales, and pipeline tracking.
* Conduct data driven analysis (quantitative and qualitative) to provide meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.
* Drive standardization and business continuity as well as identify commonalities that can be shared as best practices and identify operational efficiencies (provide suggestions/automations to enhance deliverables).
* Demonstrate solid project management skills, with the ability to seamlessly co-ordinate/switch between different workstreams.
* Support senior executives in developing executive level documents (PowerPoint presentations, Excel reports, Tableau dashboards etc.) for senior leadership utilizing story boarding skills.
* Develop knowledge of the business and priority initiatives to share insights and trends as appropriate.
* Be a proactive participant in a high-performance, inclusive, and collaborative culture across SR&T and be a people champion. Collaborate effectively across the SR&T portfolio to deliver incremental impact across Special Projects.
* Support meeting planning and execution, including drafting agenda, organizing online and offline meetings and document MoM for follow up and accountability.
* Support operational needs of the team, including maintaining and running recurring projects independently, and supporting junior or new team members.

Requisite core skills
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to prepare leadership ready materials that “tell-the-story” succinctly and logically; ability to flex the communication and messaging to the audience and context.
* Strong project management and time management skills; ability to work independently under pressure, and on multiple assignments while maintaining top quality deliverables.
* Strong business communication skills, capable of building effective working relationships with internal stakeholders across levels and across multiple business areas, functions, and geographies in a largely virtual environment.
* Mastery of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) with strong attention to detail and best in class deliverables.
* Minimum of 3 years of prior relevant experience.
* Added advantage: Knowledge and previous experience in innovation, strategy & operations, transformational roles.
* Added advantage: Write and edit Macros in Excel, create dashboards on Tableau, PowerBI, SharePoint knowledge and familiarity with online meeting platforms like MS Teams and Zoom.

**Qualifications, experience, work location, and timing**
We are looking for a passionate, high energy, and self-motivated individual who is accustomed to working independently and collaboratively on small and large projects in a close-knit team.
  
  

* Academic qualification: Master’s Degree like MBA
* Work experience: 4+ years of relevant experience
* Strong track record with previous employment, preferably with consulting firms or corporate strategy
* Location: Hyderabad
* Work hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM and 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM (expected to be flexible with time zones)
* Working from office: The individual is expected to come to office at least 2 days a week as per the ‘work from office’ schedule

**About Deloitte**

These firms are members of Deloitte Touché Tohmatsu Limited DTTL, a UK private company limited by guarantee. description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**The Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
**Senior Consulting Manager – AVEVA Operations Control**
to lead the design, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-scale Industrial Automation and Digital Transformation solutions using the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio. The ideal candidate will possess extensive expertise in AVEVA Operations Control, AVEVA System Platform, Historian, Operations Management Interface (OMI), Reports, and enterprise industrial system architectures, along with a strong understanding of OT-IT convergence, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and enterprise integration.
  
  
The role is responsible for defining scalable, secure, resilient, and high-availability solution architectures while providing technical leadership throughout the entire project lifecycle—from solution consulting and architecture through engineering, deployment, testing, commissioning, and production support. The successful candidate will establish technical standards, drive architecture governance, and ensure solutions align with customer business objectives, industry best practices, and organizational quality standards.
  
  
In addition to technical leadership, this role includes people management responsibilities, providing mentorship, coaching, and career development for a team of solution architects, technical leads, and engineers. As a trusted technical advisor, the Solution Architect will collaborate closely with customers, business stakeholders, project managers, delivery teams, and cross-functional engineering groups to deliver innovative, reliable, and scalable industrial digital transformation solutions across industries including Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Manufacturing, Mining, Power, Utilities, Water, and Infrastructure. The successful candidate will foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous improvement, innovation, and collaboration while ensuring successful project delivery and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise-scale Industrial Automation and Digital Transformation solutions using the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio.
* Define scalable, secure, resilient, and high-availability solution architectures that align with customer business objectives, enterprise IT standards, and OT operational requirements.
* Prepare, review, and maintain Solution Design Documents (SDD), Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Detailed Design specifications (DDS), Solution architecture, System Architecture, Factory Acceptance Test Procedure, Site Acceptance Test Procedures and deployment documentation.

* Design and govern deployment architectures for the complete AVEVA Operations Control ecosystem, including:

+ AVEVA System Platform
+ AVEVA Operations Management Interface (OMI)
+ AVEVA Historian
+ AVEVA Identity Manager
+ Galaxy Repository
+ Application Object Servers
+ Alarm Servers
+ Communication Drivers
+ License Manager
+ Microsoft SQL Server
+ IIS Web Servers

* Architect High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), redundancy, backup, and failover strategies to ensure maximum system availability and business continuity.
* Lead infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, scalability assessments, and performance optimization for enterprise and mission-critical deployments across on-premises, virtualized, and cloud environments.
* Define enterprise system architecture, network topology, server infrastructure, cybersecurity controls, communication protocols, and integration patterns, customer standards, and AVEVA best practices.
* Design secure authentication and authorization solutions leveraging Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, HTTPS/TLS, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Review and approve technical designs, engineering deliverables, and deployment strategies to ensure architectural consistency, maintainability, and operational excellence.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable design patterns, implementation guidelines, and technical governance processes across projects.
* Evaluate new AVEVA product capabilities and emerging technologies to continuously improve solution architecture, standardization, and delivery efficiency.
* Identify technical risks, perform architecture reviews, and define mitigation strategies to ensure successful project execution.
* Ensure all solution designs comply with AVEVA recommended practices, cybersecurity requirements, organizational governance, regulatory standards, and project-specific performance, availability, and reliability objectives.

**Essential Requirements**
**Non-Technical:**

* Excellent written, verbal, technical, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively engage with customers, executive stakeholders, project teams, and multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
* Strong leadership, mentoring, coaching, and people management skills with experience in developing high-performing technical teams.
* Proven ability to lead customer workshops, architecture reviews, technical governance meetings, and executive presentations.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex technical challenges.
* Experience in effort estimation, resource planning, risk management, and technical governance across multiple concurrent projects.
* Willingness and flexibility to travel for customer engagements, architecture workshops, solution reviews, commissioning support, and project delivery activities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Visio, and Microsoft Project.

**Technical**

* 18+ years of experience in Industrial Automation, SCADA, MES, or Digital Manufacturing, with at least 10 years in Solution Architecture or Technical Leadership roles.

- Extensive expertise in the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio, including:

* AVEVA System Platform
* AVEVA Operations Management Interface (OMI)
* AVEVA Historian
* AVEVA Identity Manager
* AVEVA Communication Drivers
* AVEVA License Manager
* Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale AVEVA Operations Control solutions for mission-critical industrial environments.
* Strong expertise in designing scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available industrial architectures for on-premises, virtualized, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Extensive experience in enterprise architecture, infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, redundancy, disaster recovery (DR), failover strategies, and system performance optimization.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, IIS, Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and enterprise authentication and authorization mechanisms.
* Experience designing secure architectures utilizing HTTPS/TLS, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and cybersecurity best practices
* Strong understanding of OT/IT convergence and enterprise integration with systems such as SAP, IBM Maximo, Microsoft applications, RESTful APIs, OPC DA/UA, MQTT, and other industrial communication protocols.
* Experience designing enterprise data architectures involving AVEVA Historian, SQL Server, reporting platforms, and analytics solutions.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure, including Virtual Machines, networking, storage, identity management, and hybrid deployment architectures.
* Experience establishing architecture standards, engineering guidelines, reusable frameworks, and governance processes across multiple projects.
* Proven ability to perform technical reviews, solution validation, architecture governance, and design assurance throughout the project lifecycle.
* Strong knowledge of Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, production deployment, operational readiness, and support transition.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams through the complete project lifecycle, from solution consulting and architecture to implementation, commissioning, and production support.
* Experience with AVEVA CONNECT, Industrial IoT, Digital Transformation initiatives, and cloud-based industrial solutions is desirable.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, microservices architecture, containerization, and DevOps practices is considered an advantage.
* Experience mentoring Solution Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineers while fostering technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement within engineering organizations.

**Services at AVEVA**
Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. title: Strategic Account Manager (SAM) OR Client Partner (EXP: 15+ Years)
description:
**Job Description: Strategic Account Manager (SAM) OR Client Partner (EXP: 15+ Years)**
**About Bilvantis**
Bilvantis is a Data & AI engineering services company with teams in the US, India, the UK and the UAE. We don't work as a vendor. We work as an extension of our clients' own teams. We put our solutions and accelerators into every piece of repeatable work, and we choose to grow deep within a small set of accounts rather than spread thin across many.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
At Bilvantis, growth comes from going deep in each account. The Client Partner owns that. You'll treat your accounts like a business you run: you deepen the relationships we have, open new ones, and keep finding where Bilvantis can create real value for the client. When that works, the account grows.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Account growth:**

* Own the revenue, margin and growth targets for your accounts, and build and run an account plan for each one.
* Find ways to upsell and cross-sell, from new projects and expanded scope to new service lines and our accelerators.
* Co-sell with partners such as Databricks and other technology alliances.
* Keep the pipeline and forecast accurate, and lead proposals from first idea through to signed contract.

**Relationships**

* Build trusted relationships at several levels of the client: executive sponsors, business leaders, technology heads and procurement.
* Move beyond the people we already know and build new relationships across business units and regions.
* Hold the governance cadence: QBRs, steering committees and executive check-ins.

**Mapping Client Needs To What Bilvantis Offers**

* Know the client deeply: their business, priorities, technology landscape, budget cycles, politics and competitors.
* Know Bilvantis just as well: our solutions, accelerators, case studies and people.
* Connect the two by spotting where we can create value before the client asks, and turning that into a clear story they'll fund.

**Working With Internal Teams**

* Act as the link between the client and the Delivery, Practice, Pre-Sales and Solutions teams.
* Take our existing solutions and people to the client, so they're positioned, staffed and land well.
* Bring client needs and feedback back to the team, and work with them to shape new solutions and offerings.
* Keep a close eye on delivery health and step in early to protect the relationship and our reputation.

**What You Bring**

* Prior Experience: 15+ years in IT Services, including 5+ Years in Strategic Account Management (SAM).
* Stakeholder management: you're at ease with senior client leaders, and just as good at aligning internal teams without having direct authority over them.
* Relationship building: people trust you, inside and outside the company, and you have relationships that have lasted for years to show for it.
* Business and solution sense: enough grounding in Data, AI and cloud to talk about value credibly and know when to bring in the experts.
* Teamwork: a record of winning together with delivery and pre-sales, not working around them.
* Communication: clear and persuasive in writing, in meetings and in front of executives.
* Commercial skill: confident with pricing, SOWs, rate negotiations and contract structures.
* Track record: you've grown named accounts by 50% or more year on year.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in BFSI or Manufacturing.
* Exposure to the Databricks or hyperscaler partner ecosystems.
* Background at a global systems integrator or a growth-stage services firm.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Year-on-year growth in account revenue and margin.
* New logos or business units opened within existing clients.
* Number of executive relationships, and how many levels of the client they span.
* Pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy.
* Client satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) and retention.

**Why Join**

* A role that's yours to shape at a company that's growing fast.
* Direct access to leadership, and decisions made quickly.
* Real solutions and accelerators to take to clients, not just people to place.

title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Investment Optimization
description:
**Summary**
Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Insights and Analytics, the Senior Manager, Enterprise Investment Optimization is accountable for developing enterprise and cross-portfolio investment/resource optimization recommendations in partnership with Finance across US direct external spend, capability spend, and HQ and field FTEs.
  
  
The role serves as a Hyderabad capability anchor for EH Enterprise Resource Optimization, providing analytical depth, scenario evaluation, external benchmarking, synthesis and recommendation development in partnership with US-based Enterprise I&A and Finance stakeholders.
  
  
Working in a two-in-a-box model with the AIDE Analytics, Capabilities & Modeling CoE, the role defines business questions, frames analytical requirements, challenges assumptions and translates optimization-model outputs into clear, actionable investment recommendations.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Senior Manager, Enterprise Investment Optimization**
**Location – Hyderabad Hybrid**
**Major Accountabilities**
**Enterprise Investment Optimization Recommendations**

* Structure ambiguous investment and resource-allocation questions into clear decision problems, scenarios, evaluation criteria, and executive-ready recommendations across direct spend, capability spend, HQ, and field FTE resourcing for the US portfolio.
* Support EH in developing prioritized guidance on where, how, and when to reallocate or invest by synthesizing optimization outputs, external benchmarks, financial ratios, analogs, risks, trade-offs, and expected outcomes into clear recommendations for USLT.
* Build and maintain external benchmarking to assess Novartis investment levels versus comparable players, identify potential overinvestment or reallocation opportunities, and challenge historical budget baselines to enable more optimal investment decisions.

**Partnership with the Modeling CoE**

* Partner closely with the AIDE CoE Modeling sleeve to deliver integrated enterprise-level investment recommendations, ensuring consultation and modeling operate as one connected capability from the stakeholder perspective.
* Lead the consultation side of the two-in-a-box model by defining business questions, framing modeling requirements, stress-testing methodologies and assumptions, and validating that outputs are fit for the decision at hand.
* Align with Analytics and Modeling leadership on clear handoffs, decision rights, and ways of working to ensure seamless delivery and accountability.

**Finance & Enterprise Stakeholder Partnership**

* Partner with Finance to co-create enterprise investment and resourcing recommendations by aligning financial baselines, assumptions, decision frameworks, and I&A evidence into clear guidance on investment choices, trade-offs, risks, and expected outcomes.
* Support enterprise planning and executive review forums with decision-ready investment-optimization recommendations, while resolving interfaces with adjacent teams across AIDE, SPT, and Finance and escalating unresolved ownership questions with a recommended position.
* Maintain clear role boundaries, ensuring the function provides strategic advisory recommendations without holding final budget or workforce allocation authority.

**Enterprise Standards & Capability Building**

* Apply and continuously improve enterprise standards and methodologies for producing, framing, and communicating resource optimization guidance across direct spend, capability spend, and HQ and field FTEs.
* Build the team’s consultative capability by strengthening strategic advisory skills that translate analytical outputs into clear business recommendations.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare resource allocation, investment optimization, commercial analytics, strategic finance, or management consulting, with strong quantitative fluency and strategic consulting capability.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Finance, Economics, or a related field required, MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* Proven ability to translate optimization model outputs into actionable investment recommendations for senior business and finance leaders, including the ability to interrogate assumptions, identify limitations, and assess methodology without directly building the model.
* Working knowledge of marketing mix, promotion response, investment optimization, external benchmarking, financial ratios, and analogs to inform resource allocation and investment guidance.
* Experience partnering with Finance on budget, investment, or headcount planning, with people management experience and exposure to globally distributed delivery models.

**Required Skills**

* Strong strategic consulting and business acumen, with the ability to structure ambiguous investment questions, understand pharmaceutical commercial investment dynamics, and develop clear, defensible recommendations.
* Quantitative fluency to critically interpret model results, challenge methodologies and assumptions, and distinguish signal from noise in ambiguous or incomplete evidence environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present persuasive investment recommendations to senior leaders and influence without authority in a two-in-a-box model.
* Proficiency with Excel and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

**Preferred Experience And Skills**

* Management consulting experience at a top-tier firm or comparable internal strategy role, with exposure to large-scale transformation, operating model redesign, offshore analytics/modeling hubs, and portfolio-level investment prioritization.
* Experience across multiple spend categories, including promotional, capability/capital, workforce resourcing, and launch resourcing.
* Working knowledge of the US pharmaceutical commercial model, data, and analytics ecosystem, with familiarity in AI-enabled investment analysis, scenario modeling, and process modernization.
* Strong change management and stakeholder communication skills.

**Location:**
Hyderabad NKC | Hybrid | 3 days a week in office is mandatory.
  
  
**Why Novartis:**
Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture
  
  
**Benefits and Rewards:**
Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.

description:

Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high-quality, outcome-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. Full-time

Enterprise AI is at an inflection point.

Businesses are moving beyond AI experimentation and looking for technologies that can fundamentally change how they operate, make decisions and execute business processes.

At FinteractAI, we're building the next generation of enterprise AI.

Our flagship platform, FORGE, is an Autonomous Business Operations Engine that works across existing ERP and business systems to intelligently understand, validate and execute complex business processes within enterprise-defined controls.

With live deployments across industries and demonstrated outcomes including up to 90% reduction in manual processing, we're now accelerating enterprise adoption.

We're looking for an exceptional individual who can help lead this journey.

Someone who can think like a strategist, engage like a business leader and execute like an entrepreneur.

As our Enterprise AI Strategy & Growth Lead, you'll work closely with the founding leadership, product and engineering teams to help enterprises understand and realise the business potential of AI.

You will independently develop enterprise relationships, engage with CEOs, CFOs, COOs and other senior leaders, identify high-impact business opportunities and convert them into successful customer engagements.

This is a frontline, revenue-owning role — combining strategic business understanding with the energy, initiative and persistence required to win enterprise customers.

Enterprise Growth & Revenue Ownership

- Build credibility as a knowledgeable and trusted enterprise AI professional.

Product & Engineering Collaboration

- Work closely with our product and engineering teams to translate enterprise challenges into practical AI solutions.

- Bring customer insights and market feedback into product development discussions.

- Collaborate on solution positioning, demonstrations and customer adoption strategies.

- Help build repeatable enterprise use cases and scalable go-to-market approaches.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

We value intellectual ability, curiosity, ambition and ownership more than conventional job titles or years of experience.

Educational Background

We particularly encourage applications from:

- Chartered Accountants (CA) — including exceptional newly qualified professionals.

- MBA + B.Tech graduates with strong analytical, business and technology aptitude.

- Exceptional candidates from other academic backgrounds who demonstrate outstanding potential.

Experience: 0–5 years.

Experience in enterprise sales, consulting, business development, corporate finance, technology or related areas is valuable, but not mandatory for outstanding candidates.

1. Exceptional Intelligence & Analytical Ability

You think independently, learn quickly, connect complex ideas and can understand business problems beyond their surface symptoms.

2. Strong Technology Aptitude & AI Curiosity

You actively follow AI developments and understand their implications for enterprises.

You don't need to be a developer or AI researcher. But you should be able to discuss how AI can reshape business processes, human roles, enterprise systems and operating models.

3. High Energy & Commercial Drive

You enjoy building relationships, opening doors, pursuing ambitious opportunities and converting conversations into business outcomes.

You are persistent, resourceful and comfortable with demanding growth targets.

4. Leadership Potential

You demonstrate initiative, sound judgment, confidence, resilience and the ambition to take on larger responsibilities.

You don't wait for detailed instructions to make progress.

5. Executive Communication & Presence

You can communicate complex ideas simply, ask intelligent questions, engage confidently with senior executives and build lasting professional relationships.

6. Collaborative & Entrepreneurial Mindset

You enjoy working with engineers, product builders and business leaders.

You challenge assumptions constructively, contribute ideas and take ownership of outcomes beyond your immediate responsibilities.

**WHY JOIN FINTERACTAI?**

Work at the Frontier of Enterprise AI

Be part of a company building AI-native capabilities that go beyond conventional automation and AI copilots to execute real business operations.

Learn Directly from Experienced Leadership

Work closely with a founding team bringing decades of experience across global banking, enterprise technology, product development and business operations.

Engage with Enterprise CXOs

Build meaningful relationships with senior business leaders across industries and participate in conversations shaping enterprise AI adoption.

Influence Product Direction

Your understanding of business problems and customer requirements will help shape the evolution of our AI platform.

Accelerate Your Leadership Journey

We believe exceptional individuals should grow based on capability and contribution, not tenure. The right candidate can progress into enterprise coverage leadership, industry vertical ownership or broader business leadership responsibilities.

Earn Exceptional Rewards

For the right talent, we offer a highly competitive, performance-oriented compensation package comprising:

- Attractive fixed compensation.

- Significant performance-linked incentives.

- Revenue-sharing opportunities.

- ESOP participation for eligible high performers.

- Accelerated growth opportunities based on results.

We want the people who create exceptional value to participate meaningfully in the value they help build.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Within your first year, you should be developing into a confident enterprise AI professional who can:

- Independently engage senior enterprise decision-makers.

- Identify business problems where AI can create meaningful, measurable impact.

- Build credible business cases and lead strategic customer conversations.

- Convert enterprise opportunities into signed customers and revenue.

- Become a valued partner to our product and engineering teams.

- Build a reputation for business insight, commercial execution and ownership.

Your success will be measured by the enterprise relationships you build, the customers and revenue you win, and the leadership capabilities you demonstrate.

**WHO WILL THRIVE HERE?**

Someone who wants more than a conventional corporate career.

Someone who is intellectually curious, commercially ambitious, technology-oriented and excited by the opportunity to help enterprises adopt AI at scale.

Someone who wants to build the credibility, experience and capabilities to become a future business leader.

If you want to be at the intersection of AI, enterprise strategy and business growth, we'd love to meet you.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your CV to info@finteract.ai

Subject: Enterprise AI Strategy & Growth Lead – Hyderabad

**"Identify one enterprise business process that AI could fundamentally change over the next three years. What would change, and how would you measure its business impact?"**

**We are interested in how you think, not how many AI buzzwords you know.**

FinteractAI | Building the Autonomous Enterprise

www.finteract.ai

title: Medical Business Associate -  Hyderabad
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
You will connect with healthcare professionals across Hyderabad to build trusted relationships and share clear, science-based information that supports better patient care. By designing and delivering a territory plan focused on local needs and customer insights, you will help make a meaningful difference. Working closely with colleagues from different teams, you will address challenges and improve patient access. We seek curious, honest, and practical thinkers who want to grow, learn, and create impact. This role offers valuable learning opportunities, career growth, and a chance to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain respectful, professional relationships with doctors, pharmacists, and other healthcare partners in your territory.
* Develop and execute a territory business plan based on customer insights and local patient needs.
* Share clear and accurate science-based information to support healthcare professionals’ decision-making.
* Record and report activities, outcomes, and customer insights accurately using company systems and tools.
* Collaborate with colleagues across functions to address customer needs and improve patient access.
* Continuously build your knowledge of clinical evidence, market trends, and ways to improve your performance.

Work type

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and perspectives. We value inclusion and work to create a workplace where everyone can contribute and grow.
  
  
Basic Qualification
  
  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution.
* At least 1 year of customer-facing experience in field sales, medical business, or territory management.

* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Telugu; knowledge of other local languages is a plus.

* Ability to use customer insight and simple data to guide your activities and priorities.

Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
  
  
**Why GSK?**

title: Manager - Strategy
description:
**The Role :**

At Recykal, strategy is not a support function. It is a growth engine. As part of the Strategy team, you will work alongside business leaders to shape high impact decisions that influence growth, profitability and long term market positioning. You will be embedded within a business unit cluster, working as a strategic partner who turns ambiguity into action.

**CORE MANDATE:**

* Own annual strategic planning for the assigned business unit cluster — market sizing, competitive landscaping, and opportunity assessment.
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with clear milestones, resource requirements, and success metrics.
* Lead strategic projects spanning product launches, pricing strategy, and market expansion.
* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership, aligning priorities across teams.
* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health and build dashboards that surface the right signals.
* Prepare executive presentations and board-level materials that drive decision-making at the top.

**EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

* 4–8 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or business development
* Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities; comfortable building models from scratch
* Experience solving complex, end-to-end strategic business problems with measurable impact
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for modelling, analysis, and executive storytelling
* Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus
* MBA / equivalent postgraduate degree preferred; strong academic foundation in business or economics

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**A. BU STRATEGY & ANNUAL PLANNING**

* Own annual strategic planning; conduct market sizing, competitive landscaping and opportunity assessments
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with milestones and success metrics
* Work with BU heads to define strategic priorities for the year ahead
* Monitor strategy execution, track KPIs, and flag early-warning signals

**B. COMMERCIAL & GROWTH INITIATIVES**

* Lead strategic projects — product launches, pricing strategy, market expansion
* Build robust financial models and business cases for new opportunities
* Identify white spaces and adjacencies for growth
* Partner with Sales, Product and Operations to convert strategy into measurable outcomes

**C. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP**

* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership
* Collaborate with Finance, Product and Operations on cross-functional initiatives
* Influence decision-making without direct authority
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels

**D. PERFORMANCE & INSIGHTS**

* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health; build dashboards for leadership
* Develop competitive intelligence frameworks to track market dynamics and benchmark Recykal's position

**E. EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION & STORYTELLING**

* Prepare crisp, well-structured executive presentations and board-level materials
* Synthesize complex data into clear, decision-ready recommendations
* Communicate decisions and strategic context in a way that builds confidence and clarity

**WHY THIS ROLE?**

* Embedded strategic partner shaping high-impact decisions for a business unit cluster
* Direct exposure to BU heads, central leadership, and investors
* Own strategy end to end — from market sizing to boardroom storytelling
* Equal parts analyst and communicator — build the models and deliver the narrative

OR
  
  
Equivalent experience.

title: Senior Product Specialist - Deep Sector-7
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**

Clients seamlessly access organized and connected content that is easily discoverable, explorable, and procured via the Open:FactSet Marketplace. Data is delivered via a variety of technologies and formats that meet the needs of our client's workflows. By enabling our clients to utilize their preferred choice of industry standard databases, programming languages, and data visualization tools, we empower them to focus on the core competencies needed to drive their business. * Ability to troubleshoot client issues and solve them with a combination of creativity, analytical skills, and subject matter expertise.
* Understands how to leverage tools and frameworks for product management such as user personas, empathy mapping, and prioritization frameworks.
* Is product-oriented. Can take a stand to say “No” to stakeholders/engineering and starts by defining the problems, goals and needs, and does experimentation to uncover the best solution.
* Familiarity with query languages (e.g., SQL) and programming languages commonly utilized in the financial industry (e.g., Python, R).
* Knowledge of data sets and technology solutions commonly utilized in the financial industry is a plus.

Knowledge of data and technology workflows and end users common in the financial industry is a plus.

* Develop and maintain subsector-level expertise across tech (and specifically hardware, semiconductor and consumer tech) landscape, including emerging technologies, business models, and financial drivers. This includes proactively researching companies, trends, themes, underlying technologies, and potential disruptions through direct study of industry reports, company disclosures and other credible sources.

description:
**About SmartWinnr**

 

SmartWinnr is an enterprise-grade sales enablement platform that helps organizations build sales readiness through AI sales roleplay, coaching, and certification at scale. The platform serves Fortune 500 clients including Boston Scientific, Johnson & Johnson, and AstraZeneca, along with other major companies such as Abbott, Medtronic, HDFC Life, SBI Life, ICICI Prudential, and Aditya Birla to boost sales productivity. SmartWinnr has earned recognition from G2 as one of the top 50 sales products for two consecutive years, based on authentic customer reviews and feedback.

**Job Role:**

Pre-Sales Solutions Architect

**Job Location:**

Hyderabad (On-site)

**About the role**

SmartWinnr is looking for a Pre-Sales Solutions Architect who can bridge the gap between customer business requirements and our product capabilities. This role requires excellent communication and presentation skills, along with strong expertise in sales documentation and proposal development.

You will work closely with the sales team to demonstrate SmartWinnr's platform to prospective customers, including senior leadership, understand their requirements, and prepare compelling proposals, commercial documents, and responses to RFPs/RFQs.

The role also involves coordinating the review of customer agreements, setting up demo accounts, and creating customized presentations and other sales materials based on business discussions. We are looking for someone who can communicate confidently with enterprise customers, manage documentation accurately, and support the sales team throughout the sales cycle.

**What you will own**

* **Product demonstrations and presentations.**

  Deliver engaging product demos to prospective customers, including senior leadership. Understand customer requirements and tailor demonstrations to relevant business use cases and expected outcomes.

* **Demo account setup.**

  Set up, configure, and maintain demo accounts and environments before customer meetings. Ensure the product is ready for demonstrations and aligned with the prospect's requirements

* **Proposal documentation.**

  Prepare professional proposals, solution documents, presentations, commercial proposals, and other sales-related documentation based on customer discussions and business requirements.

* **RFP/RFQ responses.**

  Review Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), and customer questionnaires. Coordinate with internal teams to gather accurate information and ensure complete, high-quality submissions within deadlines.

* **MSA/NDA vetting and coordination.**

  Review customer Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) for completeness, identify non-standard clauses or deviations, and coordinate with the Legal team and relevant stakeholders for review and approval.

* **Commercial documentation.**

  Prepare quotations, pricing summaries, commercial proposals, and supporting documents in coordination with the sales and finance teams. Ensure accuracy and alignment with approved commercial terms.

* **Sales decks and supporting materials.**

  Create and customize presentation decks, solution overviews, and other sales collateral based on business discussions, prospect requirements, and sales opportunities.

﻿

* **Cross-functional collaboration.**

  Work closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and other internal teams to gather information, validate product capabilities, address customer queries, and support deal progression.

**What we are looking for**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, sales enablement, sales support, or a similar role.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present confidently to enterprise customers and senior leadership.
* Strong presentation skills and the ability to explain product features, use cases, and business value clearly.
* Experience preparing proposals, presentations, commercial documents, and other customer-facing sales materials.
* Ability to understand business discussions and translate customer requirements into structured documentation and compelling presentations.
* Strong attention to detail when preparing and reviewing documents.
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and other tools used for sales documentation.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate documentation within tight deadlines.
* A proactive, organized, and ownership-driven approach to work.

**Useful but not required**

* Experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, sales enablement, or enterprise SaaS sales.
* Experience conducting software product demonstrations for enterprise customers.
* Familiarity with RFP/RFQ processes, commercial proposals, and enterprise procurement requirements.
* Exposure to MSA/NDA review and contract coordination.
* Experience with CRM platforms, proposal management tools, and document collaboration systems.
* Understanding of SaaS business models and enterprise sales cycles.

**What this role is not**

This is not purely a product demonstration or presentation role. It requires equal attention to sales documentation, commercial proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, and coordination of customer agreements.

The person will be expected to contribute hands-on to preparing documents, setting up demo accounts, coordinating with internal teams, and supporting the sales team in moving opportunities forward.

**Things worth knowing before you apply**

You will work closely with the sales team and engage with prospective enterprise customers. Strong communication, presentation skills, documentation accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple sales-related activities are essential to succeeding in this role.

The position is based in Hyderabad and requires working on-site.

description: ## About the RoleAt Leverage Edu, we believe every student deserves the right guidance to achieve their global education aspirations. We are looking for ambitious, driven, and student-focused individuals to join our team as **Study Abroad Consultants**.As a Consultant, you will be responsible for guiding students through their study abroad journey, understanding their aspirations, recommending the right-fit universities and programmes, and helping them make informed decisions about their future. You will serve as their trusted advisor, building strong relationships and ensuring a seamless experience from the initial consultation to admission and enrolment.This role offers the opportunity to combine your communication, advisory, and relationship-building skills with a strong focus on **student outcomes, enrolment success, and business growth**. You will work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where taking ownership, building trust, and consistently delivering results are key to success.## Key Responsibilities**1. Student Counselling and Solution Advisory**- Conduct in-depth consultations to understand student requirements and provide tailored recommendations on countries, universities, courses, and career pathways.- Present suitable programmes and services, clearly communicating their value and relevance to students' goals.- Help students evaluate their options, address concerns, and make confident, well-informed decisions.**3. University and Admissions Expertise**- Develop a strong understanding of international education markets, university admission processes, intake cycles, eligibility criteria, and application requirements.- Guide students on standardised tests and English language proficiency exams, including GRE, GMAT, IELTS, and TOEFL.- Stay updated on university offerings, admission trends, and emerging opportunities across study destinations.**4. Application Progress and Process Management**- Track student progress at every stage of the application journey and ensure timely completion of key milestones.- Proactively identify challenges, address concerns, and coordinate with internal teams to minimise delays.- Maintain accurate student records and ensure consistent follow-ups to keep applications moving forward.**5. Admission, Offer and Enrolment Coordination**- Guide students through offer evaluation, university selection, and subsequent admission formalities.- Collaborate with visa, admissions, finance, and international university teams to facilitate a smooth transition from offer acceptance to enrolment.- Ensure students receive timely support and a high-quality experience throughout the process.**6. Performance and Business Growth**- Take ownership of individual performance goals and contribute to the team's overall business objectives.- Convert student consultations into meaningful enrolment outcomes through effective needs assessment, solution positioning, objection handling, and relationship management.- Manage the student pipeline proactively, prioritise high-intent opportunities, and maintain consistent follow-ups to maximise outcomes.- Identify opportunities to improve student engagement, decision-making, and enrolment rates while maintaining a student-first approach.## What You Bring1. A graduate or MBA degree in business, management, psychology, or a related field.2. 0–5 years of professional experience; experience in ed-tech, education consulting, customer engagement, or client-facing roles is an advantage.3. Strong communication, influencing, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.4. A results-oriented mindset with the ability to work towards defined performance goals and deliver measurable outcomes.5. Excellent research and analytical abilities, with an interest in international education and global career opportunities.6. The ability to understand customer needs, present tailored solutions, handle objections, and build confidence through effective communication.7. Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple student journeys simultaneously.8. A proactive, resilient, and ownership-driven attitude, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment.## What We Offer1. Industry-leading perks and benefits.2. A dynamic work environment with significant ownership, learning, and career growth opportunities.3. The opportunity to work alongside talented teams across technology, marketing, partnerships, content, and student experience.4. A high-performance culture that encourages initiative, accountability, continuous learning, and rapid execution.5. Opportunities to take on greater responsibilities and grow into leadership roles.6. Access to experienced mentors and a strong professional network within the international education ecosystem.7. The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping students make life-changing decisions about their higher education and careers.**Work Mode:** Full-time, office-based role **Working Days:** Six days a week

environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.

* Solution Design & Implementation

* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.

* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.

* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.

* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).

Introduction
  
  
Join our Sales team as a Manager of Field Account South and play a key role in driving commercial performance across the assigned territory through effective sales execution, customer engagement, and opportunity governance. In this field-based leadership role, you will guide Field Account Managers, strengthen customer relationships, and ensure disciplined account execution to accelerate growth and support better health for more people. This position is based in Hyderabad, India and requires extensive customer-facing engagement across the territory.
  
  
**Grow With Us – Your Responsibilities**

* Ensure sales process discipline through CRM (SFDC) compliance, rigorous opportunity qualification, high-quality documentation, and data-driven pipeline review practices to improve forecast accuracy, data quality, and sales cycle efficiency
* Govern execution of account plans across the territory by tracking progress, resolving escalations, and addressing execution gaps to maintain customer satisfaction and accelerate opportunity advancement
* Drive adoption of the commercial operating model by monitoring process adherence, collaboration between Account Management and Technical Sales teams, and completion of required enablement activities to ensure consistent execution and scalable commercial performance

* Demonstrated expertise in solution-based and value-based selling within complex customer environments

Experience: Freshers – 3 years
  
Qualification: MBA must required
  
Salary: 3-4lpa
  
  
About Bijliride
  
Bijliride is a fast-growing electric mobility company providing sustainable, convenient, and cost-effective
  
electric two-wheeler rental solutions to individuals and businesses.
  
  
Our services include electric vehicle rentals, battery delivery and swapping, breakdown assistance, B2B
  
fleet rentals, 3PL solutions, and EV fleet management. We are focused on building a reliable and
  
uninterrupted mobility ecosystem for our customers and business partners.
  
  
Position Overview
  
We are looking for a Key Accounts Manager who will be responsible for managing and developing
  
relationships with key B2B clients and business partners.
  
  
The role involves understanding client requirements, ensuring smooth service delivery, coordinating with
  
internal teams, resolving client issues, and identifying opportunities for account growth and revenue
  
generation.
  
  
Freshers with an MBA who have strong communication and relationship-management skills are also
  
encouraged to apply.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
● Manage and maintain strong relationships with key B2B clients and business partners.
  
● Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
  
● Understand client requirements and ensure timely resolution of queries and concerns.
  
● Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Service, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure smooth
  
service delivery.
  
● Monitor account performance, usage, revenue, and customer satisfaction.
  
● Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, renewals, and business growth.
  
● Handle client escalations and coordinate with relevant teams for quick resolution.
  
● Maintain regular communication with clients and conduct client meetings/business reviews.
  
● Coordinate with the Finance team regarding invoicing, outstanding payments, and collections.
  
● Prepare and maintain account reports, MIS, and performance updates.
  
● Support client onboarding and ensure a smooth transition from sales to operations.
  
● Build long-term relationships and improve client retention.
  
● Proactively identify potential issues and take corrective action before they impact the client.
  
● Support business expansion by identifying additional requirements and opportunities within
  
existing accounts.
  
  
Candidate Requirements
  
● MBA is preferred.
  
● Freshers can apply. Candidates with 0–5 years of experience in Key Account Management,
  
Client Servicing, Business Development, Sales, or B2B Relationship Management are eligible.
  
● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  
● Strong presentation, negotiation, and client-handling abilities.
  
● Good problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
  
● Ability to manage multiple clients and coordinate with different internal teams.
  
● Good working knowledge of MS Excel and reporting tools.
  
● Knowledge of CRM tools is an added advantage.
  
● Experience in EV, mobility, logistics, fleet management, or service industries will be an
  
advantage.
  
● Fluency in English, Hindi, and Telugu is preferred.
  
● Self-motivated, proactive, responsible, and target-oriented.
  
● Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
Working Requirements
  
● This is a client-facing and operationally important role.
  
● The candidate should be comfortable handling client calls beyond regular working hours when
  
required.
  
● Availability may be required for urgent client requirements, operational escalations, or
  
time-sensitive issues.
  
● Candidates should be flexible and committed to maintaining strong client relationships and
  
uninterrupted service.
  
What We Offer
  
● Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
  
● Opportunity to work with high-value B2B clients and business partners.
  
● Exposure to the growing EV and electric mobility industry.
  
● Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing organization.
  
● Hands-on experience in account management, business development, and operations.
  
● Supportive and growth-oriented work environment.
  
  
Immediate joiners are preferred.

description:

Hyderabad - Somajiguda
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Acquire and convert eligible Education Loan customers through compliant counselling, disciplined funnel management, complete documentation, coordinated fulfilment and active ownership of portfolio quality.

* Generate and manage leads from direct, referral, consultant, institution and partner channels.
* Counsel students and co-applicants on course, country, institution, funding requirement, repayment construct and documentation.
* Capture complete application data, customer consent and source attribution in approved systems.
* Collect and validate admission, academic, KYC, income, banking and collateral documents before login.
* Coordinate with Credit, Operations, Verification and partners to resolve queries and progress files within agreed service levels.

* Communicate sanction terms, conditions and pending requirements accurately to customers.
* Maintain compliant selling, customer confidentiality, audit trails and approved communication standards.
* Support portfolio quality through appropriate sourcing, fraud vigilance and early issue escalation.
* Support portfolio quality and X-bucket management through pre-due and pre-bounce customer engagement, timely repayment reminders, follow-up on assigned overdue cases and escalation to the Sales Manager and Collections team.
* Execute assigned activities directly and maintain accurate system records.
* Escalate customer, documentation, fraud or repayment concerns promptly.

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**
Decision rights
  
  

* Make day-to-day sales and customer-management decisions within approved policy, process, pricing and delegated authority.
* Prioritise and allocate customer follow-ups, including portfolio-quality and X-bucket actions, within the assigned scope.
* Escalate policy deviations, material customer impact, fraud indicators, persistent overdue cases and unresolved dependencies.
* Commercial, hiring and budget authorities are to be defined in the approved delegation matrix.

Key interactions
  
  
Internal Sales, Product, Credit/Underwriting, Risk, Operations, RCU/Fraud Control, Collections, Compliance, Finance, Technology, HR and COE.
  
  
External Students, co-applicants, universities, education consultants, DSAs, referral partners and other approved service providers.
  
  
**Major Challenges**

* Balancing growth, customer experience, turnaround time and portfolio quality.
* Managing incomplete or inconsistent customer, academic and financial information.
* Driving timely customer engagement for pre-due, pre-bounce and overdue cases while following approved conduct standards.
* Coordinating Sales, Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations to address X-bucket and early-delinquency issues.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
Graduate. Relevant customer-facing, lending or financial-services experience preferred.
  
  
Critical skills and knowledge
  
  

* Education Loan customer counselling
* Sales execution and relationship management
* Portfolio-quality and X-bucket management awareness
* Customer repayment engagement and early-delinquency follow-up
* Understanding of academic, income and KYC documents
* CRM/LOS usage and MIS discipline
* Communication, negotiation and customer orientation
* Compliance, fraud and customer-conduct awareness
* Excel, presentation and business MIS capability
* High standards of integrity and customer confidentiality
